## Cycle page: an option to select menopause (her 2026-10-19 "give optioon to select menopause", on a 55F patient whose Cycle page was still showing the full calendar/tracking UI; build 20261019-1270000, LIVE on main)
Investigated first: `phCycleOn(rec)` already has an age cut-off (`PH_CYCLE_CUT_AGE` 48) that would normally default a 55F to the "Change of life" question set — but it's skipped the instant `rec.cycleOn` is explicitly `true` or `false` (set at patient creation, `pr.cycleOn === undefined ? true`, or by an earlier cycle/fertility-plan complaint). A 55-year-old created before/without ever being re-evaluated can sit indefinitely in full cycle-tracking mode with no way out — there was a write path already built for this (`data-pres-cycle-enable`, an `.checked` handler that sets `rec.cycleOn` and calls `renderPresPanel()`) but NO markup anywhere in the file ever rendered that checkbox — confirmed by grep, dead code since whenever it was written.
- **Forward direction:** a plain outlined chip, **"Menopause"**, added to the Cycle page's own footer row (`phCycPageHtml`, after the Contraception chip — same `.ph-ck-chip` shape, same row as Regular/Irregular and Contraception already live in), shown for any female patient (not age-gated: premature/surgical menopause exists; her own explicit control, not an app-enforced cut-off). Tapping it sets `rec.cycleOn = false` — nothing is deleted, her existing `rec.cycle` data stays on file, this only stops asking her to log it and swaps her over to the Change of life question card (`phPfSetFor` already resolves "meno" the instant `cycleOn` is explicitly false).
- **Reverse direction, so this never dead-ends her:** the Change of life card (`presPfwSetHtml`, `sid === "meno"` only) gained a matching header chip, **"Tracking a cycle again?"**, writing `rec.cycleOn = true` and handing her straight back to the real Cycle page.
- **Repaint, deliberately NOT scoped:** flipping `cycleOn` adds/removes a whole rail tab (the "usual"/Change-of-life section in `presAssessSections`), the Today's-visit Cycle tile, and swaps the Cycle page's own content for an entirely different card — none of that lives inside one single scoped host, so a targeted repaint would have to touch three unrelated places. Reused the full `renderPresPanel()` the already-built (if unreachable) `data-pres-cycle-enable` handler had already established as the right call for exactly this cross-cutting change, rather than trying to out-engineer a scoped patch for a rare, deliberate action — flagged in a code comment so a future reader doesn't assume this was an oversight of the "never fall through to a full render" rule.
- **One new click-handler block** in `phCycClick`, `data-cyc-menopause`/`data-cyc-trackcycle`, right after the existing Cycle-page-footer block (length/Regular-Irregular/Contraception) it sits beside; a `presSavedToast` confirms either direction ("Marked as menopause — her cycle is no longer tracked" / "Tracking her cycle again").
- Verified live via a scratch dev-server preview + real function calls on a synthetic patient (never a hand-typed stand-in, deleted after): the Menopause chip renders on the Cycle page footer for a 55F; flipping `cycleOn` false resolves `phPfSetFor` to `"meno"` and the Change of life card carries the "Tracking a cycle again?" chip; flipping it back true re-renders the real Cycle page footer with the Menopause chip still offered; the ordinary "period" card (shown while `cycleOn` is true) never carries the reciprocal chip. App booted with zero console errors (confirms no syntax break across the whole file).
- **Not exercised:** a real patient, her phone, a real tap through the delegated click handler (the write/render logic was exercised directly, not via a dispatched DOM click — this sandbox has no signed-in session to render the full chrome), a real screenshot.

## Photo organising redesign, increment 1: one-tap type-fix + date-fix on the Patient Photos grid (her 2026-10-19 "in photos organising, for both date and type, its currently not efficient or easy. the ui is not user friendly. improve - show 2 mocks", then "push it live"; build 20261019-1290000)
Full design process already run before this increment: investigation of both photo screens (the per-patient Photos tab and the whole-clinic Records → Photos page), a visual guide shown before asking, 8 clarifying questions across two rounds, two interactive mocks (Mock 1 "Tiles", Mock 2 "Comparison table"), and her explicit confirmation **"Both, as a switch (Recommended)"** — build both views as two switchable modes of the same photo data on both screens. Her 8 confirmed requirements: equal priority on TYPE and DATE friction; a direct one-tap type chip on every tile (tongue split into Natural/Flash/Sublingual/Side); a one-tap date-fix on every tile, not buried in Select mode; a calendar jump replacing the old max-2 FIFO date-chip picker on the Comparison table; a swap/reorder control for which side is "before"/"after" on the Comparison table; tongue grouped by shot everywhere, including Records → Photos' grouping; works on desktop and phone equally.
Given the very high concurrent-session churn on this one shared `index.html` (confirmed via `git log` — roughly a dozen unrelated builds landed from other sessions during this same investigation window), this increment is deliberately scoped to ONE complete, self-contained piece rather than the whole redesign in one unreviewed pass: the Patient Photos tab's grid tiles (requirements 3 and 4 only, on that one screen).
- **Two new per-tile controls, `phRenGalChipsHtml`/`phRenGalDateBtnHtml`**, added just above the rewritten `phRenGalTileHtml` (the By visit/By type grid tile builder; the Comparison table and Select mode are untouched, separate mechanisms): a type chip (tongue = the four shot sub-chips + "Tongue ▾" to unfold the full type list; any other kind = its own type chip, tap to unfold); a quiet 📅-icon date button opening a hidden native `<input type="date">` via `showPicker()` — the exact convention the Appointments dialog already established (a visible button calls `showPicker()`/`.click()` on a sibling hidden date input; a `change` listener, not `input`, does the write).
- **`phRenGalTileHtml`'s non-Select branch** is now a plain `<div class="ph-gal-tile">` wrapper (was a single `<button>`) holding a `.ph-gal-thumb` button (image + caption, same `data-ren-tl-open`/`-row`/`-patient` attributes as before), a `.ph-gal-fixrow` (the date-fix button), and the new chips. The Select-mode branch is byte-for-byte unchanged.
- **Four new click-handler branches** inserted into the existing delegated click handler right after `[data-gal-shot]`: `[data-gal-type-open]` (unfold/fold the type list on one tile, `phRenGalTypeOpen` view state), `[data-gal-type]` (relabel via the existing `phRenBulkPatch([id], key, fn)` helper, unmodified, reused exactly as the bulk/single write door it already is), `[data-gal-shot2]` (set/clear a tongue shot, same write door), `[data-gal-dateopen]` (opens the hidden date input). A new scoped `change` listener (placed near the other feature-scoped `change` listeners already in this file, not a new giant dispatcher) handles the date-input commit: validates against the same regex/range rules the existing bulk date-change panel uses, writes through `phRenBulkPatch`, repaints via `phRenPhotosSecRefresh(key)`.
- **Every write shows an Undo toast** (`presSavedToast`, with an `undo` function that reverses the exact write) and triggers a full gallery-section repaint so a photo that just moved groups (by type or by date) is never left stranded in its old grouping.
- **Toast-message bug caught before shipping, not after:** an early draft wrapped the toast message text in `esc()` (matching the habit everywhere else in the file that writes into `innerHTML`). Checked `presSavedToast`'s real implementation first — it sets `el.querySelector(".m").textContent = msg`, i.e. `textContent`, not `innerHTML` — so `esc()`-wrapping would have shown literal `&amp;`-style entities in the toast. Removed `esc()` from all three new toast calls, matching how every other toast call in the file already handles this.
- **Deliberately deferred to a later increment, disclosed rather than attempted blind:** the Comparison table's calendar-based date-column picker (still the old max-2 FIFO `phRenGalCmp` picker) and its before/after swap control; the whole Records → Photos redesign (its "By type" grouping mode still lumps all tongue shots into one combined group via `phRenTypeOf` rather than `phRenRowKeyOf` — confirmed the real, narrower gap there after re-reading `phRecPhotos*` in full: the per-tile type chips there already correctly split by shot, only the grouping mode doesn't; Records → Photos also has zero date-fixing mechanism anywhere, confirmed, unaddressed). Comparison-table per-cell type/date-fix controls are also not yet built.
- **Verified** via real IndexedDB reads/writes through the app's own production functions (`phRenPhotoPut`, `phRenPhotoDelete`, `phRenPhotosFor`, `phRenLoadPhotosFor`) on synthetic test data created and fully deleted afterward (no real Supabase account exists or was created in this sandbox, per the standing rule): a shot tap sets it, tapping the same shot again clears it; a type-fix changes `kind` and drops any stale `shot`; a date-fix validates and persists correctly; all three correctly trigger `phRenPhotosSecRefresh` so grouping-by-date/by-type is never stale after a write moves a photo between groups. Zero console errors at any point. Confirmed via `git diff --stat` that the change is isolated to these additions (115 insertions, 2 deletions in `index.html`) with nothing from a concurrent session swept in.
- **Not exercised:** a real patient, her phone, a real pixel screenshot (the sandbox's sign-in overlay blocks it — bounding-rect/`getComputedStyle` checks on markup injected into the real `#pharmacyPage` DOM were used instead, confirming the new CSS classes resolve and there is no overflow at 375px), a real tap dispatched through the live delegated click handler (the write functions were called directly, which exercises the same code the handler calls but not the event-matching `closest()` logic itself).

## Dispense label preview: the collapsed window cut off before the script (her 2026-10-19 screenshot of a patient's "LABEL" preview, "cant see script"; build 20261019-1310000)
Her screenshot: the desktop one-screen Dispense layout's collapsed label window (`.ph-dsp-win`, inside `.ph-dsp-lbl`/`.ph-dsp-fit`) showed only "Date: ... - $23.10 (incl. GST)" and "Use Before: ...Patient: a patient" — nothing past it, so she could not see the actual prescription (the formula name + herb ingredients, i.e. "the script") without tapping "⤢ read it all" every time.
- **Root cause, traced against the real label template:** `PH_LABEL_DEFAULT_TEMPLATE`'s line order is Date/price (1) → Use Before (2) → blank (3) → Patient (4) → **Formula Objective (5)** → blank (6) → **ingredients (7+)** → blank → Total/Dosage/Take-days. The old `.ph-dsp-win` was a fixed `height: 44px` at `font: 500 var(--fs-11)/1.45` (line-height ≈ 15.95px) — about 2.76 lines, enough for Date and Use Before (and a sliver of Patient) but never reaching Formula Objective or a single ingredient line. Confirmed this is a pure CSS truncation issue, not missing/empty data: the template order itself guarantees the script is always further down than 44px can show.
- **Fix:** `height: 44px` → `height: 150px` (≈8 visible lines at the same font/line-height) — now reliably shows through Date, Use Before, Patient, **Formula Objective**, and the first 1-2 ingredient lines before the existing fade + "⤢ read it all" take over for the rest. Confirmed safe against the page's "one screen, no page scroll" promise: `.ph-pres-col-right` (the column holding the label block) has `height: auto` with no scroll of its own, but the sibling herb table (`.ph-sheet-herbs`, `flex: 1 1 0`, already documented in this file as "the ONE scroller" for that column) is the element designed to absorb a size change — growing the label block just trims a row or two off the herb table's own already-scrollable area, never breaks the no-page-scroll frame.
- **Locked STEP 4 respected:** her 2026-10-01 rule — "what's on screen and what gets copied must be identical, character for character" — was not touched by this fix: the window still renders the exact same `presLabelFinalize()` string in the exact same order, just more of it before the fade; nothing was reordered or restructured to put "important stuff first."
- Verified via a synthetic `.ph-dsp-fit`/`.ph-dsp-win` node (matching the real template's line order: Date, Use Before, blank, Patient, Formula Objective, blank, 6 ingredient lines, blank, Total, Dosage, Take-days — 16 lines total) injected into the real `#pharmacyPage` DOM at `window.matchMedia("(min-width: 901px)")` true, with the real CSS applied (not a reimplementation): `getComputedStyle` confirms the new rule resolves to `height: 150px; overflow: hidden`, and the computed line-height (15.95px) times the visible inner height works out to 8 full lines on screen — reaching well past Formula Objective into the ingredients, exactly the fix's goal.
- **Not exercised:** a real patient, her phone (this layout is desktop-only, `presDspFit` gates on `window.innerWidth > 900`, so no phone check applies), a real screenshot of the signed-in Dispense page (the sign-in overlay blocks it, the documented sandbox limitation — verified via computed style on an injected node instead).

- **Exact existing doors reused, no new ones:** a zone with a photo on file carries `data-ren-tl-open`/`data-ren-tl-row`/`data-ren-tl-patient` (identical attribute names `phFbbPhotoBoxHtml` already prints); a zone with none carries `data-ren-cap-type`/`data-ren-cap-patient`/`data-ren-cap-name` (same). **No new click-dispatch wiring was added at all** -- confirmed by reading the big document-level delegated click handler: its `data-ren-tl-open` branch (~line 38052, calls the real `phRenViewPhoto`) and its `data-ren-cap-type` branch (~line 37794, calls the real `phRenCaptureStart`) both sit earlier in that one handler than `phRenTabClick`'s own call (~line 39014), so a tap on any zone is caught and fully handled before it would ever reach `phRqClick`/`phRenTabClick`. `phRqClick`'s own `[data-rq-card]` dispatch (`data-rq-look`/`-none`/`-next`/etc.) was not touched or extended.

## Ren "His build" figure: signs drawn as they look (her 2026-10-19 "make this chart more visually accurate of the ren signs -- show mock"; mock `ren-figure-looks-mock-2026-10-19.html`; LIVE on main)
Her screenshot: a man's Ren figure filtered to "Shen Qi Wan only", ghost numbered dots on a plain body. Her 4 popup picks (all the Recommended option, do not re-ask): **A · draw the sign** (each sign is drawn as it looks, named on tap or hover, never printed call-out labels, that was B); a family expects a sign she has not ticked = **a dashed outline + a dashed ring**; **real proportions** (the build words change the body's regional widths, not one even stretch); **age = a small "Age N" tag by the head** (no hair). One base word sets the width (emaciated .76, thin .86, slim .93, heavy build 1.2, full-figured 1.14, robust 1.12, robust firm 1.12, slightly heavy 1.08, soft / loose 1.03), then regional modifiers: large upper body +.22 around the chest, thin legs -.2 below the hips, toned muscle +.05 at the shoulders and thighs, soft muscle +.04 at the belly; the head barely changes (x.15) and the feet half (x.5). **A measured build (height and weight typed, `phBodyBuild`) is the base and wins over a base word; the modifiers still add their regional shape on top.** No build words and no measured build = the old plain figure. **All widths are DRAFT, hers to correct.** Retired: the old `buildKey` -> one even `sx` table.
- **Drawn as they look** (inside the skin clip, above the anatomy, under the tap rings): red / dark / sallow / pale / puffy face tint (the face fill opacity follows the tone), a soft shadow under each eye for dark eye sockets (`${u}-blur2`), a puffy lid above and below the eye for swelling around the eyes, lips in the ticked colour (pale gets a faint edge, red or swollen are fuller), hollow cheeks and visible collarbones and ribs for emaciated, definition lines for toned muscle, dark or purple spots over the body (both views), blue cold hands and feet (gradient `${u}-cold`, both views), swollen ankles with a pit (both views), a raised navel area with the navel drawn (`${u}-bulge`), a sagging lower belly (`${u}-sag`), tight lower-belly lines, and a bloated belly now drawn as a rounded bulge. `PH_REN_LOOK` lists the signs that have such a drawing: a `PH_REN_DRAW` row whose ticked signs are ALL in it draws only a thin tap ring (no glow), so the picture is the mark; any sign not in the set keeps its glow. **A sign drawn here should be added to `PH_REN_LOOK`; a sign added to the set that is NOT drawn would lose its only mark.** Signs with no ring of their own (dark spots, toned, emaciated) carry `class="rf-part" data-rf-name` on the picture itself so a tap still names them.
- **Expected but not ticked** (only while a herb family is picked, like the ghost marks): a **dashed outline in that family's colour**, drawn from the build words the picked family weighs at 3 or more that she has not ticked (every unticked modifier, and the strongest base word only when she ticked no base word), tap or hover names it ("Expected build, not ticked yet: large upper body, thin legs · Shen Qi Wan"). The existing dashed ring and numbered badge stay for the other unticked signs. **MY reading of "dashed label": the dashed outline carries its name on tap, no printed text; say so if she meant a visible dashed text label.**
- **Age tag** `Age N` (`phAgeOf(rec.dob)`, only when `age_middle_elderly` is on), a white pill by the head on the front view, no tap.
- Tested in the sandbox with a synthetic in-memory patient (never saved) through the real `phRenFigureParts` / `phRenFigureHtml` / `phRenExpandHtml`: man, woman, sex not set, front and back, every drawing above, the Shen Qi Wan filter with the dashed expected outline, a measured build base, no console errors. **NOT exercised:** a real patient, her phone, a real tap.

**Pulse, how it is saved.** `rec.constitPulse = { pulse, pulseRef, hammer, at, hist }` is the ONE live chart; the dated copy lives in `rec.visitFnd[sessionId].pulse / pulseRef / hammer`, filled by `phExamMirrorToday` (same-day sessions only, and only once `phTodayDonePart(rec, "pulse")`, which reads `at`). Two things were wrong, both fixed:
- **Every write dates the chart.** `phHxConstitPulse(rec)` is the ONLY write door (grid, referred chips, every Shen-Hammer tick, the rate box); it stamps `p.at = Date.now()`. Before, only a grid tap stamped it, so a referred / Hammer / rate tick saved but was never "examined today" and never filed into the visit (the rate handler now also calls `phExamMirrorToday`).
- **A new day starts blank, last time dashed.** A chart last written on an EARLIER day is "stale" (`phHxConstitPulseStale`: `at` before today and it has marks, referred or Hammer content). The page then shows it BLANK with the last earlier-day chart dashed in its cells and a key line "Dashed · 19 Oct" (`phPulsePrior`: a visit's dated copy, an archived chart, or the stale live chart; read side, nothing written). The first write of the new day moves the stale chart into `p.hist` (kept, never deleted) and starts a blank one, so yesterday's marks are never filed as today's finding. **Render functions never mutate**: `phHxConstitPulseRead` is the read door.
- **Readers that follow `hist` (and the stale live chart, so a reader answers the same before and after today's first tap):** `phExamPast` (the history line, days with no visit row), `phVisitPrevPulse`, `phFbrChartWords` (Fang Bing Ren pulse words when no filed visit is newer), `phTsExamHist` (the Treatment table's pulse history), `phTodaySumPart` (a stale chart is "Nothing recorded", not today's finding). `phPulseHistLatest(rec)` returns the live chart while stale, else the newest archived one. A new reader of "the last pulse chart" must go through these, never `rec.constitPulse` alone.
- **My reading, disclosed:** "blank each day" was built because she said "fix them all" after I had offered to mock it first; she has not seen it. If she wanted last time to carry over as a starting point instead of dashed, change `phHxConstitPulseHtml`'s `p` line and `phHxConstitPulse`'s archive step together.
**Abdomen exam page.** (1) The Tension row is ALWAYS the whole abdomen (`data-visit-abd2="tension:<v>"`, tap again clears; it fills every zone). Tapping a zone adds a second row **Zone** (`tensionAt:<v>`, only that zone), and the region line's "whole abdomen" link became a **Done** chip. The old rule "a second different tension arms a brush" is gone (a zone is set on the Zone row); a brush for marks (water, gas ...) is unchanged. **My reading of "tension is all over", disclosed, open to her correction.** (2) The chart is bigger: viewBox is now `20 0 80 150` (the trunk is only x 27-93, so the old 120-wide box was half empty), the exam chart is 250 x 470 desktop / 170 x 319 phone (was 280 x 350 / 150 x 188), names read 9-12px. Every OTHER place keeps its old height and loses the dead width (86 x 162, 56 x 105, mini 29 x 55). The neutral zone fills are paler so a "soft" reading shows against them (`ROWFILL`). (3) Temp / Sounds / Feel bars were clipping their labels when the right column narrowed: they are now `.ph-tng2-seg.wrap` (one joined box that wraps, dividers = each chip's left and bottom edge, the wrapper's -1px margins hide the box edge doubling).
- Tested in the sandbox (preview + synthetic patients, nothing saved): pulse stale -> blank + dashed + untouched record, grid tap / referred tap / rate tick each archive then stamp today, rate filed into today's visit, yesterday's visit copy untouched, readers agree before and after, no console errors; Abdomen at 1280 and 375 px (250x470 / 170x319, no sideways scroll, bars wrap with nothing outside), real clicks on the Tension and Zone chips. NOT exercised: a real patient, her phone, reduced motion on a real device. The Tongue and Abdomen standing charts probably carry over day to day the same way the pulse chart did (`rec.tongueExam`, `rec.abdomen.chart`): unchecked, unchanged.


## Session grid on a cycle plan: plan a phase by cycle days or a number of visits (her 2026-10-20 "this format is not working for me. i cant change that the treatment is once a week for menses", screenshot of the Care Plan Session grid with Menstruation open; LIVE on main, build 20261020-1520000)
Her screenshot: a cycle plan's open phase (Menstruation, CD 1-5) offered only 1x/wk, 2x/wk, Fortnightly, Monthly, so "once a week" could not be changed to a day or a visit count a 5-day phase can use. Four questions, all her picks (do not re-ask): Menstruation gets BOTH "specific cycle days" (tap CD chips, squares dated from her real period) AND "a number of visits" (a - N + stepper, no weekly rhythm); applies to EVERY phase of a cycle plan (follicular, ovulation, two-week wait too); a non-cycle plan keeps the four weekly choices unchanged; the pills wrap to two rows (all choices visible, one tap), not a dropdown.
- **The cadence string stays the one truth.** A cycle-day plan is `phase.cadence = "CD 3, 5 acupuncture · herbs"` (`phTpCadenceCompose(0, "cd", forWhat, null, cds)`) and `phase.sessions = cds.length` (`phTpCadenceCdList`, `phTpSessionsOf`). The Treatment tab and Communications already read "CD ..." lists; nothing new is stored. `phTpRhKeyOf` is null for a CD list, so the rhythm pills show none picked.
- **Cycle days exist only where `phTpCdCtx(name, plan)` gives a window** (Natural fertility, PCOS, Endometriosis, Dysmenorrhea with a tracked cycle and a logged period; the same gate as the CD chips). `phTpPlanCdAvail(cdx, ph)` = the window's days; `gone` = today's CD is inside the window and the day is already past (dimmed, disabled, "Already passed this cycle"). `phTpCdDates(name, cds, from, after, count)` dates a CD list from `rec.cycle.lmp + c*cycleLen + cd - 1`, this cycle or the next (a window entirely past reads the next cycle: tested, CD 1 on 23 Oct with the LMP 28 Sep is Mon 26 Oct). `phTpCdSpread(days, n)` = n visits spread evenly down the days (`days[floor(i*L/n)]`, n clamped 1..L, so a one-day window gives one visit however many squares are tapped).
- **Pills** (`phTpSessionLadderHtml`): one joined wrapping box (`.ph-tng2-seg.wrap`, chips get their left + bottom divider) using the whole phase cell; **Cycle days** is the fifth pill and shows only when the phase has a window. Two rows from a ~165px cell up, three rows below that (a 375px phone or a narrow Course column), never clipped. A phase of a week or less with no rhythm of its own previews **cycle days** by default; a phase with its own rhythm (a follicular template's 1x/wk) keeps it and she taps Cycle days.
- **Open phase, Cycle days:** a panel row under it (`tr.dd.cdp`, `phTpPlanCdOpenHtml`): "Cycle day" chips (`data-tp-plan-cd`, picked = solid, draft in `phTpPlanUi.cd`, view state), a "Visits" stepper (`data-tp-plan-cdn`, spreads that many down the open days) and the page's one solid "Plan" button (`data-tp-plan-cdgo`, `phTpPlanCommit(..., "cd", n, cds)`). Tapping a dashed slot commits the draft's first N days, else N spread. "Same for all phases" is hidden in this mode (cycle days belong to one phase). **Planned phase:** the dropdown's "Other..." panel has the same Cycle days segment; chips and stepper write at once (`phTpPlanWrite({cd})`), the planned pill reads `CD 3, 5` (up to four days) or `CD a-b · n`. Undo (the one toast) restores cadence and sessions.
- **Dating:** `phTpSessionCells` dates a CD cadence's next squares from `phTpCdDates` (after the last real visit, strictly increasing), not by stepping 7 days; `phTpPlanSlotDates` does the same for the preview. A "1 visits" label now reads "1 visit".
- **CSS** by the `.ph-tpg-rhs` rules: `.ph-tpg-rhs { display: block }`, `.ph-tng2-seg.wrap .ph-tpg-p3.rh` (padding 2px 5px, nowrap), `.seg.cdd button`, `.gone`. No new animation, no new media query.
- **Disclosed:** the default to Cycle days applies only to a phase of 7 days or less with no rhythm of its own; "Same for all phases" does not take cycle days; `phTpProjectedVisitsForCds` (Treatment tab projections) was left as it was and still skips days up to today.
- Tested in the sandbox (preview + a synthetic Natural fertility patient, 1280 / 700 / 560 / 480 / 375 px, deleted after): pills wrap two rows at 620px and up and never clip; chip toggles, stepper spread (3 -> CD 6, 8, 10; 4 -> CD 6, 7, 9, 11), Plan commit, planned squares and dates (~23 / ~24 / ~26 / ~28 Oct), toast + Undo, slot-tap commit, the planned phase's Other... panel writing at once, a next-cycle window, a Neck & shoulder plan unchanged (four pills, no Cycle days, Same for all + Undo), no console errors. NOT exercised: a real patient, her phone, the Treatment tab's own copy of the grid, reduced motion on a real device.

## To Order: the desktop board is 3 columns, animated (her 2026-10-20 "improve this design ui. it has the features i need but its not easy to read, not spaced out well, and needs interactive animated elements to improve workflow. make mock"; mock `order-board-mocks-2026-10-20.html`; commit e49cdda6 on `session-a`, LIVE on main (its tree reached origin/main via its pre-amend sibling 0dbef951, pushed by a concurrent session; the CLAUDE.md note followed on her "push live" 2026-10-20), build 20261020-1530000)
Scope = the desktop To Order board only (`renderPhRestock`, `isDesk = window.innerWidth > 900`). The phone layout (<=900px: `osmRow` / `osmBand` / `osmSupGroups`, the phone `shellHtml` with its stat strip) is BYTE-FOR-BYTE untouched, her explicit pick. Mock approved, **her 8 picks (all Recommended + the drag option):** 1 Layout **A - Rows**; 2 **remove the stat strip** on desktop (the counts move into the column heads); 3 **fill the window** (the three columns stretch to the viewport, each scrolls inside its own `--ph-osb-h` height, the page itself barely scrolls); 4 **+ Add to order in the Needs-ordering head** (`phOsAddPick`, a search box that slides the herb into the list); 5 motion = **Arrived flies across** (the row lifts, a ghost clone slides to the top of Arrived and lands with a gold wash, the head counts + money roll; "All arrived" staggers 140 ms apart) + **jar and bar fill in on landing** (0.7 s, the % counts up) + **Add slides into the list** + **drag a row between columns** (mouse; the buttons still work); 6 **drop the supplier dot**; 7 **two lines, as the mock**; 8 **one toast with Undo** (`presSavedToast`).
- **Three columns:** **Needs ordering** (To order grouped by supplier + Running low merged in, same action, + the Snoozed strip, the gold cover-% bar), **On the way** (grouped by supplier, Copy for email / All arrived / per-card Arrived, the bottle-count fact), **Arrived** (last 14 days, "+N older, not yet settled" reveal, never drops anything). Rows `.ph-osb-row.{low|toorder|ordered|arrived|snz}[data-ph-os-row=id][data-ph-os-drag="id:stage"]`; colbodies `.ph-osb-colbody[data-ph-os-drop=toorder|ordered|arrived]`; heads `[data-osb-n]` / `[data-osb-money]`.
- **Every existing interaction reuses its own `data-ph-*` attribute**, moved from a `<table>` row into a `<div>` card -- no handler change for mark ordered / arrived, the Refill / status menus, snooze, supplier picker, copy-for-email, bulk mark/arrived, arrival edit/undo. New engine: `phOsbMove(ids, to, srcRows)` (write FIRST via `phOsbWrite`, then the fly animation, then a scoped `renderPhRestock` + scroll the landed row into its colbody), `phOsbFillIn` (the jar `.ph-os-jar .fill` scaleY from pWas/pNow + `.ph-stockbar-fill` width + `.ph-level-pct` count-up), `phOsbRolls` / `phOsbRoll` (head counts + money), `phOsbFit` (the `--ph-osb-h` column height from the board top and the footer) / `phOsbTween`, `phOsAddPick`.
- **Motion engine, guarded:** `phOsbTween` short-circuits in a hidden tab and carries a `setTimeout(ms + 80)` guard so the counts always settle even when rAF barely fires; everything is off under `phTpReduceMotion()` (the reduced-motion CSS covers `.ph-osb-row.glow`, `.ph-osb-rw.gone`, `.ph-osb-fly`, `.ph-osb-exp`, `.ph-osb-colbody`, `.ph-osb-lvl .ph-stockbar-fill`); the data write is `phOsbWrite` / `phArrive(list, {noRender:true})` (the new `opts.noRender`) and never waits on an animation. Flies append to `#pharmacyPage`, not `<body>`.
- **Disclosed judgment calls:** (1) "All arrived" on a supplier group moves only that group's ORDERED rows -- `herbNeedsOrder` ignores `h.ordered`, so the shared handler would otherwise sweep the supplier's still-to-order herbs into Arrived; the board path filters `h.ordered` (the phone path is unchanged). (2) "Back to To order" keeps the herb's existing order date (`orderOn` is only stamped when it newly joins the list). (3) the To-order row buttons are outlined per the mock; the "Order now" red-lined button (`.red`) shows only on a zero jar (zero = `--ph-zero`, the status red, never gold). (4) columns 2 and 3 get a plain static accent strip, not a live percentage bar (there is no honest "on the way" / "arrived" percentage; only Needs ordering has the real cover %).
- **Tested** in the sandbox (preview at 1280 and 1600 px, synthetic stamps on `PHARMACY.herbs`, restored from a full `zz-osb-snap` snapshot after, viewport reset): the board height fills to the footer with no page scroll, each column scrolls inside; a single Arrived flies and lands in Arrived with the glow, the jar fills to 100% (verified end to end: inline `transform: scaleY(1)` with the 0.7 s cubic transition, pWas 20% -> pNow 100% count-up, "+200g" toast, row class `arrived glow`) and the On-the-way bottle-count fact reads right; "All arrived" staggers; "Mark all ordered"; "Order now" on a low row; drag (dropok on the allowed columns, dropno otherwise); "+ Add to order"; reduced motion (immediate repaint, no flies); Undo on every path restores the data and the log; no new console errors. The earlier "jar fill-in did not animate" note was a stale / concurrent-render-disturbed reading -- a clean run animates correctly (the `.ph-os-jar .fill` selector matches; the `scaleY(0.2)` a getComputedStyle reports is an SVG `transform-box: view-box` quirk, the inline `scaleY(1)` is what paints and the fill rect renders full `height=16`).
- **NOT exercised:** a real patient, her real stock, her phone (desktop only), a real mouse drag, reduced motion on a real device, a 3-column board at the widest width with several real suppliers in one On-the-way group.

- **Which region the diagram shows** = `phMskDgReg` (view state): `phMskDgRegFor(list)` normalises it on EVERY `phPainMapHtml` render (the first pain's region unless the current one is still on the map, so a removed pain can never leave a stale region). A tap on a pain row (`tr.ph-pm-tr[data-mk-reg]`, read by `phMskDgFollow` from the pain-map click handler when the box sits in `[data-msk-pain]`) swaps the diagram in place (`phMskDgRefresh(true)`: only `[data-mk-dg]` is repainted, `.swap` = `mkDgSwap` .3s, added only on a change). `phMskDgSync` recolours the bellies (`.on`, `aria-pressed`) in the page AND an open Enlarge clone after every plan write.

## Profile search: a box in the patient header band (her 2026-10-20 "include a search box so i can quickly search inside profile e.g. surgery pain etc"; mock `profile-search-mock-2026-10-20.html`, her "make mock" then 8 popup picks; LIVE on main)
**Her 8 picks (do not re-ask):** (1) both: typing drops a results list under the header grouped by page; tapping a row opens its page, marks every match and rings that line, and a find strip (`‹ n of N ›`, page chips, ✕) steps through the rest; (2) it searches everything: Came in for, pain table, surgeries, history and notes, visits / re-checks, plan text, Fang Bing Ren signs, supplements, bloods, photos; (3) related words count (surgery finds arthroscopy / repair; pain finds aching / sharp) and the related word is the one marked; (4) desktop: the field is always in the band beside the camera and grows on focus (230 to 360px); (5) phone: a magnifier disc opens a full-width box in place of the name; (6) the rail shows a match count per page while searching, gone when cleared; (7) keyboard: `/` jumps to the box, up / down walk results, Enter opens, Esc closes the panel then clears, Enter steps to the next match once a page is open (Shift+Enter back); (8) result groups run in rail order (File, Exam, Plan, Log).
- **Where:** `#presPanel` only (a patient script, not a formula). Field = `phPsFieldHtml()` in the band template of `renderPresPanelCore`, results `#phPsRes`, find strip `#phPsFind`, both children of the band; `phPsAfterRender()` runs at the end of that render. The block sits just above `renderPresPanel`: `PH_PS_ALIAS` (related words), `PH_PS_GROUPS`, `phPsBuild` (one `add(pages, group, text, meta, alias, ringText)` per indexed fact), `phPsIndex` / `phPsMatches` / `phPsRenderRes` / `phPsRenderFind` / `phPsBadges` / `phPsMark` / `phPsRingApply` / `phPsNavigate`, and delegated input / focus / click / capture-phase keydown listeners. **Nothing is ever saved**; state is module vars (`phPsS` keyed by the open script) because the band is rebuilt on every panel repaint.
- **Pages** come from the rail itself (`phPsPages`, keys `p:<id>` profile, `g:<id>` plan page, `s:<stage>`). Plan-dependent pages (Musculoskeletal, Tongue, Pulse, Abdomen, Ask her, Cycle, Timeline) only exist once a plan is open, so each item carries a candidate list `pg` ending in an always-present fallback (the pain table is `["g:msk","g:plan"]`), `it.page` = the first one in the rail now, and the id is hashed from `pg[0]` so a result keeps its name when the rail gains pages.
- **Marks and ring:** `mark.ph-ps-mark` on every text match (a MutationObserver re-applies them after any repaint, debounced 70 ms, `takeRecords()` after its own writes), `.ph-ps-ring` (2px `--ph-herb`) on the line the tapped result came from, found by its own text with the commas / spaces stripped (a page that splits points into chips has no contiguous text), climbing out to the whole line; the pain table rings its row's first cell (`reg` = the pain's region, `tr.ph-pm-tr[data-mk-reg]`); a plan phase that is not open shows only its name, so the ring lands on the phase name (`it.alt`). Scroll is the least amount, below the band.
- **Pinned while a search is on:** the panel's `overflow: hidden` made it the band's scroll container, so the sticky band never pinned. While the query has words (`.ph-ps-pin`) the panel uses `overflow: clip; display: flow-root` (scoped with `:has(.ph-pres-band.ph-ps-pin)`, not on the one-screen Dispense), so the box, results and find strip stay in view. Clearing the search (✕) puts the band back to its normal, non-sticky self.
- **Phone:** inside the one 640px block: the field is a 28px gold-ringed disc; the find strip is count + stepper on the first row and the page chips scroll sideways on the second (a single-page search hides the chip bar), so the pinned strip is about 84px and the band about 134px.
- **Disclosed:** `rec.medicalHistoryNotes` (the free-text notes) is NOT searched: no box shows it since the dead-code sweep, so a hit would land on nothing. The first Pain-table tap before a plan is open lands on the Care Plan figure (that table only has its own page once a plan is open). A phase's text that is not on screen is reached by its name. Related words are a small draft list (`PH_PS_ALIAS`), hers to correct.
- **Trap met:** the CSS block was swept into another session's commit before this one (HEAD briefly held the styles with no script); this commit carries the script, the band markup and the last CSS edits.
- Tested in the sandbox preview (synthetic patient "Zz Search Test", deleted after) at 1440 and 375: results grouped and counted, rail badges, a tap opens its page and rings one line, the stepper walks every match, retyping while scrolled keeps the band, Esc order, no console errors; a sweep of every result for four queries (18 + 11 + 3 + 7 hits) leaves exactly one ringed line each. **NOT exercised:** a real patient, a real phone, reduced motion on a real device, photo and blood results (the synthetic patient has none).

## Old acupuncture points cleared from her saved template copies (her 2026-10-21 "yes clear old acu points"; commit be4b5b5b, PUSHED LIVE with Build 4 on her "push live", build 20261021-1600000)
Follows [the built-in Points emptying of 2026-10-20, `4ae54304`]: her own edits of the built-in templates (`tpTemplateOverrides` copies whole `phases`) and her own saved templates (`tpTemplates`) still carried the old points, and she answered yes to clearing them.
- **`phMigrateTemplatePointsClear`** (boot IIFE beside `phMigrateLabelObjectiveLine`): runs once. Empties `points` on every phase of an override whose edit stamp (`tpTemplateOverridesAt[id]`) is older than the cut-off (a stamp of NOW is written, so the cloud merge's newer-edit-wins keeps the cleared copy) and of a saved template whose id's embedded base-36 timestamp (`uid()`) is older than the cut-off. **Nothing she types after the build ships is touched**: a newer stamp or a newer id is skipped. `pressPoints`, Aim, Watch and every other field stay; plans already made keep their points; the built-ins were already empty.
- **Flag and backup in one:** `PHARMACY.tpPointsCleared = { at, templates, phases, was: { "<templateId or user:<id>>": [[phase label, removed text], ...] } }`. Set only when the device holds at least one override or saved template (an empty new device stays unflagged so a later cloud pull of old copies is still cleared). `mergeTemplateOverrides` or-merges it like `tpTemplateOverridesMigrated`. One toast on the first boot says how many were cleared ("Old points cleared · 2 templates, 2 phases"); nothing shows when there was nothing to clear.
- **Disclosed:** a stale device that is not updated yet and wins a whole-blob conflict can bring old copies back with their old stamps; the flag then blocks a second clear on that device (restore from a backup file re-runs it, as the restored data has no flag). `PHARMACY.tpPointsCleared` carries the removed text, so a mistake is recoverable by hand from the data until she deletes it.
- Tested in the preview with seeded made-up data: an old override cleared (pressPoints and other fields kept, stamp refreshed), a newer-edit override left alone, an old saved template cleared, a new-id saved template left alone, flag + backup written, toast shown, no console errors.

## + Watch / + Aim go through the Watch / Aim write door (the 2026-10-21 docs audit's "Known gap", first flagged in "Care Plan = the findings beside the plan"; commit 74f57e02, LIVE on main via d7593be9, build 20261021-1630000)
Before: `phTpFxAddToggle` appended "<Finding>: <phrase>" to the raw stored `ph.watch` / `ph.aim`. Since "Watch and Aim write themselves from the patient" the stored text of an auto field is only the template's, so one tap made the field read as hers (frozen) with the red flags and the new line only, and the auto chips were gone.
- **Now** (`phTpFxAddToggle`, block "+ Watch / + Aim: adds (or takes off)"): starts from what she sees, `phTpFieldText(name, plan, ph, which)` (= `phTpFieldView(...).text`), adds or removes the segment, and writes through `phTpFieldCommit`. A failed save and Undo put back the exact stored text AND the `watchHers` / `aimHers` mark (present or absent, `snap` / `put`); Undo finds the phase by its id (it used to take whichever phase was live at Undo time) and rolls itself back if its own save fails. Toast, fly (`phTpFxFly`) and repaint (`phTpPlanRepaint`) as before.
- **The button's ✓** (`phTpFxRowHtml`) reads `phTpFieldText` for the live phase, not raw `ph.watch` / `ph.aim`. **"↺ back to auto"** (`phTpFieldBackToAuto`) now also calls `phTpFxRefreshAll()`, so the drawer's ✓ goes back to + with the field.
- **(Superseded the same day by "+ Watch / + Aim: her own lines on top of the auto field", below.)** **Decision, disclosed: a + Watch / + Aim makes the field hers** (she chose it). The auto text she saw at that moment (red flags and every chip) is kept as her text with the finding added, and the cell shows "↺ back to auto". Consequences: (1) while hers the field no longer follows the patient (a "Day 12, follicular" chip stays as written, a new complaint adds no chip); back to auto brings the live chips back and drops her added lines; (2) the Treatment tab shows her text as plain chips split at commas (`phAcuWatchChips`), without the Red flag / Main / Also / Cycle tags, the same as any Watch she types; (3) taking her last pick off returns the field to auto only while the rest still matches the auto text (`phTpFieldCommit`'s rule); if the auto text has moved on (a new cycle day), it stays hers and back to auto is the way out. A field she typed herself stays hers through add, take off and Undo. Keeping the field auto with her picks as a separate list on top would need a new stored field and a change to the read; hers to decide.
- **Left alone on purpose:** `phTpFxColInner` and `phTpFxPhaseTint` (a concurrent session reworked both on 2026-10-21; the tint now follows the template's "Looks at" and no longer reads the Aim / Watch text).
- **Pages checked (★★★):** Care Plan (Watch and Aim cells, the findings drawer's ✓), Treatment tab Watch chips (`phAcuWatchItems`), the print doc (`phTpPlanDocHtml`), the spine row / letter text (`phTpWatchFixedText`); Today's visit shows no Watch (unchanged).
- Tested in the sandbox preview (synthetic "Zz Wa Fix", Natural fertility plan on Follicular week 1, main + secondary complaint, cycle day 12; deleted after, sandbox left empty): auto Watch (red flags + Main + Also + Cycle) → + Watch keeps all four and adds "Came in for: Trying to conceive", ✓ Watch, back-to-auto chip, toast with Undo; take off → auto (template text stored, no `watchHers`); Undo of the take-off → hers exactly; Undo of an add → auto exactly; back to auto → + Watch; a typed Watch stays hers through add / take off / Undo; + Aim on an auto Aim → hers, take off → auto; a failed save (`savePharmacy` stubbed false) puts text and mark back with the fail toast; the fly element and the field's landing flash seen; 375px no sideways scroll; no console errors. **NOT exercised:** a real patient, her phone, reduced motion (`phTpFxFly` unchanged), a cloud sync between a tap and its Undo.

## 2026-10-21 · Concept pictures: one moving picture per pattern
Her ask: "include conceptual images/animations/diagrams e.g. blood stasis - clotted blood flow - show mock". Mock `concept-pictures-mock-2026-10-21.html` (9 pictures) plus a second inline mock of the 4 later drawings; her 8 popup picks (memory `project_pharmacy_concept_pictures_2026_10_21`) and "Yes, build it". Sandbox first.
- **Her picks:** in all four places (the body map close-up, the Care Plan Diagnosis, the Patterns page cards, the Guide study card); the body map shows the pattern HER signs at that place point to; style "flow + the pot"; a picture opens on the pattern, Balanced is a tap away; it moves gently, always (still under reduced motion); short labels, on the pattern side only; her own matching signs under it; **all 13 patterns, each its own picture** (not the reuse I offered).
- **The pictures** (`PH_PP`, one IIFE before `phPatCompute`, `PH_PP.SC[pattern id]`): two families so they read alike. FLOW: Blood stasis (cells back up and darken behind a clot, a stabbing spark; starts already backed up, `S.warm`), Blood deficiency (few pale cells, the tissue pales), Qi stagnation (qi knots and swells, stop-start), Qi deficiency (a weak push, qi sags), Damp / phlegm (slow heavy fluid, sludge, sticky globs, fog), Cold-damp (the pipe contracts, frost, damp pools, cramping). THE POT over the fire: Yang deficiency (fire low, water cold), Yin deficiency (water low, empty heat rises), Heat (fire high, boils over). Their own drawings: Kidney yang (the root fire between the kidneys, cold kidneys, clear urine often), Middle deficient cold (the stomach over a low middle fire, food sits, dull ache), Cold in the channels (cold tightens the vessel, blood can't reach the cold fingers), Plum-pit qi (qi circles a lump in the throat). ## Today's visit Compass: Fang Bing Ren signs as monitored rows (2026-10-22, BUILT on session-a, NOT pushed)
Her ask: "help improve todays visit so it integrates with chief complaints, complaints, signs and symptoms from ren fang bing etc are accessory symptoms to monitor". Mock `today-signs-mock-2026-10-22.html` (v2 is the contract), her 18 picks (memory `project_pharmacy_today_signs_compass_2026_10_22`), then "Yes, build it".
- **One table.** Complaint (its Goal under the name, tap to edit, ↺ auto kept) | Since | Today | Change | Note. Today = a slider with a number badge ("last N" until rated; a % box for any number on % better). Notes are kept for every visit: today's box, last visit's note faint under it, "+N" opens all (`phCxNoteCellHtml`, `phCxNotesBefore`). Gold "now asking" row + glance line ("Asked n of m · better · worse · gone"); keys 0-9 (1 then 0 = 10, % = 100), G B S W on a sign, ↓ skips (`phCxKeys` listener, `phCxAskSkip`). A tap on a complaint's name lights its chart line and points Quick assess at it (`phCxLitKey`/`phCxFocusFbr`, stored in `phFbrFocus`, so the Fang Bing Ren page's own bar agrees). The legend chips and Today's "Looking at" bar are gone.
- **Signs.** `phCxSignList(name, rec)` = Fang Bing Ren signs she ANSWERED: her own taps (Fang Bing Ren, Ask her, Quick assess), last visit's carried Bing ticks, intake form, usual answers, Medical history, cycle PMS log, signs rated before or pinned with "+ add". Never one the app only works out (Patterns clues, implied / linked / compound, charts, pain map, bloods, build / age / sex). A Bing / Ren twin pair is one row keyed by its Bing key. A sign sits under the complaint of the same subject, else under Other signs (my rule, hers to correct). Cap 2 per complaint / 6 other, "+ N more"; rated or pinned always show; Gone at two visits in a row leaves; Not watching (▾) puts it in a "Not watching" line with ↺. "Rest the same" fills unrated sign rows with Same. First visit: "rated from next visit".
- **Storage.** `rec.ccTrack.days[day].sx[signKey] = {v:"g|b|s|w", n, t}`, `ccTrack.sxOff[signKey] = day`, `ccTrack.sxPin[signKey] = {cc, at}`. Only `phCxWrite` writes them (its tidy now keeps `sx`; before it deleted unknown buckets).
- **Gone → Fang Bing Ren.** `phCxGoneToday` (a Gone rated after her last Yes tap on that sign, read from `rec.tri.audit`) turns today's Bing tick off in `phTriEffective` / `phTriAutoWhy` / `phNqState` (Quick assess counts it answered). A Yes tap after the Gone puts it back. Ren is never touched. `phTriRefresh` repaints the Compass once (guard `phCxTriBusy`); a rating repaints Fang Bing Ren through `phCxTriSync`.
- **Energy.** A complaint about energy or fatigue (`phCxIsEnergy`: words fatigue / energy / tired / exhaust, or the "Weight & energy" family label) is scored by the am · pm · ev bars under its row (`phEnergyLineHtml(name, {inRow:true})`), 10 = best, no chart line; the standalone Energy line stays only when there is no such complaint. `fatigue_now` / `fatigue_tend` get no sign row then. `phCxEnergyMain` / `phCxEnergyChg` / `phCxMainChange` keep "n of m done", the Treatment Response and the Re-check mirror working for an energy MAIN complaint.
- **Order.** Drag ⋮⋮ (desktop) or ▾ Move up / down writes `rec.complaint.secondary` (`phCxReorder`), so Came in for, the Care Plan Goal and `phase.symptoms` follow; MAIN stays first.
- **Treatment tab.** The Subjective table is replaced by one read-only "Today's ratings" line (`phTsRatingsLineHtml`; the her-words box stays); Watch = the template's Red flags only (`phAcuWatchItems`); "Apply the usual" and its handler are gone; the Log saves today's sign ratings as `session.subj` (Gone = `o:"better", gone:true`); the Visit record's Ask lists them. Old "s:" Subjective drafts are dropped on restore. Dead code left in place on purpose: `phTsSubjHtml`, `phTsSubjRows`, `phTsCycleRowsHtml`, `phTsSinceSet` and the `phTsClick` branches that fed them.
- **Goal and letter.** `phCcSecAll` returns her typed complaints only (the auto Fang Bing Ren "complaints" are gone from the Goal, `phase.symptoms` and the card). `phCcSeedSymptoms` seeds complaints + the Compass's visible sign rows (`ccKey "x:<signKey>"`), in her order; an untouched seeded sign row (or old `fbr:` row) leaves when the Compass no longer shows it, a row she wrote on stays. `phTpSymSummary` prints complaints, then " — and with them <signs>"; the letter's "Watching:" line carries it. **That wording is DRAFT, to show her before it ships.**
- **Pages checked for the changed facts:** Today's visit (Compass, Quick assess, "n of m done"), Fang Bing Ren (ticks, Looking at), Treatment tab (Today's ratings, Watch, Log), Care Plan (Goal, Spine "Symptoms:", letter line), Came in for order. Not opened: Patterns, Dispense, Messages, print.
- **Tested** (sandbox harness, seeded patient, real functions and real clicks through the click router): render at 1000px, 549px and 360px; first visit and return visit; Better / Gone / same-cell-again; Gone vs a later tap (both orders); slider, % by tens and the % box; keys 0-9, G B S W, ↓, `1` then `0`; reorder by ▾ and by `phCxReorder`; "+ add" search with arrows + Enter; Make it a complaint; Not watching and back; note per day; seed of `phase.symptoms`, the summary and the Goal; the Treatment ratings line. **Not exercised:** a real patient, a real drag with the mouse, real touch on her phone, the Treatment tab and the Log screens on screen, the letter PDF.
- **Disclosed calls (mine, hers to correct):** a sign sits under the complaint with the same subject; an exam / lab / build / age / sex sign never gets a row; a tapped sign still gets one; the "Weight & energy" label counts as an energy complaint; the Treatment "Cycle - reported, not examined" rows left with the Subjective table (the Cycle page is their home); the letter's sign names read "Subject: wording".

## 2026-10-22 · Concept pictures round 2, build 2 (batch 1): the nine women's health plan conditions
Same ask as build 1 ("design more animations for health conditions"); her picks in memory `project_pharmacy_concept_pictures_round2_2026_10_22` (mock = artifact `women-mock.html`, **mock = build**; every answer was "as mocked"). Batch 2 onward (pain / MSK, face / skin, stress / sleep / weight / immune / men's: 20 more) is not built; each batch is mocked first.
- **Pictures:** `PH_PP.SC["cd_" + template id]`, drawn in their own scope at the end of the `PH_PP` IIFE: `cd_pcos`, `cd_endo`, `cd_dysmen`, `cd_amen`, `cd_perimenopause`, `cd_natural`, `cd_cycle_ivf`, `cd_pregnancy`, `cd_breech_correction`. Same contract as the pattern pictures (`S.k` 0 = Balanced .. 1 = the condition, labels on the condition side only, `RM()` = still frame). Shared drawing helpers inside that scope: `pelvis` (womb, tubes, ovaries; the lining is the cavity's own stroke width), `route` / `nearest` (walk a path by distance), `cluster` (1-2-4-8 cell embryo), `sperm`, `baby`, `womb`. Long loops run on the clock `t` (Natural fertility 14 s, IVF 16 s, others 5-8 s).
- **Behaviour:** PCOS = a ring of small follicles, thick capsule, none ripens; Endometriosis = chocolate cyst, tissue outside the womb that bleeds with each period, adhesions, pain; Dysmenorrhea = the womb squeezes, vessels tighten, dark clots; Amenorrhea = the signal fades before the ovary, a thin lining, no period; Perimenopause = fewer eggs, a swinging hormone line, a flushed sweating person; Natural fertility = egg released, sperm swim up, the embryo travels and settles (condition: weak egg, few slow sperm, thin lining); IVF = many follicles, needle collection, a dish, catheter transfer (Balanced: one follicle); Pregnancy = Balanced the womb at rest, condition a baby with heartbeat, placenta and cord; Breech = head up (Balanced head down; the baby turns when flipped).
- **Wiring:** `PH_PP_COND` holds a pseudo pattern def (`name`, `fam: "pink"`) per picture so `phPpDef` / `phPpCol` / `phPpBarHtml` / `phPpSheetOpen` (the one renderer, bar and sheet) treat it like a pattern; `PH_PP_SHORT` has the bar's short names. `phPpDxRowHtml(name, pats, plan)` now puts the plan's own condition picture FIRST in the Care Plan Diagnosis thumbnail row (the plan's template via `phTpxTplOfPlan(plan)`, so a plan on a template she renamed or copied under another name shows none). Her pick: the main plan's picture only (no pictures for "Also treating").
- **Same limits as the pattern pictures:** the thumbnail row sits in the Diagnosis card's auto branch only, so a Diagnosis she typed herself, or one that came from a booking, shows no thumbnails (patterns included); the plan modal has none.
- **Tested** (headless Edge harness, since removed): all nine on both sides at 1x and 1.5x; every scene stepped at k 0 / .3 / .5 / .8 / 1, with and without reduced motion: no exceptions, no NaN / undefined in any SVG; `phTpFocusGoalHtml` for a synthetic Endometriosis plan renders one condition thumbnail, `phPpSheetOpen("cd_endo")` opens with "Balanced | Endometriosis" and mounts; the thumb row for all nine template names at 1280px and 390px. **Not tested:** a real patient's Care Plan (no sign-in in the sandbox); the loops' later frames by eye (only the stills and a time strip of Natural fertility and IVF).
- **Wording** on the pictures (e.g. "Hard to turn late on", "Few, slow sperm") is DRAFT until she has read it.

## Baseline Compass: score an earlier visit (2026-10-23, LIVE since build 20261022-232900)

Her words, on screenshots of a neck and shoulder patient whose Compass said "first visit · today sets the baseline" while the Care Plan's appointment table listed 4 done bookings: "ive treated this person multiple sessions. how do i set baseline from earlier appointments?"

**Why it said first visit:** Today's visit strip, `phTodayParts` and the Compass counted only visits logged in LCM (`rec.acuSessions`) and scored Compass days, never bookings; the Up next card already counted bookings. There was no way to score a past date in the Compass.

**Her 8 picks** (mock `earlier-visit-baseline-mock-2026-10-23.html`, all as recommended): her notes have a score for each visit; option A, a "Scoring" bar of visit chips; done bookings count as visits; dates = done bookings only; an earlier visit shows complaints + pains only (signs and Energy sit out); a gold line + the Today column takes the date; a quiet "N earlier visits · none scored" hint; computer only.

**Built:**
- `phSeenDays(who, day)`: the days a patient was seen before a day (logged sessions + bookings, not Break), oldest first; takes a name or the record. Read by `phTodayParts` (Re-check joins a return visit), `phTodayStripHtml` ("Last visit 10 Oct"; the phase's "visit N", else the visit count the way the Up next card counts) and `phCxModel` (`back`).
- `phPastBookDays(name)`: the bookings alone, newest first, for the Scoring bar.
- Compass: `phCxAt = { pk, day }` view state (never stored; cleared on a phone width or another patient's card) and `phCxDayOf(name)`. `phCxModel` scores `today` = that day and keeps `now` for the real today; earlier-visit mode drops Energy rows and sign rows, hides "Same as last time" and the drawer's "Move baseline to today". Writes follow the day: `phCxScoreWrite`, the note box (`data-cx-day`, `phCxTypeSave`), the ↓ skip, and pains through `phPmScoreSet(..., atDay)` (that day's pain store; today's severity is untouched, as before). Bar: Today + up to 5 bookings as chips, the rest under an "Older ▾" select (more than 6). Gold line "Scoring an earlier visit: Mon 7 Sep · Back to today"; the header reads "7 Sep" and "Note · 7 Sep".
- Meta line: "4 earlier visits · none scored" until any earlier day has a score; then "N visits · baseline 7 Sep" as before.

**Tested** in the real app (Browser pane, seeded patient with 4 then 8 past bookings, real handlers): bar and hint shown; 7 Sep scored by slider, number key and note, all stored on 7 Sep (Compass + pain store); baseline moved to 7 Sep; 12 Sep showed "1 better", today "3 better" with the chart and Re-check mirror; drawer has no rebase button on an earlier visit; Older ▾ picks 2 Jul; 375 px: no bar, scores today; no new console errors. Not tested on her real data or her phone.

**Judgment calls (disclosed):** more than 6 past bookings = the 5 latest as chips + Older ▾ (keeps the bar one line); when a phase has no planned visit number, the strip shows the overall visit count; the Re-check check now joins Today's visit for a patient with earlier bookings (the return-visit rule).

## Baseline Compass: pain rows on "% better" (2026-10-23, LIVE since build 20261023-010200)

Her words, on a screenshot of the Compass on "% better" with only pain rows (Neck, Shoulder both sides, Left shoulder): "i cant see the % option". Cause: pain rows always scored 0-10, so the switch changed nothing on a pain-only table.

**Her picks** (mock `pain-pct-better-mock-2026-10-23.html`): "Both A and B" (A: a pain takes % like every row, her % kept and the 0-10 score worked out from the baseline; B: a 0-10 score reads as % in From baseline) and "Ask for 0-10 first" when a pain has no baseline yet.

**Built:** `phCxPctBase(hist, moved, day)` = the baseline a % counts from (a score before the day being scored, above 0; a baseline moved to that day or later = none). The model marks such a pain `pctOk`: its slider is 0-100% with the % box, number keys score tens (`data-cx-askk="pnp"`), live drag converts. `phCxPainScoreWrite` turns a % into `now = baseline × (1 − %)` (one decimal) and passes the % to `phPmScoreSet(..., atDay, pct)`, which keeps it as `vis.pains[r|s].pct`; any other "now" write for that day (0-10 on the Compass, the Musculoskeletal page) drops it. `phCxPctOf` reads a row's distance from baseline in % on "% better" + From baseline: her own % for the day, a complaint's own % entry, else (baseline − now) / baseline; a pain entered as % adds "= 3.5 / 10". The group average reads in % too. The 0-10 bubble shows one decimal (3.5).

**Tested** in the real app (seeded patient: Neck 7 and Shoulder 6 on 7 Sep, Left shoulder new): Neck and Shoulder took %, Left shoulder stayed 0-10; key "5" = 50% → stored now 3.5 + pct 50, "50% better = 3.5 / 10"; % box 35 → 3.9; a 0-10 write of 3 dropped the % and read "50% better"; 0-10 switch shows 3.5 / 3 / 4 and step distances; From last visit unchanged; the Musculoskeletal page shows 3.5 / 3 / 4; phone layout fine; no console errors. Not tested on her real data.

**Judgment calls (disclosed):** the % reading on "% better" applies to typed complaints too (one switch, every row), not only pains; the group's average line reads in % on "% better"; a pain's % is stored next to its score in the pain store (one entry), not in the Compass's own days.

## 2026-10-23 · Photo batch: every picked photo saves (the "Saved 0 of 3 — image couldn't be read" error)
Her report (screenshot from her Android phone, 3 tongue photos, "Saved 0 of 3 — 3 didn't save (image couldn't be read ...)"): "i keep
getting this error periodically on my mobile. i need to be able to upload multiple photos at once and have it all save".
**Cause:** a picked gallery photo is a pointer back into the phone's gallery; Save re-opened it later through `<img>` in
`phRenCompressToBlob`. On Android that read can fail (the gallery's hold on the file lapsing after a while, or a big camera photo decoded
while memory is tight), and one failed decode failed the photo outright; all of a batch at once matches the hold lapsing.
**Fix:** (1) `phRenHold(x)` copies each picked photo's bytes into memory straight away (`x.ready`); used by `phRenConfirmOpen`,
`phRenConfirmOpenBatch` and `phRenConfirmAdd` (+ Add more / paste / drop); Save all and the single Save wait for the copy. A copy that
fails keeps the original file. (2) `phRenCompressToBlob` tries three ways before giving up: `<img>`, `createImageBitmap` after 300 ms,
then the bytes copied into a fresh Blob; each canvas is emptied after use. The failure message and the "still here, tap Save again" rows
are unchanged for a truly broken file.
**Tested (sandbox):** forced `<img>` failure → saved through the fallback; a 3-byte fake JPEG still fails with "couldn't open that image";
a 3-photo batch (3000×4000) copies all three at pick time and Save all files 3 of 3, modal closes. **Not tested:** on her phone (the lapse
can't be reproduced in a desktop browser).

## 2026-10-23 · Appointments paste: several dates in one paste
Her ask (the Appointments dialog's Paste list, opened from a patient): "make it possible to paste multiple appointments on multiple dates
and have it added".
**Cause:** the Acupreg (Zanda) day-view and Alexandria day-list branches of `phApptParse` read only the date line ABOVE THE FIRST
appointment, so every appointment in a several-day paste landed on that one date (the Cliniko day / week branch already switched date
at each date line). A date line between two appointments was also swept into the earlier one's service text.
**Fix:** `dkAt[i]` = the nearest date line above line i (else the picked day); both branches read it per appointment and leave date
lines out of the appointment text (`isDateLine`). `phApptParseDateLine` also takes a weekday before a numeric date ("Tue 28/10").
The dialog already imports across several days ("Import N appointments across D days").
**Tested (sandbox, `phApptParse`):** Alexandria list over Fri 24 Oct / Tue 28 Oct / "4/11" → 3 dates; Zanda over "Mon 27 Oct" /
"Tue 28/10" → 2 dates, service "Acupuncture" only; Cliniko list over Fri 31 Oct / Mon 3 Nov → 2 dates; no date lines → the picked day.
**Not handled:** a date and a time on the SAME line ("Tue 28 Oct 4pm Acupuncture"). **Not tested:** her real paste.

## 2026-10-23 · Her pregnancy is one fact (plan date, Pregnant? test, IVF transfer result)
Her words (screenshot of "Before her plan starts" asking her week): "this data is already in her file. can you connect it? make
the pregnant data universal for all relevant input in app".
**Before:** two stores never read each other: the Pregnancy plan's date (`rec.pregnancy.start`, week 0) and the Pregnant? test
(`rec.pregTest.date`, the "4 weeks" anchor); an IVF transfer's positive result counted only for the appointment flag and the cycle pause.
**Now (derived on read, nothing copied):** `phPregStartOf(rec)` = the plan date, else a positive test's date − 28, else the latest
positive IVF transfer's `pregTestDate` − 28 (a negative test with no plan date = not pregnant). `phTpPregFor(rec)` returns it, so every
reader of the plan date follows (the Pregnancy block, timeline items, the plan list's "week N", the Breech / Labour pictures, the
trimester sync). `phPregPositive` / `phPregAnchor` feed the Pregnant? button, the appointment 🌸 week and the cycle pause.
The "Before her plan starts" popup (`phPregQOpen`) no longer asks when her file already has it: the plan starts on that date's trimester
with "Pregnancy plan started at week N · from her file". Her plan date always wins; typing it in the Pregnancy block still writes it.
Left as they are: the Timeline / blood-test items that read a test as a dated EVENT, and the "test logged" banner.
**Tested (sandbox, a copy with only this change; another session's work was mid-way):** test at week 24 → week 24, plan opens on
Second Trimester with no question; plan date 20 weeks ago → button "Pregnant · 20w 0d", appointment "🌸 20w0d"; transfer result only →
11 weeks (button, picture); negative test → not pregnant, the question still shows. **Not tested:** her real patients, her phone.

## 2026-10-24 · Medical history: rows that held two conditions split
Her words: "audit the medical history signs the same way", then "split all as you picked". Every row already started with a capital. Five rows named two things; three split, two kept (do not re-ask).
- **Split:** "Asthma or respiratory condition" → **Asthma** (`asthma`) + **Other lung condition** (`lung_condition`); "Kidney or liver condition" → **Kidney condition** (`kidney_condition`) + **Liver condition** (`liver_condition`); Family history "Endometriosis or PCOS" → **Endometriosis** (`fh_endometriosis`) + **PCOS** (`fh_pcos`). **Kept:** Family history "Heart disease or stroke" (both blood-vessel disease), "Tinea / fungal skin (ringworm, athlete's foot)" (one condition, its kinds named). The list is 42 rows now.
- **Old answers** (`PH_HX_SPLIT`, `phHxSplitCarry`, run once per record by the boot pass `phHxSplitCarryAll` after `phMigrateHistoryV2`): old No → both rows No; old Yes → the row its note names (the smart-paste words), or both rows when the note names neither or both, the note copied; a row already answered is never touched. Kidney / liver: her two separate answers from before 2026-08 (`rec.medicalHistory.kidney_disease` / `liver_disease`) decide each organ while they still add up to the joined answer. The old key is never deleted; `rec.historyMoved[old]` holds the answer carried, so a later answer under the old key carries again. A carry does not stamp `updatedAt` (so it never beats a real edit from the other computer in a sync; the other device carries at its own boot). - **Fix (`phTpCycPhaseOn`):** on a `PH_TP_CYCLE_SYNC` plan, a booking or logged visit dated from her current period on is filed on the phase the cycle names that day (`phTpCycleEffectivePhase`, the band's own read; up to today the cycle never rolls, a day ahead is projected by `phCycleCompAsOf`). `phTpPhaseVisitRows` and `phTpPhaseSessionDates` use it; a hand-filed `a.phaseId`, earlier cycles, an overdue cycle and a plan moved past the wait by hand keep the phase windows.
- **To-come squares (pick: next cycle's days):** with no cycle-day cadence, a phase's squares land on its own CD window (`phTpCdCtx`) from its first CD by its rhythm, this cycle if the window is still ahead, else the next (`phTpCdDates`). Each to-come square shows its CD under the date and opens the Cycle page on that day (pick), the calendar on that month with the day ringed (`data-tp-cyc-go`); a past day opens its day card. Template row order is kept (pick).
- **Cycle page:** the Usual period card is gone from the page (`presCycleSectionBodyHtml`). The footer asks the length once: the stepper while Regular, her shortest–longest range (the same `rec.usual.period.len` store and `data-pfw-range` save) when Irregular. A **Usually** line under it is worked out from her logged periods (`phCycUsual` / `phCycUsualHtml`: each period's heaviest flow, most-picked colour, clots, pain; discharge and PMS over all days), "from N periods"; with fewer than 2 logged periods her old answers stand in ("from her answers"). ## Records → Photos: a tap never moves the page (2026-10-25)
Her words, with a screenshot of the Records → Photos tiles: "when i click dropdown to change tongue to something else, the screen jumps up. stop this".
- **Cause** (reproduced in the sandbox, 3672 px → 197 px): after a label, `phRecPhotosLabel` rang the next photo still needing a label and `phRecPhotosRing` scrolled to it. When the photos after it were all labelled, the next one wrapped round to the top of the page, and the page jumped there. A second, smaller jump: opening one tile's type list folds away another tile's open list, and a list folding above the tapped tile pulled that tile up.
- **Now:** a tap (type list, shot chips, Undo) keeps the page still. `phRecPhotosFocusNext(id, still)` rings the next photo needing a label only while it is fully on screen (`phRecPhotosOnScreen`); otherwise no photo is rung. The keys (1-9, Enter, arrows) still walk the page to the next one, as before (her 2026-10-15 key flow; `byKey` on `phRecPhotosLabel`). `phRecPhotosKeepStill(id, paint)` scrolls back by however far a repaint moved the tapped tile (opening a list, a label repaint). A label that moves a photo to another group in By type keeps the scroll where it was. `phRecPhotosTypePick` is the one type write for a tap and for the 1-9 keys with the list open.
- This changes her 2026-10-14 pick "the next photo is rung and scrolled to": a tap no longer scrolls (her newer word).
- **Tested** (sandbox, 1280 × 800, 54 seeded photos, removed after): labelling the last unlabelled photo near the bottom stays at 3584 px (it was 3672 → 197 before the fix); four labels in a row, shot chips and type list, stay at 3584 px, the ring moves to a photo on screen or none; opening a second tile's list while another is open above keeps the tapped tile at 542 px; By type: opening and picking keep 1200 px; the keys still scroll to the next photo (0 → 44 px); no console errors from this code. **Not tested:** her real photos or a touch device; the phone width (no layout or CSS changed); the Prescriptions search (this change touches only the Records → Photos code).

## 2026-10-25 · Readable text: app-wide contrast audit
- **Her ask:** "audit app to correct text that is not readable" (screenshot: the Fang Bing Ren Quick assess bar, white words on a near-white box). Audit = measure and fix all, one pass.
- **How it was measured:** a throwaway script walked every visible text run in `#pharmacyPage` (22 tabs, 24 patient pages, Quick assess open), with animations finished first, against its real composited background: 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text. 77 spots failed at first; about 15 were not real (white text on a navy gradient the script cannot read, the Messages tone switch's sliding thumb, the composer's invisible text mirror, the Fang Bing Ren bar's clipped overlay label).
- **Fixed:**
  - Quick assess bar: the chip sweep had put a paper box behind white words; it is now a faint white box on the navy header (`.ph-qa2-tog`).
  - Fang Bing Ren colours: Fu Zi and Huang Lian now take ink words, Chai Hu (`#478052`) and Ma Huang (`#8C7046`) are a shade deeper so white words read, the grey fallback takes ink. `fgOf` picks white or ink at the true crossover (0.207, was 0.34), and a formula shade in the dead band (0.18–0.24, readable with neither) is nudged a step lighter or darker (`readable`). A ticked row's ✕ and point pill are solid, no 75% fade, no white wash.
  - Amber text: new `--ph-low-press #8A5708` (5.4:1 on the amber tint); all 87 text uses of `--ph-low-deep` read it ("Low", "Not dispensed yet", "low", stock %, price review badge, restock bands). Fills and lines keep `--ph-low-deep`.
  - Treatment's green and navy blocks and the visit table's green rows: their soft / faint words were 82% / 62% white, now white / 94% white; the "+ Add" formula action is a see-through chip there (it was white on white).
  - Patterns: green, orange and sand patterns put ink on their colour (`--on`), so "Agree with this pattern", the bubbles and Likely tags read.
  - Faded labels lost their fade: page header counts (`.ph-shell-sub`), Fang Bing Ren group counts, All templates counts, Dispense band counts; the pain-map caption under the idle figure stays readable (only the drawing fades); the Compass "Goal" and "–", the relocation date label, the Messages tab tag and the Stats "Usage" head now read the faint / soft ink.
  - Count badges on a picked tab (Tongue, Pulse, Fang Bing Ren switches, To Order segments) darken instead of whitening.
  - Appointments now-line time: ink on gold. Find the Ren ★: gold-deep. The "i" dots: ink on grey.
  - Cycle calendar days from the next month: 80% (was 50% × 85%).
- **Left on purpose:** disabled controls (the empty price-review start button, future cycle days): WCAG exempts them.
- **Tested** (sandbox): full rescan at 1280 (22 tabs, 24 patient pages, Quick assess open) and 375 (13 tabs + 4 patient pages): no real failures left; Quick assess bar by eye; Prescriptions search narrows (Tess shown, Zara hidden) and returns.
- **Not tested:** pages that need data the seed lacks (an IVF round, a full stock list with every status, Settings editors opened deep), by eye at phone width beyond the scan.
- **Pages checked:** every tab above and Patient details, Today's visit, Ask her, Tongue, Pulse, Abdomen, Musculoskeletal, Cycle, Fang Bing Ren, Patterns, Care Plan, Treatment, Log, Notes, Medical history, Ren, Supplements, Blood tests, IVF history, Visit checks, Photos, Appointments, Messages.

- **Store:** `lcm-me` (localStorage, NOT daybook-prefixed on purpose: both logins show it and it survives a location switch) = `{d, rev, who, dirty}`; `d = {v, items, todos, bdays, modes, modesUp, brought}`; item `{id, t, d, s, e, c | g, mode?, note?, k?:"clinic", rep?:{f d|w|m|y|n|x, wd, every, n, u, at, until, plus}, ex?:{day: 0 | {s, e, t}}, dn?:{day:1}, up, del?}`; to-do `{id, t, day?, done?, at, up, del?}`; birthday `{id, n, d, m, y?, up, del?}`. One write door `phMeSave(fn)` (owner tag must be one of the row's members; a failed local write = `phShowSaveError`). Reads: `phMeDayItems(day)` (occurrences, `phMeOccurs`), `phMeBdaysOn`, `phMeRuleText`.
- **Cloud:** one row `public.lcm_me` id `linh` (`supabase/me_setup.sql`: RLS read / update only for the two login addresses in `members`; a client may change `data` and `rev` only; no insert, no delete). **Created 2026-10-25 on her yes** (LCM project jkpfhqaxhsiwtijxxzql, SQL Editor) and checked: the row `linh` with both addresses at rev 0, RLS on, policies "lcm_me members read" (SELECT) and "lcm_me members write" (UPDATE) for authenticated, grants = SELECT + UPDATE (data, rev) for authenticated, nothing for anon. `phMeSync` reads, merges entry by entry (`up` newest wins, `del` kept), writes back only when this device holds something newer, through `.eq("rev", rev)` (a crossed write reads again, 3 tries). Waits on `window.__lcmOwnerOk()` (the sync layer's `ownerOk`, one new line in the sync IIFE) and on the owner being a member. Runs 1.5 s after a change, on `lcm-sync-caught-up`, on the tab coming back (20 s throttle); a missing table or no row changes nothing on the device.
- **Grid (search "ME · HER OWN THINGS LIVE IN LCM" + "C22 ON THE APPOINTMENTS GRID"):** `phC22Src` = her items, plus C22's digest only until she brings it in. Level `phMeLevel()` off / ev / all (`lcm-me-layer` 0 / 1 / 2). At Events a routine folds into the day's ⟳ n chip in the before-row (`phC22RtCount`, tap = `phC22Unf`, that day only, this visit); a clinic routine still shows on a day with no patients. Card (`phC22PopHtml`): her item = rule or day + time, note, Done (`phMeDoneToggle`, kept 90 days) · Edit; a cake is a button (`data-ph-me-bday`, card `phMeBdayPopHtml`, "bday:<day>").

Me hides the patient panes and the ⋯ menu and shows `#phApptMe` (`phMeFormHtml`): Event · To-do · Birthday; an event = title, day, start – end (no end = 60 min), Once · Daily · Weekly · Monthly · Every… (Mon–Sun, a stepper + days / weeks / months), colour ▾ (her C22 Modes, then C22's groups a Mode does not already name), note; a repeating thing asks This day | Every day first, and This day hides the repeat, colour and note rows (it changes only title and time; a new day moves it); "Coming up" (30 days of one-offs and birthdays) beside the form. ## Me on the grid: a stack instead of slivers (2026-10-25; commit 5ffbcb1d, LIVE in build 20261025-100100, carried by another session's publish; her "push live")
- **Her ask:** a screenshot of her live week at 1219px with Me on All: beside patient bookings her routines were cut into unreadable slivers ("|", "!", "T"), at 3pm (Code + Lunch beside three patients), 6pm Mon / Tue (Travel + Shoulder Rehab), and Saturday. The routine times were right; the layout split the 26% side lane between every item that met a booking (`26 / of`).
- **The fix:** an item is never narrower than the lane. A cluster whose columns would split it (2+ beside a booking, 4+ on a day with no booking) folds into ONE stack over its whole span (`phC22DayLayout` builds `{stk:[...], s, e, side}`; `phC22LifeHtml` hands it to `phC22StkHtml`): the count, then each item's glyph in its own colour (a dot when it has none, `phC22Mark`). A tap opens its card (`stk:<day>|<id>|…`, `phC22StkPopHtml`): the day, the span, a 32px row per item (faint tint of its colour, title, start). A row opens that item's own card (Done · Edit), still hanging off the stack (`phApptPopAnchorEl` finds the stack by `data-ph-c22-ids~=`, never a row inside the card). Tapping the stack again closes it; Enter / Space open it; every "clear the ring" list now includes the stack.
- **Calls made (disclosed):** the thresholds (2 beside a booking, 4 on an open day, so nothing drops under the lane's own width); a single item in the lane is unchanged; the stack's edge is the neutral grey (its items have different colours); the card is the same small 240px card as an item's.
- **Tested (localhost:8947, a test owner tag + her routine shape as test data, no sign-in):** 1280, 7 days: 6 stacks (Mon 3pm Code + Lunch, Mon 6pm Travel + Shoulder Rehab, Tue 3pm Code + Lunch + Dentist, Wed / Thu / Sat 3pm), each 28px wide with the count and marks; no lane item under 28px. Card: 3 rows, 32px, own tints, on screen beside the stack; a row → "Dentist / Tue 27 Oct · 3:30 – 4:30 / Done / Edit", the stack keeps its ring; Done → ✓ Done; close → focus back on the stack, no ring left; Enter opens a stack; a second tap closes it; Code's row → Edit → the dialog on Me, This day | Every day. Events level: 0 stacks, ⟳ counts; ⟳ on Monday → its two stacks. 375 (1 day): stacks 77px, the card a bottom sheet with 343px rows, no sideways scroll. Prescriptions search: "alice" → 1 of 2, cleared → 2. No console errors (two 404s from the harness).
