## 2026-11-01 · Calendar: click a free time to add, from her event presets
**Her words:** "i want to be able to click the calendar and add an event like a calendar. i need all events to be organised and
preset so i can just search and select instead of free selecting all the time."
**Measured first:** her Me row held 137 events with 57 titles, many the same thing typed differently (Gym / GYmn, Mandarin class /
Chinese class 1 hr, three spellings of one seminar); most had no colour. Effort today (her answer): all four, typing the name,
picking the colour, setting time + length, getting to the box.
**Her picks** (mock `event-quick-add-mock-2026-11-01.html`, published to her; all as recommended except 4, where she added Repeat):
1 A a click on a free time opens a card there, a drag down sets a longer time first · 2 A one tap on a row saves, Undo in the toast ·
3 A before typing the whole list shows, grouped under her colours · 4 a preset holds Length + Usual time + Repeat (not Note) ·
5 A the list starts from her own events, tidied, and every new name she types is kept · 6 A one table in Settings › Calendar plus
an "Edit list" row on the card · 7 A Me only (patients stay in Cliniko) · the card sits BESIDE the clicked time, not docked in the
column (opening it closes any booking card) · a repeating preset whose routine already runs adds THAT DAY only; with no routine yet
it starts one and the toast offers "Only this day".
**Built:** a click on a free time of the grid (the day column itself, never a block; Appointments, Grid, Me events showing:
`phQkArmed`) opens `#phQk` beside that time (right of the column, else left, kept on screen; a bottom sheet at ≤640px; centred
from Settings), with a ghost block holding the time and, for a mouse, a hover band that says where a click lands. The card: the
date + time (or the dragged range), Search events (name and colour words, names that start with the words first, then the most
used), the list grouped by colour (`phMeColours()`: her Modes, then C22's groups; no colour last), each row its usual time and
length; arrows + Enter pick; the last row "New “x”" for a name not on the list (the form: Name, Colour, Length, Usual time,
Repeat as one joined bar Once · Daily · Weekly · 2 weeks · Monthly; the clicked time fills Usual time); Edit list ›. One tap =
one `phMeSave` writes the item (clicked time, the preset's length or the dragged one, its colour, its repeat on that weekday or
day) and, for a new name, the preset; the one toast says "✓ Gym · Tue 3:00 pm · Weekly" with Undo (both go) and Only this day
when a repeat was started. Esc, ✕ or a press outside closes. Settings › **Calendar** (a new group) › Event presets: one table
Name · Colour · Length · Usual time · Repeat (· From your events, the titles a preset was tidied from), ✎ opens the row in the
same card (rename, a duplicate name is refused; Delete with Undo), + Preset. The Me form's Event title lists the names (native
datalist) and a picked name fills colour, time, length and repeat (Once when that routine already runs).
**Data:** presets are a new Me map `pre` (`{id, t, mode|c|g, len, at, rep, from?, up, del?}`), merged entry by entry like items

## 2026-11-01 — Two parked fixes: the photo Undo in the one toast; the title bar lands whole before paint

**Her word:** "continue", twice, after the data check went live; the OPEN list's parked line held these two small fixes, so they
were the next thing. Both have left that line.

- **One toast (★★★ rule 5).** A photo delete's "Photo deleted · Undo" used its own `#phRenUndoToast` pill at the bottom of the
  page (its own CSS, its own `[data-ren-undo-delete]` click branch, `phRenUndoToastHtml` / `phRenUndoToastRefresh`). It is the one
  toast now: `phRenDeletePhotosWithUndo` (every photo delete, the patient's Photos page and Records → Photos alike) calls
  `presSavedToast("Photo deleted" | "n photos deleted", { undo: phRenUndoRestore, ms: 8000 })`; `phRenUndoRestore` is the old
  click branch as a function (every record back exactly as stored, one reload per patient, `phRecPhotosRefresh`); a failed
  restore reads through the toast too (it used `phFlashShow`, banned on a patient page). `phRenUndoState` keeps its 8 s window,
  so a second delete still supersedes the first. The pill's markup and CSS are gone.
- **The title bar grew after paint** (known since the Refill chip build, BUILD-NOTES 2026-09-02 "Known, NOT fixed": ~19px then,
  with the 44px disc). Cause: `renderPharmacy` sets the page's action cluster (`phTopbarActionSet(tab)`) before the page draws
  its own `phShellHead`, so the merge found no visible bar; the 0 ms retry dropped the disc in after paint and the bar grew on
  every repaint of every page with a primary action. Fix: `phMobileDedupeTitles` (the one call every render path makes last)
  runs the merge again, synchronously, with the set the pre-render call remembered (`window.__phTbmArgs`: its tab is the
  normalised one; a first version passed `PHARMACY.activeTab` and lost the disc when that held a stale name renderPharmacy maps
  to Inventory). The retry and the 40 ms heal stay as they were (they find the cluster on screen and do nothing).
  Measured in the `_ia-page.html` harness, the HEAD copy against the fixed one, the visible bar right after `renderPharmacy()`
  and 350 ms later: before, Inventory / Prescriptions / Stocktake / a stale tab name 50.5px with no cluster → 58px with the disc
  (7.5px of growth; Stock movements, Communications and Settings have no primary action and never grew; Formula refill sets its
  own cluster and never grew); after, every one of the ten pages the same height at both moments with the cluster in the bar
  from the first paint (58 or 50.5 at 1440; 47 at 375, ☰ · title · disc · ⋯).
- **Left as it was:** Appointments at desktop width repaints its own bar twice after opening (about 100 and 300 ms, its own
  render path) and the 40 ms heal puts the cluster back each time; that short flicker predates this build and is Appointments'
  own, not the shell's.
- **Post Ovulation (OPEN since 2026-10-21):** read on her live records tonight (read only): the jar is back already (240 g, low
  125, $0.20/g, Lyttleton default with a Koda PO row, 9 dispenses, the last 1 Oct). Nothing to add; the OPEN line is gone.

**Tested (sandbox, `_ia-page.html` harness at 1440 and 375):** the one toast shows "Photo deleted" with Undo wired to
`phRenUndoRestore`; Undo with two stubbed records put both back (one load, one refresh), cleared the state and closed the toast;
no `#phRenUndoToast` element, `phRenUndoToastHtml` / `phRenUndoToastRefresh` gone from the reloaded copy; the title-bar
heights above on Inventory, Stock movements, Communications, Settings, Appointments, Dashboard, Formula refill, Stocktake,
Prescriptions and a stale tab name; the Prescriptions search with three in-memory rows narrowed to one on "Beta" and gave all
three back when cleared; no console errors. **Not exercised:** a real photo delete on her records;
her phone; Appointments' own repaint.

## 2026-11-01 — A wiped title-bar cluster comes back before paint (the Appointments blink)

**Her word:** "A · Fix the Appointments flicker too" (her pick after the two parked fixes went live, build 20261101-220200).

- **Measured first** (the `_ia-page.html` harness, the visible `.ph-shell-titlebar` sampled every 25–50 ms after `renderPharmacy()`):
  at desktop width Appointments' bar lost its action cluster about 100 ms and 300 ms after opening and got it back 40–50 ms
  later each time (58px → 50.5px → 58px): the disc blinked twice. Cause: `phPinApptZones` runs at 0 and 250 ms; when the grid
  was drawn for a different room than it measures it schedules a 60 ms refit (`phApptCalRepaintKeep` → `renderPhAppointmentsPage`),
  which rebuilds the whole head with `innerHTML` and so wipes the merged cluster; the shell's heal (the `#pharmacyPage`
  MutationObserver in `phTitlebarMerge`) only looked 40 ms later. The same wait blinked the disc on every page that repaints
  its own bar (a search keystroke on Appointments, a Dashboard zone rebuild).
- **Fix, in the shell, not the page:** the observer now checks its records first: when a removed node is (or holds) a
  `.ph-tbmerge` and no slot is left in the page, it runs `phTopbarActionSet` at once, in the same task (a MutationObserver
  callback is a microtask, so it lands before the frame paints), with the tab the pre-render call remembered
  (`window.__phTbmArgs[0]`, the normalised name). Only a removed slot takes that path: a page with no bar never runs the merge
  on every mutation. The 40 ms heal stays for the odd off-screen case; Appointments' own refit is untouched (the grid still
  redraws for its room, as it should).

**Tested (sandbox harness, 1440 and 375):** Appointments opened through `renderPharmacy()`: 33 samples over 800 ms all 58px
with the disc in the bar (before: two dips to 50.5px); `renderPhAppointmentsPage()`, `phApptCalRepaintKeep()` and
`renderPhDashboardPage()` called directly each wipe the slot synchronously and have it back by the next task; at 375 the
phone bar held 47px with ☰ · disc · ⋯ through 600 ms; the Prescriptions search with three in-memory rows narrowed to one on
"Gamma" and gave them all back when cleared; no console errors. **Not exercised:** her records; her phone; a real Cliniko load
landing mid-open.

**LIVE:** build 20261101-230200 (publish 31c21c8e, 2026-11-01).

## 2026-11-01 · Meal repeats: each food is daily, on set days, or that day only
Her words: "need an easier way to organise meals based on daily or one day" (screenshot of the Meals week, Thu 29 – Sun 1). Her
4th report on this area (10/26 ✎ Usual, 10/27 the bar on top, 10/28 pick B and "i dont need an every lunch and everyday
button"), so the layer was wrong: her answers said she wants all four of make a day her daily, add one thing daily, change one
day only and plan by weekday; her meals "change day to day"; every hard part ticked (can't find every day, can't tell what
repeats, a changed day stays stuck, too many taps). One fixed usual meal a slot was the wrong model: what repeats is a food.
Sample: `meal-repeat-mock-2026-11-01.html` (artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/28ee7czCndUhpCQeiHdf74). **Her 8 picks, all
the recommended:** C · Both (a chip on each food + ↻ Repeat meal), the ↻ mark look, ✕ on a repeat asks Just · on · Every day ·
Keep, a new food starts that day only, ✎ Usual goes, a repeat runs from its day on, an amount change on a repeat asks the same,
"Yes, build it".

**What changed** (code "MEAL REPEATS" above `phMealPlan`; CSS "MEAL REPEATS" after A CALMER MEAL's):
- A repeat = `d.meals["rp|<id>"]` {sl, x, r d · w · e · k (wd), fr, to}. `phMealPlan(day, sl)` (the one read every page uses:
  cells, card, calendar, macros, Shopping list, Had it) = the repeats on that day less the day's `off`, at the day's amounts, +
  the day's own foods (an entry with `ad: 1`). Her usual meal (`def|<sl>`) counts as Every day foods (`phMealRepAll` makes them
  virtual repeats, so nothing moved and an old build still reads it); changing one moves it out of the usual meal into a repeat
  of its own (`phMealRepCut`, carrying on to the day before). A day kept before (no `ad`) still reads as its whole meal; when a
  repeat of that meal changes, its days from today on are kept the new way first (`phMealLegacyUp`), so they follow.
- Every write to her day goes through `phMealDayPut` (the day's list as she wants it, kept against what repeats): `phMealPlanSet`
  "day", Copy a day (`phMplCopyDays` copies the day's foods as they show), and the list's add / ✕ / − + paths.
- The chip (`phMealRpRowHtml`, a line under each food of HER day's meal; not a patient's, her usual sheet or a meal she had),
  its list (`phMealRpMenuHtml`: <Thu> only · Every day · Weekdays · Weekends · Every <Thu> · the M–S joined bar), ↻ Repeat meal
  on the top line (`phMealDayTopHtml`, with ↺ Undo once the day has its own changes; "Same as every <meal>" and "<Thu> only"
  went), the ask on ✕ and on − / + of a repeat (`phMealRpUi`; − / + keep changing the shown amount until she picks),
  `phMealRepSet` / `phMealRepRm` / `phMealRepQ` (one save each, its Undo puts every entry back).
- Planner: a ↻ before a food that repeats, a food for that day only bold (`.ph-mpl-ml.rpx`); the key reads "↻ repeats · bold =
  that day only"; the ✎ Usual buttons (row heads) and the phone's Usual / Every chips are gone; the picker always opens on the day.

**Tested** (sandbox, her real week's shape seeded: milk every day from her usual, cocoa on Thu, water at lunch, a Fri lunch
emptied, Sun and Tue 3 kept the old way): every day read the same as before the build; Repeat meal → Every day on Thu made
cocoa daily from Thu (Mon–Wed unchanged) and reached Sun and Tue 3; the toast's Undo put it back; ✕ milk on Fri → the ask →
Just Fri took it off Fri only; + + on Sat's milk showed 350 ml with the ask → Sat on: 250 ml up to Fri, 350 ml from Sat; the
day bar (Sat off, then Sun off) went Every day → "Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sun" → Weekdays with no extra entries left; a banana
added = "Mon only", bold in the cell; Copy a day Mon → Sat kept the weekday cocoa as Sat's own; Skipped ahead and back; a meal
she had and her usual sheet show no chips; the card shows the chips; no console errors. Pictures (headless Edge, 1220 and 375
in a frame): `shots/meal-repeats-1220|ask-1220|375-2026-11-01.png`. **Not tested:** her real records, her phone (Key2), a second
device on an old build (it still reads her usual meal; days changed here read their own foods only there until it updates).
**LIVE:** build 20261101-231600 (publish ead3b3db, 2026-11-01).

## 2026-11-01 — The built-in herb list is her live list (PH_HERB_SEED baked)

**Her word:** "C · Bake the built-in herb list" (her pick after the Appointments blink went live; the last parked item but the
heartbeat field).

- **What the seed is for (measured in the code first):** `loadPharmacy` seeds `PH_HERB_SEED` only into a store with no herbs at all
  (a fresh profile, or a stored object never seeded). On a device's first-ever boot the sync base is set from that local copy, so
  the first pull reads local as unchanged and the cloud row wins whole: the seed never reaches an existing row. It is what a
  **brand-new row** (a new clinic login, whose empty cloud side the empty-guard refuses) and a **fresh profile before its first
  pull** (the sandbox too) start with. Since the 2026-10-14 dead-code sweep that was the raw 2026-07-23 galcott.com export: 301
  entries, `code / name / cost / qty / low / note` only, no supplier rows, no stopped or phasing flags, 142 with stock numbers.
- **Baked:** the line is now her inventory as read on her live build tonight (read only, 302 jars): `name`, `cost`, `low`, `note`,
  `suppliers` (name · code · bottleCost · isDefault, the rows her app keeps), `supplier`, `stopped` (113), `phaseOut` (31), `kind`
  (3 formulas), `source` (7 onsite, 1 premade), `overstockAt`, `usedByHH`; `qty` is null on every entry (no stock numbers in a public
  file, and a new row has no stock to claim); ids are given at seeding as before. Dropped: the ordering and arrival state
  (`order`, `ordered`, `snoozedUntil`, `restockHistory` …), `prevQty`, `refill*`. The notes are herb notes (functions, ingredients,
  her supplier price jottings); scanned for anything personal: nothing. The header comment above the line says what it is now.
- **One rule with it:** a store where nothing is counted yet (every `qty` null) opens Inventory with **no status filter**
  (`phStatusStart`): the everyday default hides Untracked, which would have shown "0 of 302 herbs" on a brand-new row or in the
  sandbox. Her own store (144 counted jars) keeps the default exactly; one counted jar brings it back on the next open.

**Tested (sandbox harness, `_ia-page.html`, truly fresh profile = the pharmacy store and the one-time migration flags removed, put
back after):** 302 jars, `seeded` true, 113 stopped, 31 phasing out, 3 formulas, every qty null, 302 distinct ids; the supplier
directory backfilled to her 9 names (Evergreen, Koda, In house, Doane, Lyttleton, GMP, Huang Huang, Mick, KPC); Twin jars finds the
same 7 pairs as her live list; Inventory opens on "Status ▾" with 40 rows on page 1 (3 Yellows · Abx · Allergies Chronic …), no
errors; the sandbox's own store (142 counted of 301) still opens on "Status · 5 ▾", 142 of 301; the HEAD copy on the same fresh
profile showed 142 of 301 with the old names (the comparison); the Prescriptions search with three in-memory rows narrowed to one
and gave all three back; no console errors. **Not exercised:** a real brand-new login; her phone. Her own records are untouched
(read once, nothing written; the clipboard carried the list and was put back as it was).

**LIVE:** build 20261101-233700 (publish 902cfb31, 2026-11-01), together with the Communications page audit (fdd719fc) from the bugs session.

**Communications page audit LIVE:** fdd719fc + notes 30a12928 went out in build 20261101-233700 (publish 902cfb31, made by the
B33 C4 LCM session with its built-in herb list f8aaf07e, on her "Push both"); build 20261101-233900 (9bcff7de) re-stamped the same
code (this session's publish had waited on the lock and found nothing new). Checked on the live copy: the Not shown break, the
phone composer block and "Nothing prepared" + Compose.

## 2026-11-02 — The 6–7 week scan on IVF history: one fact, read in four places (the last parked item)

**Her word:** "continue" after the baked herb list went live; the OPEN list's last parked line was "a heartbeat field on IVF scans".
Measured first (read only, her live build): 1 patient with IVF rounds (9 rounds, 5 transfers, 1 Pregnant — ongoing with a positive
test), no scan recorded anywhere, and the two screens disagreed about it: the transfer card's 3rd step said "heartbeat" from the
outcome alone while the Timeline's Heartbeat row estimated ~transfer + 30. Her 8 picks + 4 look-picks, all the recommended option.

- **The scan lives on the transfer** (picks 1–2): `t.hbDate` (a full date, guarded 1900–2100 like every date input) and `t.hbSeen`
  (heartbeat · none · twins), with `t.hbPicked` once she tapped a chip herself. A scan line under the test's row in the transfer's edit
  (`phIvfPregTestHtml`, only once the test is positive): "6–7 wk scan" · date · one joined chip bar (`.ph-tng2-seg.ph-ivf-hbseg`,
  `[data-ivf-tchip="rowId:tid:hbSeen:value"]`; the same chip again clears; a chip with no date yet dates the scan today). The only writes
  are the transfer field handler (`[data-ivf-tfield]`, new `hbDate` branch and the outcome branch) and that chip bar.
- **The card's 3rd step reads it** (`phIvfTransferViewHtml`): "2 Nov · heartbeat"; an undated Pregnant — ongoing reads "heartbeat ·
  date to add"; the step is a `button.s` door (`data-ivf-t-edit`) once the test is positive: it opens the edit, the line fades in once
  (`phIvfHbRevealTid`, `.ph-ivf-hbline.in`) and focus lands on the date. A typed date with no chip reads as the outcome says (a loss:
  no heartbeat; else heartbeat), hers to change.
- **Outcome rules** (picks 4 and 6): Pregnant — ongoing with no scan pre-fills today + heartbeat and opens the line; a loss
  (miscarriage · ectopic · biochemical) keeps the scan's date and reads "no heartbeat" unless she picked the chip herself. A scan
  counts only on a pregnancy that tested positive (`phIvfHbOf` filters on it), so an outcome moved back to awaiting / negative never
  shows a stale scan and nothing is deleted.
- **Read in four places, one read each** (picks 3, 5, 7): `phIvfHbOf(row)` = this round's latest dated scan → the Timeline's Heartbeat
  row (Done · date · what was seen · "from IVF history", `phTlModel` `hb` branch; still "~19 Nov" (transfer + 30) until then) and Today's
  visit's Journey door ("Scan ~5 Nov" before; "Heartbeat 2 Nov" / "Twins 2 Nov" / "No heartbeat 1 Nov" after, opens the Timeline);
  `phIvfHbScan(rec)` = the latest across her rounds, never before the pregnancy's start → the Pregnancy plan's Dating scan row.
- **The embryo beats** (pick 8): `svg.ut.hb` rests the catheter and its glow and sits the embryo in place; `.beat` (once per open,
  `phIvfHbPulsed`) plays `phIvftBeat` 900 ms × 3 (scale 1.45); none under reduced motion.
- **Look-picks (all as built):** the undated step's words, the line's label "6–7 wk scan", what was seen leads on Today's visit, the
  beat stays small. The app's desktop rule makes every joined bar 30px at ≥641px; this bar follows it (32px at phone widths).

**Tested (sandbox, `_ia-page.html` on a clean HEAD copy `_ia-build.html`, a made-up patient, 1440 and 375):** the step tap opens the
line with focus on the date; a typed date → "2 Nov · heartbeat", `ut.hb.beat`, catheter hidden, 3 iterations; the twins chip → the
step, the Timeline row ("2 Nov · twins from IVF history") and the Journey door ("Twins 2 Nov") all read it; outcome → ongoing on a
second transfer pre-filled today + heartbeat with the line's fade-in; → miscarriage read "1 Nov · no heartbeat" (`s no`, no beat) and
"No heartbeat 1 Nov"; before any scan the Journey said "Scan ~19 Nov" and the Timeline row "~19 Nov" estimated; a Pregnancy plan's
Dating scan read Done · 2 Nov · twins from IVF history; 375: no overflow, chips 32px, no text cut; the Prescriptions search narrowed
to the one name and gave the list back; 0 errors over the path. Pictures `shots/hb-after-*.png` (seven; six sent to her as the mock
round). **Not tested:** her real records, her phone (Key2), the beat by eye in motion (headless pictures are stills).
**LIVE:** build 20261102-004400 (publish 0207faf1, 2026-11-02 ~01:55), with two build-notes commits from the other LCM sessions. The live copy carries `phIvfHbOf` and the scan line; her computer and phone still need the gold Update button.

## 2026-11-01 — Meals as a clean table (MEALS TABLE): Table | Grid, fasting the first ring, the meal in a column, steps, drag to copy

Her synth22 batch tonight: "help me redesign this page so it fits what i want to see and achieve. i want a table format for meal
planning and recording. i need to to be clean, like the appointments page. use cliniko zanda and google ui designs as a guide for how
i like things. show mock." Mock meals-table-mock-2026-11-01.html (her real week); her picks: B Week table + A Week grid (both, a Grid |
Table switch), 3 Rings, fasting = her word "ring", D Column, then "include interactive animations and workflow elements" (mock v3:
the step bar, drag to copy, the toast + Undo, motion) and "Yes, build it".

Built (computer): ONE card. The toolbar = ‹ 26 Oct – 1 Nov › · Today (off on this week) · Grid | Table (`lcm-mpl-view`, this
device's; Table first) · the steps Plan n/7 · Shop n to buy · Eat had/n · Check n to answer (`phMplSteps`; the first not done is
filled; counts roll) · More ▾ (Copy last week, Recipes, Shopping list, Targets; the shared `.ph-comm-more`). Then today's rings
with fasting first (`phMplFastRingHtml`: the running fast's arc to its goal, `data-mpl-fring` moved each minute by `phMplLive`, the
goal select, → the time or "last 14 h ✓"; the gold ring at the goal now goes round it) and Stop / Start / Continue fast + Your fasts ›
beside them (`phMplRactsHtml`, its own `data-fast-host` so the fast handler hears it). The clock bar (`phMplClockHtml`) and the Fast
row (`phMplFastHtml`) are gone with their CSS; so is the Macros row (`phMacCellHtml` + `.ph-mac` bars): the numbers are the Table's
kJ · P · C · F columns and the Grid's Total row (`phMplDayNums`, the MACROS colours). Then `.ph-mpl-body` = the week + the column
(`phMplColHtml`, 360px, sticky): the meal's picker (inline now, so `phMplPlace` has nothing to place on a computer), or a panel
(`phMplPnl`): "shop" (the week's list, Make list / Make again), "check" (`phRxCkCardHtml` takes a meal now; one card a meal she had
1½ h ago with no Fine, reaction or ✕), or a day key (tap a day's name: `phMplMoreHtml` + Copy this day, the strip shared with the
phone's Copy a day as `phMplCStripHtml`). With the column open the week scrolls inside; the day column and the four number columns
are sticky (Table), the label column (Grid). Steps' doors (`phMplStepGo`): Plan → next week (phone: the first empty day from today,
else next Monday) · Shop → the column (made first when none; phone: makes it and scrolls to it) · Eat → today's next meal not had ·
Check → the column (phone: the meal's own card, `phRxCkOpen`). Drag (`draggable` on a meal with foods, computer only) onto another
day's same meal = `phMplCopyMeal` (what she had, else its plan, via `phMealDayPut`; a meal she had there stays; "✓ Wed 28 lunch
copied to Fri 30" + Undo). Grid = `.ph-mpl-t.blk` (days across, had = solid teal block with white words, Total row). A click on
More ▾ no longer closes an open meal. Phone: the rings five across (52px; the goal select hidden, it is on Your fasts › as the clock
bar's was; "of" hidden, the goal field stays), Stop · Your fasts a row under them, the steps fill the width with counts only, no
Fast row.

Tested on a test copy (sandbox, her week seeded through a temporary `_mt-shot.html`): 1220 / 1440 / 360 wide, Table and Grid, a
meal open, Shopping made from Shop then a tick (4 → 3 to buy), a day's column, Check with two meals, Start fast (ring 0 → 31% at
5 h), drag Fri → Sat breakfast + Undo, More ▾ open / shut, week back / Today, no console errors. Pictures:
scratchpad mt-b1-table / mt-b2-grid / mt-b3-check / mt-b4-phone.

`phRecPhotosThumbHtml`, `.ph-gal-chip`, `.ph-gal-datesel`, `.ph-gal-swap`, the 640px block):**
- **All dates | Pair**, one joined bar (`.ph-recphotos-seg`, the page's own) above the table once a patient has two or more
  dates. All dates = every column, **oldest left, newest right** (`allDates` sorts ascending; it used to be reversed). Pair = two
  columns whose heads are the pickers: BEFORE 8 Sep ▾ · ⇄ · AFTER 20 Oct ▾ (`select.ph-gal-datesel.field-bare`, a 32px 6px chip with its own
  chevron; `field-bare` keeps it out of the app-wide `select:not(.field-bare)` pill rule, the Field-input trap from the 10/29
  audits; on a phone it keeps STYLE-LCM's 16px value size), opening on
  **first ↔ latest**; the ⇄ (`.ph-gal-swap`, a 32px circle) swaps the two dates; a pick in a head repaints the section in place.
  `phRenGalCmp` now holds `{ mode, a, b }` per patient key for the session (never written to the record): no entry = All dates on a
  computer, the **Pair on a phone** (`phRenGalPairOf`). The old "Show" chip row, its max-two FIFO and the "pick a second date" hint
  are gone. The swap column is a narrow `th.sw` / `td.sw` so the group heads' colspan counts it.
- **Phone (≤640px, inside the one PHONE REDESIGN block):** `.ph-gal-table.pair` lets the two columns fit the screen (`fit` cells
  lose their 220px floor, the row head wraps in an 84px column at 10.5px, the head dropdown loses some padding, the swap column is 36px: 296px of card, 296px of table at 375). All dates is one
  tap away and scrolls sideways inside the card as before.
- **Records → Photos, By type** groups by `phRenRowKeyOf` in `phRenRowsFor`'s order: Tongue · Natural light, Tongue · Flash,
  Tongue · Sublingual, Tongue · Side, Tongue · unsorted (no shot yet), then the other kinds; a shot change on a tile now moves it
  between groups (`phRecPhotosLabel`'s `moved` test counts the shot). Each tile's date is the patient page's own date chip
  (`phRenGalDateBtnHtml`, the hidden native date input) in place of the date words; the one `change` handler serves both pages
  through **`phRenDateMove`** (the write through `phRenBulkPatch` → `phRenPhotoPut`; on Records the page's flat cache is patched by
  hand and the tile repaints in place, or the body with the scroll kept when grouped By date, `phRecPhotosQuiet` held through the
  reload so nothing jumps; Undo in the one toast).
- **The standard chips:** `.ph-gal-chip` (All · Unsorted · the kinds) is 32px, 6px corners, 13px, picked = solid teal (Unsorted
  picked = solid amber `--ph-low-press`, white text); the tongue **shot row** (Any shot · Natural · Flash · Sublingual · Side) is one
  joined bar that scrolls in itself on a narrow screen. Not joined: the kind chips carry counts and vary per patient, so a joined
  bar would wrap at 375px (the rule's own exception says dropdown, which would hide the counts) — they stay loose standard chips.

**Tested** (HEAD copy through `_ia-page.html`, port 8994; a seeded test patient with 9 photos on 4 dates, 1280 and 375 wide):

· Eyelid 1, 9 date chips; a date fix (22 → 23 Sep) moves the tile's chip, the toast "Moved to 23 Sep · Undo", both caches and the

## Colour audit (2026-11-02): black for text, 2-3 colours for the UI, the rest as accents
Her ask: "audit all app pages and keep design to - black for text, 2-3 colours for ui, and other colors kept as accents".
**Measured** on her live computer (build 20261102-133700, read-only `getComputedStyle` of every visible element): 19 sidebar
pages, 16 patient surfaces, 11 Me pages. Words carried colour all over the app: teal-deep headings and chip words (Inventory 128,
Photos 509, Patient directory 165 `.ph-load-btn`), the active sidebar label, red cycle chips and condition badges on every list row,
gold flags and priority notes (Medical history 24 + 25), blue plan bands and restock pills, the Case colour on every ‹ and tab line,
a second black (`#000`, the 43 Medical history question labels), C22's own greys on Fitness. Report:
`colour-audit-2026-11-02.md` (scratchpad); mock `colour-audit-mock-2026-11-02.html` (Today | A for six questions, plus the
no-question strip). **Her 8 picks (popups):** 1 KEEP the Case-coloured patient rail; 2 KEEP the solid calendar blocks; 3 state words
in black + a dot (not coloured words); 4 KEEP the dark heads and cards (Suppliers, Dispense history, Dosage & price, the herbs head,
the dark bands); 5 Fang Bing Ren trait bars one teal, the leader in gold; 6 KEEP All templates' coloured groups; 7 LEAVE the Guide;
8 gold = counts + the one gold card.
**The law (CLAUDE.md Theme):** words are ink (`--ph-ink` / `-soft` / `-faint`), white only on a surface she kept dark; the UI is
teal + white + gold (teal for lines, fills and the picked state; gold for counts and the one primary disc); every other colour is a
mark, never a word: a 6px dot before a state word, a 3px stripe on a band, a stroke on a chart. Nothing suggests, nothing shouts.
**Built, two layers, all inside the main `<style>`:** (1) a sweep (`ca-ink.pl`, scratchpad, deterministic): every `color:` that named
a teal, status or Case token (39 tokens; herb-deep 551, green-deep 405, herb 200, zero-deep 138, gold-deep 135, low-press 106 …)
now reads `--ph-ink`, EXCEPT a glyph pseudo-element, a rule whose own background is a solid dark or status colour (687 left alone)
and a selector in a container she kept dark (495: the dispense band, the treatment hero, `ph-struct`, journey tiles, nav, pres band,
topbar, cockpit, calendar blocks, event rows …); every STATE selector that lost a status colour (110, class names such as
`.low .zero .late .due .stale .draft .stopped .over .todo .better`) gets the same 6px dot before its word, dot colour = the old token's
family. (2) one hand block "COLOUR AUDIT 2026-11-02" before `</style>`: the `.ph-fit` C22 tokens remapped to LCM's (and the 22
Fitness rules that gave WORDS the C22 green → ink; the ring, the plate button and the ± marks keep it); `.ph-hx-qlabel` ink; tinted
state pills and chips (`.ph-pill.low/.draft/.stale/.make/.restock`, `.ph-cycle-chip`, `.ph-cond-badge`, `.ph-reloc-chip`,
`.ph-load-btn.warn`, To order's `.ph-ost-bdg.amber/.red`, the Dashboard's `.pill.empty/.low` — EMPTY was white on solid red) →
white + hairline + ink + dot; `.ph-ds-band.*` → paper + a 3px state stripe; `.ph-shell-qa-badge` gold with ink, `.ph-pill.count`
gold-tint; words on kept dark surfaces stay `--ph-struct-lbl` / white (`.ph-tp-hero .gold`, `.ph-dsp-band .add`); the Dashboard's
urgent task button solid teal (was solid red); FBR bars `--ph-herb` with an nth-of-type fade, `.lead` gold, `.ph-fbr-t-lab.hi` white;
the patient flow rail's done-step tick ink on its gold circle (white on gold measured 2.1:1); `.srctag` (made-in-house tag, cream wash
KEPT by her word) ink letters; `.ph-count-btn` ink (had the browser's black); a picked cell in a light shell top block ink; To
order's lit count badge ink on gold. Outlined buttons' words go ink with the sweep (teal stays on their lines); an icon drawn in
`currentColor` follows its words.
**Kept on purpose** (her picks or the law's accents): the Case colour on the patient rail, ‹ and tab lines; solid calendar blocks;

## A prescription record with no herb list no longer crashes the open script (2026-11-02)
Seen 2026-11-02 in a localhost sandbox copy of HEAD (build 20261102-150700), not on her data: a patient whose prescription record
had no `ingredients` array (a test patient made with `phPatientRec` plus a hand-made record saved through `savePresc()`), opened
from the Patient profile list, past the no-plan gate's Skip for now, then the Dispense stage: `Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read
properties of undefined (reading 'map')` in `presIngredientsEditorHtml` ← `renderPresPanelCore` ← `renderPresPanel` ← the
`[data-pres-stage]` click, and the panel stayed half drawn.
- **The array:** `t.ingredients` on the record in `PRESC.items`, the herb lines that the Dispense editor's plain-list textarea,
  its "N herbs · Ng" summary and `presEditMatchStatic` map, count and filter. That record was never given one.
- **The app's own doors all write it:** `presNewDraft()` (`ingredients: []`) behind + New (`presStartNew`), Create patient
  (`presCreateNewPatient`), the appointment import's new-account draft, the intake apply (`phIntakeReviewApply`) and a phase's
  script (`phTpEnsurePhaseScript`); the prescription form's Save and the scheduled dispense's Build new write the literal. Nothing
  to change there: a record without the list can only come from outside (a hand-made test record, an older or foreign backup).
  The same gap bit Formula refill on 2026-10-23 (`refSuggestRecipe`, guarded then).
- **Where the default belongs: on the record, set at the one door every way into the panel uses.** `presOpenScript` (the list
  row, `data-pres-open`, `presGoToScript` all end there) now gives a record with no list an empty one
  (`if (t && !Array.isArray(t.ingredients)) t.ingredients = []`, saved with the record's next save), so the editor, the autosave
  (`presCommitTemplateFields` reads `t.ingredients.length` on the first keystroke), Save & log (`presSavePrescription`) and the
  letters (`phLtrCtx`) all read a list. The editor itself also reads through a local `ings = t.ingredients || []`
  (`presIngredientsEditorHtml`, `presEditMatchStatic`): a renderer never throws on a record's shape. Three functions, nothing else.
**Tested (a sandbox copy on port 8997, fresh storage, 1220 × 900, one made-up "Zz" patient, no sign-in, real clicks):** the
untouched HEAD copy throws exactly the reported error on the Dispense stage (here the flow buttons, Today's visit and the others,
drew without it); the patched copy, with the same bare record read back from storage: list row → Skip for now → Today's visit →
Dispense, no error, the Ingredients editor with "No ingredients yet."; then two lines typed in the plain list → the autosave kept
both (`t.ingredients` 2, 15 g, the herb table's rows, "2 of 2 not in the inventory" since the sandbox has no herbs); console
clean. **Not tested:** her real records (no bare record is known there), the phone, the Refill side sheet (`#refPresPanel`, the
same door). **Seen, not changed:** Formula refill's lists read `r.ingredients.length` on a FORMULA record before any open
(`presIsFormula(r) && r.ingredients.length`, several places); a bare formula record would still throw there.
**Integration:** the fact is the record's own list, read by every page through the open door; walked in the sandbox on the
bare record: the Patient profile list, Today's visit, Dispense. Not pushed; live only on her "push live".

Her screenshot of the Meals rings + "when i hover, show breakdown of foods that contributed to hte macro". Built at once (a
competence call, her "table first" taste): pointing at the kJ, protein, carbs or fat ring (not Fasting), a Numbers cell, a Table
kJ · P · C · F cell or a Grid Total number opens one box under it (above when there is no room).
- **The box** (`phMacBkHtml`): the number, "+ N planned" (today), "of" her goal; a row a food, most first, had then planned (pale,
  the ring's own pale): the food with its amount, its meal (Breakfast · Lunch · Dinner · Snack · Drink, `phMacSlW`), a bar of its
  share, the amount, the %; past 12 rows (and crumbs under 1) one "+ N more" row (a single one shows itself, "<1 g"); "Not counted ·
  …" for what could not count it (Eating out, a dish with no numbers, C22's logged numbers for kJ / carbs / fat).
- **One read** (`phMacFoods`): `phDietSum` now also returns `rows` ({nm, sl, x, v}: each thing's own numbers), its items carry their
  meal (`phDietMyDay`, `phMplPlanSum`: [v, nut, sl], snacks "s"); had = `phDietMyDay`'s rows; today and a day to come add
  `phMplPlanSum`'s rows for meals not in the had list = planned. The same rows the ring adds up, never a second sum. Whole numbers by
  largest remainder: the had rows add up to the ring's number, the planned ones to "+ N planned", the % to 100 (first draft showed
  45 + 19 + … = 85 of 83).
- **The box's life** (`#phMacBk`, `phMacBkShow` / `phMacBkHide`, `data-mac-bk="day|number"`): 150 ms after the pointer lands; the
  record's colour copied from the ring (`--ph-mac-c/pl/tr`); any other point, a tap elsewhere, a scroll or Esc closes it; the goal
  field never opens it. A phone: a tap on a ring opens it, a tap elsewhere closes it.
- **Tested** (test copy, made-up meals: Break Fast had, Lunch past its time with an Eating out item, a snack, Dinner still planned;
  yesterday; tomorrow): every ring today / yesterday / tomorrow / an empty day (the rows add up to the ring, % 100, "Not counted · Out ·
  Thai larb", "Nothing planned yet"); hover on the ring (1000 wide), a Numbers cell, a Grid Total; the goal field closes it; a phone
  tap opens it under the rings, a tap elsewhere closes it; console clean. Pictures `shots/meals-ring-breakdown-2026-11-02.jpg`,
  `shots/meals-ring-breakdown-phone-2026-11-02.jpg`. **Not tested:** her real meals, her devices.
- **Integration (★★):** the rings, Numbers, Table and Grid numbers share one box and one read (`phDietSum` rows); the Diet / More
  lines and Targets bars are untouched.

## Calendar click: my event OR a patient (2026-11-02)
Her ask, with a picture of the click card ("David Dinh" typed, the Lease invoice preset, New "David Dinh"): "how do i know if i
am adding personal event or patient?", then "show me mock", then: "i am referring to when i click the calendar, how do i add
personal events vs patients". Her newest word wins over 1 Nov's pick 7 (Me only): the click now offers both. **Mock:**
`event-card-wording-mock-2026-11-02.html` (Today | A one card with a switch | B one box, both lists | C ask first; the cards copy
the real `.ph-qk` styles). **Her 8 picks (two popups, every one the recommended option):** 1 A, one card with a My event |
Patient bar; 2 opens on My event; 3 a patient row = Name · last visit; 4 the dragged length, else 30 min; 5 "New patient" books
the name only (like Quick add); 6 a Home visit chip on the Patient side; 7 Repeat stays in Add appointments; 8 before typing, her
recent patients.
**Built** (all in the click card's code, "QUICK ADD · A CLICK ON A FREE TIME", and its CSS): the card's state gets `side`
(ev | pat), `home`, `len`; the list view shows the card's own `.qk-bar` as `.qk-side` (My event | Patient, icons i-cal / i-user)
under the time; the event side's box says "Search my events" and its new row "New event “…”". The Patient side
(`phQkPatListHtml`): a Patient name box; before typing, RECENT = the last ten people seen (`phQkPatients()`: every name from her
prescriptions, her bookings (never a Break) and her records, last visit = the latest past booking or `phLastVisitKey`); typing
searches them all (starts-with first, then most recent), with "New patient “…”" when no name matches; a row = the patient's Case
colour dot (`phQkPatDot`: gynae / MSK via `phCaseAccentClass` of `phApptScriptFor`, else teal), the name, "last visit 28 Oct" or
"new"; chips (32px): Home visit (on = solid teal) and the length (30 min; a tap cycles 15 · 30 · 45 · 60 · 90 and clears a dragged

Her ask, on a picture of her Meals cells (5:30 am ↻ 250 ml milk / 1 Matcha Latte · Medium; 7:53 pm had it 2 eggs / 250 ml milk): "when i
hover over food i want to see what percentage of my daily macros that food will take up - know what i mean? show me mock". Mock
`food-share-hover-mock-2026-11-02.html` (artifact 1MXaKwmS7yqrum1wnyHDT9, real pictures from a temp prototype). Her picks: box **B Bars**
(she asked "show me" first: the popup's drawn previews did not count, the mock was not yet open on her screen; labelled pictures + the
mock opened, then B); **this food only**; % of **her day's goal**; **all four places** (the table's foods, the open meal, the list before
adding, snacks · drinks); **A** point at the meal = the whole meal; **A** kJ and carbs red past 100%; phone **A** a line under each food;
"Yes, build it".
- **Box:** the rings' own box (`#phMacBk`, `.ph-mac-bk` + class `fs`, 320 px): header = the food with its amount (`phMealName`) and, on
  the right, its meal + " · had" / " · planned" / " · usual", "not added yet", Snack or Drink, or for a meal "N foods · planned"; then a
  table kJ · Protein · Carbs · Fat: amount, a bar of its share (3% least, full at 100%), the %. "<1%" under half a percent, "–" when a
  food has no number. kJ or carbs past 100% (`PH_MAC_RD`, rounded) = the bar `i.rd` red (`--ph-zero`); the words stay ink.
- **Targets** (`data-mac-bk`, read by the rings' mouseover / `phMacBkShow`): `f|day|meal|n` a food line in a Meals table cell
  (`phMplCellHtml`, the food = `phMealShown(v)[n]`), `m|day|meal` the cell button = the whole meal (`phDietSum([[v, had ? had.nut :
  null]])`), `s|day|n` a snack · drink chip (`phMplSnackHtml`, with its own nut), `x|day|meal|food` a row of the open meal
  (`phMealRowHtml`, only where it shows kJ), `a|food` a row of + Food's list (Everyday / Drinks / Menus food rows + My dishes;
  `phMlkShareAt`, on only when the list is hers: `!c.pt` in `phMealAddHtml`, `!box.dataset.mlkPt` in `phMealMenuFill`). Each amount is
  `phDietSum([[x]]).t`, the same sum the rings add, against `phDietGoal()`.
- **Titles moved:** a target never also carries a `title` (two tips at once): the close-match / reaction words (`phFoodTipAt`,
  `phRxTip`), the cell's "Drag to copy to another day" and the chip's "Tap to remove" become `data-mac-tip`, shown as a soft line
  under the box. Cells and chips without a box (phone, an empty or skipped meal) keep their old title.
- **Phone (≤ 640, no hover):** no food-share attributes at all, so a tap never opens the box; the open meal shows one line under each
  food, after its repeat row: `<span class="ph-meal-fs"><b>16%</b> kJ · <b>19%</b> P · <b>92%</b> C · <b>5%</b> F</span>` (`phMacFsLine`;
  a small red dot before a % past 100 on kJ or carbs). Rule in the meal-row block (class-based, outside media queries).
- Code: "FOOD SHARE" (6 places): `phMacFsOf`, `phMacFsPc`, `phMacFsRows`, `phMacFsHtml`, `phMacFsLine`; `phMacBkShow` builds a target
  matching `^[fmsxa]\|` with them and returns when it has no numbers; the ring box is unchanged (class `fs` off).
**Tested** (test copy, goals 8000 kJ · P 50 · C 50 · F 170): at 1220 the Matcha Latte · Medium box 1,259 kJ 16% · 9 g 19% · 46 g 92% ·
8 g 5% under its line; the Breakfast cell 2 foods 1,954 kJ 24% · 18 g 36% · 60 g 120% (red bar) · 17 g 10% + "Drag to copy to another
day"; dinner's had egg "Dinner · had"; the open meal's rows; + Food's Banana "not added yet" 479 kJ 6% · 24 g 48% · 0 g <1% with the
close-match words under it; a snack chip "Snack" + "Tap to remove"; the ring box as before; no element with both a title and a box. 375:
the line under each food ("9% kJ · 17% P · 28% C · 5% F", "16% kJ · 19% P · 92% C · 5% F"), no food-share attribute, no box on a tap,
no sideways scroll. Prescriptions search: Jane narrows, Zzqx none, clear returns. Console clean. **Not tested:** her real Meals page
and goals, a touch laptop, her devices.
**LIVE** 2026-11-02 in build 20261102-193700 (publish 5edfa514, her "Push live"; mock moved to mocks/). Her devices need the gold Update.

same family or just formula comparison - hep design this thoroughly. show mock", then mid-turn: "also include formula ingredients and
dosages integrated with the inventory formulas - i want to see this so its correct and i want to see whats missing from my inventory".
**Measured first:** the Gui Zhi family's seven Ren tables make 99 rows (76 in one formula only, 20 with a Key); the card's "Compare
with…" put a badge on ONE card's rows, two formulas at a time, no ingredients. Her inventory (27 Oct copy): 302 jars, 81 of them formula
jars; 64 formula recipes among her prescriptions; the classical recipes = `PH_HU_SRC` (DRAFT). **Mocks** (root until live, then
`mocks/`): `formula-compare-mock-2026-11-02.html` (Today | A one table of dots, a Compare tab | B heat cells | C Ren and Bing side by
side | phone), then on her word "can you try putting the symptom in the cell e.g. skin row fair in gui zhi cell" `formula-compare-mock-D-
2026-11-02.html` (D1 words with dots | D2 words only), then on her "put the same signs on the same line e.g. complexion pale for all
columns is the same ... list the signs in alphabetical order. show mock before building" `formula-compare-mock-D3-2026-11-02.html`
(D3 | D3b). **Her 16 picks (four popups, memory project_lcm_formula_compare_2026_11_02):** 1 D3b: inside a category one line per sign,
A to Z, the sign named once on the left and its words + dots in every column that weighs it; 2 a Compare tab in the Guide, a Compare
chip on each family head and the card's Compare with… open it pre-loaded; 3 a herb cell = the classic's dose over her recipe's grams;
4 a dose is judged by its share of the formula (amber past a quarter off); 5 dots, the Guide's notation; 6 Tells open first; 7 one
Ren | Bing | Both bar; 8 missing = marks in the table + a count line with Missing only and Can make now; 9 a built-in stand-in list,
DRAFT; 10 a body type's herbs column = its base formula's recipe; 11–12 (asked with 1–2) the same shape and tab; 13 a Tell = a 4 or 5
in one formula and a blank in another; 14 several recipes for one formula = Recipe ▾ in the column head; 15 Can make now = every herb
stocked, none out or stopped (low and phasing out still count); 16 Copy as text.
**Built** (one hand block "Guide · Compare" after the `.gf-cmpb` rules, the module "方病人 Guide -- Compare" right before
`renderPhGuidePage`, the phone rules at the top of the big 640px block):
- The Guide's tabs are Families · **Compare** · Tongue map · Pulse · Herbs · Blood tests (`renderPhGuidePage`); `phGdBodyHtml` draws
  `phCmpHtml()`; the one search box filters both tables ("Search a sign or herb"). The delegated click / input / keydown / change handlers
  call `phCmpClick` / `phCmpInput` / `phCmpKey` / `phCmpChange` right after the Families tab's.
- **Picker** (`.ph-cmp-pick`): Family ▾ (`PH_REN_FAM_GROUPS`, loads the herb + its formulas + `also`), one chip per formula in its shade
  (a tap takes it out), "Add a formula" (a list of matches while she types, Enter adds the first, Esc clears), Clear. **Entry points:**
  a Compare chip on each family head of the Families mosaic (`cardOf`, `data-cmp-fam`, families with more than one formula) and the
  card's Compare with… select (`phGdfChange` → `phCmpOpen([card, picked])`; its row badges no longer paint).
- **Signs** (`phCmpSignRows`, `phCmpSignsTableHtml`): one row per sign key across the picked formulas from `phGdfRows` (so her Guide
  edits count), grouped by the category of `phSignLabel` in the sign pool's own order (`phCmpCatOrder`), A to Z inside; the sticky
  first column names the category once and each line's sign faintly; a cell = the Guide's dots in the formula's deep shade + the words,
  bold at 5, red dots when against; filter chips All · Key · Shared · Tells · Unique with counts (`phCmpSignFilter`; a Tell =
  `phCmpIsTell`); Ren | Bing | Both (Both = the Ren table then the Bing table); "Shared by all n" above the table on Tells.
- **Herbs** (`phCmpCol`, `phCmpHerbRows`, `phCmpHerbsTableHtml`): a column = the formula's classical recipe (`phHuFormulas()` by
  name; a body type's = `PH_CMP_BASE`), her recipes (`PRESC.items` + `presIsFormula`, matched on the name before any bracket; Recipe ▾
  when several; `phCmp.pick`), her formula jar (`PHARMACY.herbs` + `phIsFormula`, the live one first); rows = the union of the classics'

  (a stand-in from `PH_CMP_STANDIN` lands on the classic's line with a blue dot; the rest = "In your recipe only"); a row's jar = the
  live jar first (`phCmpJarRank`: stocked or low, phasing out, untracked, empty, stopped), the one her recipe names among equals, then

the "No classical recipe" words, the Key2's height. **Trap met:** a sandbox on a reused port serves a STALE copy through the old

## Meal photos (2026-11-02)
Her ask: "add a function where i can attach photos to my meals", and mid-round "allow for multiple photos of meal". Mock
`meal-photos-mock-2026-11-02.html` (artifact UErrauw5V4PmUvKPoCCAQQ; real pictures of her test Meals with drawn stand-in food
photos). Her picks: 1 for = all three (what I really ate · add the foods later · show someone); 2 table = **A small photo** beside
the foods; 3 computer = **A Photo tile**; 4 phone = **A Camera · Photos**; 5 a photo **ticks Had it at the photo's time**; 6 seeing =
**big view AND a Photos view**; 7 snacks · drinks **too**; 8 **just hers**; 9 no foods yet = **Add foods mark**; 10 **Share in the
big view**; "Yes, build it".
- **Kept:** her own record's photo store (`lcm-ren-photos`), `{ kind: "meal", meal: b|l|d|s, dateKey, takenAt, srcSize, srcMtime }`,
  shrunk like every photo (`phRenCompressToBlob`, her 1600 / 0.85), bytes held at pick time (`phRenHold`). The photo's time = the
  file's (a camera photo: now). A re-pick of the same file (or same size, day and meal) is skipped: "Already on this meal".
- **Out of her Photos pages:** `phRenLoadPhotosFor` and `phRecPhotosLoad` drop kind "meal", so her own record's Photos, the
  Comparison table and Records → Photos never see them. `phRenLoadPhotosFor` then reads them again for Meals (`phMealPhLoad`), so
  every add, delete, Undo and phone import repaints Meals. `phRenDeletePhotosWithUndo` finds them in `phMealPhList()` (the one undo).
- **Relay:** `phCapRelayPath(…, meal)` adds `_m<slot>`; push, retry and backfill pass `rec.meal` (backfill sends type "meal", not
  "other"); `phCapAutoImport` accepts type "meal" (not a `PH_REN_PHOTO_TYPES` kind, so no kind list grows) and files `meal` from
  `_m<slot>`. `PH_REN_BACKUP_FIELDS` + `meal`, `takenAt`.
- **Table (`phMplCellHtml`):** class `ph` + `.ph-mph-th` (40 px, +N), a second grid column; a narrow table (`.ph-mpl-body:has(>
  .ph-mpl-col)`: a meal or day open; the Grid's `.ph-mpl-t.blk`) puts it under the foods at 32 px (first build squeezed the names
  letter by letter with the picker open). Photo, no foods: `.ph-mph-nf` "Add foods" (gold dot) + the photo. Snacks: `phMealPhSnHtml`.
- **Open meal:** `phMealPhRowHtml(day, sl)` under the header of `phMplPickHtml` (not on Every <meal>), the snack picker and both
  states of `phMealCardHtml`; 72 px photos, + Photo (`data-mph-add`, drop on it) / phone chips Camera (`capture`) · Photos (`multiple`).
- **Had it:** `phMealHadSet(day, sl, v, at0)`; `phMealPhHad` after a save and from `phMealListPut` when foods arrive on a meal with a
  photo; never a day to come, a Skipped meal, or a meal with no foods.
- **Big view:** `#phMealPhView` + `#phMealPhBd` (direct children of #pharmacyPage), `phMealPhRender`; ‹ › / ← → over the day's meal
  photos (b, l, d, s), Esc / backdrop closes (capture listeners, so the picker under it stays); Share = `navigator.share` with the
  file on a touch screen, else Save (a download); Delete = `phAsk` then `phRenDeletePhotosWithUndo`, the view moves to the next.
- **Photos view:** `phMplLay` "ph" (button "Photos" beside Numbers), `phMplPv` while the Table draws: a 78 px photo + the first food
  (+N), a dashed camera for a meal with none. Toolbar: the week label 150 → 122 px and view buttons 12 → 10 px padding, so the row
  still holds at 1220 with Photos (it wraps, as before, when Check reads "N to answer").
- Icons `i-image`, `i-share`. Code: "MEAL PHOTOS".
**Tested** (test copy, Browser pane at 1220 and 375): photos saved through `phMealPhSave` with set file times: Lunch ticked Had it at
12:40 (its photo), Breakfast at its photo's hour, Dinner (already had) unchanged; 2 photos on Dinner = +1; a photo on yesterday's
empty Lunch read "Add foods", adding 2 eggs ticked it at 1:05 pm (the photo's time); Tue (a day to come) photo-only: Add foods, no
tick; a tap on a cell's photo opened the big view, not the meal; ‹ › and ← → walked "2 of 4 today"; Delete asked, kept the view on
the next photo, "Photo deleted · Undo" put it back; Esc closed; Photos view of last week (22 photos, 3 dashed); phone: Camera ·
Photos chips, the photos beside each meal, no sideways scroll; relay name `cap_meal_<day>_…_ml.jpg` parses back to meal "l";
her record's Photos cache and Records → Photos hold 0 meal photos; Prescriptions search: Jane narrows, Zzqx none, clear returns.
**Not tested:** a real camera or gallery on her phone, the phone → laptop relay end to end (needs her login), Share on a phone,
her real Meals. **LIVE** build 20261102-204600 (publish d16caf39); mock in mocks/.

## Compare: the same and the different, in motion (2026-11-02)
Her ask (late evening, a screenshot of the Compare signs table, Wu Ling San against Zhen Wu Tang): "in the formula sign comparison table:
add relevant animations and visuals of similarities and differences. show mock". **Measured:** the pair's Ren union is 49 rows (7 shared,
19 only Wu Ling San, 23 only Zhen Wu Tang; Key 15, Tells 26, Unique 42); the table said "same" only by two filled cells on one line and
"different" only by a blank. **Mock** `formula-compare-motion-mock-2026-11-02.html` (root until live, then `mocks/`; published to her as an
artifact): one live table on the real 49 rows, chips A Marks & tint · B Overlap bar · C Motion on change · D all three. **Her 12 picks (three
popups, memory project_lcm_compare_motion_2026_11_02), every one the recommended option:** 1 D all three; 2 a shared row = a teal tint + a
hollow teal ring before the sign; 3 a sign only one has = ghost dots (faint, hollow, the other side's count) in the empty cell; 4 both have
it, one stronger = the extra dots pulse once; 5 a filter chip = the rows that stay slide to their new place, leavers fade, newcomers fade in;
6 a column head tap fades the rows that formula lacks, tap again resets; 7 a new comparison = the dots light up in sequence, once; 8 quick
(slide .28 s, pulse .55 s, fade .16 s); 9 the overlap bar above the table for two formulas, a tap filters; 10 a shared-share bar under every
column head; 11 one mark per sign on the category line; 12 the Herbs table gets the same marks and motion.
**Built** (the hand block "Guide · Compare, the same and the different" after the Compare CSS; the `phCmp*` module):
- `phCmpSignsTableHtml`: a row is `tr.sh` (two or more have it) or `tr.un`, carries `data-k` + `data-has` (the columns that have it) and
  `--r` (its place, capped at 25, for the light-up order); the sticky cell is `.nmr` = `phCmpMark(has, cols, "mk")` (ring `.mk.sh`, or `.mk.u`
  in the shade, `phCmpDeep(col)` reads `--deep` from `phGdfStyle`) + the name; an empty cell draws `phCmpGhost(top)` (`.sg.gh`, opacity .32,
  hollow dots in the column's shade, as many as the row's strongest side); `phCmpDots(w, from)` gives every dot `--i` and class `x` to the
  dots above the weaker side's level on a shared row; the category line carries `.comp` marks; each head is `th[data-cmp-foc=i]` with a
  `.mini` bar (`share(i)` = the share of this formula's signs that another picked formula also weighs); two formulas get `.ph-cmp-ovl` above
  the table: three `button[data-cmp-filter]` segments (`only:0`, `shared`, `only:1`, `--w` to scale, `--u` the shade) and the labels under
  them. `phCmpSignFilter` knows `only:<i>`; the chips bar shows no chip on for it (the bar's segment is the picked state).
- `phCmpHerbsTableHtml`: the same `tr` attributes (the row's mark counts the classics that hold the herb; an "In your recipe only" row counts
  her recipes), the same head tap, `data-side="h"`.
- `phCmpPaint(mode)`: `"new"` redraws and adds `.in` to every row and to the tables and bar (the dots fill in sequence, the bars grow once);
  `"filter"` measures every row's top, draws the new card into a detached div, marks leavers `.out` (160 ms fade), then swaps the card in,
  keeps each `.ph-cmp-wrap`'s scroll, slides the stayers from their old place (`translateY` → `.mv`, armed by a 16 ms timer, not rAF, so a
  hidden tab never holds a row displaced) and fades newcomers `.in`; `"focus"` toggles `.dim` / `.foc` in place from `data-has`; no mode =
  a plain redraw. `phCmpRowId` scopes a row by its table (`r:`, `b:`, `h:`). `phTpReduceMotion()` turns the filter motion and the entrance
  classes off; the CSS block ends with the reduced-motion rules. A family pick, a chip's ✕, an add (list or Enter), a side change =
  `"new"`; a filter chip, the bar, Missing only, Can make now, Recipe ▾ and the search box (`phCmpPaintFilter` in the Guide search handler) =
  `"filter"`; a head tap = `"focus"`; `phCmp.focus` resets whenever the formulas change and is never saved. `phCmpOpen` paints `"new"` after
  `renderPhGuidePage`.
- A–Z (her same-day rule, `phAz`): the Family dropdown, the "Add a formula" list (starts-with first), the signs inside a category and the
  category tie-break. The legend reads "faint dots = not in this formula · ◯ both have it · ● only this one".
**Tested** (sandbox on port 8998, her 27 Oct jars + recipes + one made-up patient; 1280 and 375): Gui Zhi family → 7 columns, 59 Tells = 22
rings + 37 dots, 320 ghost cells, 7 head bars (48 · 15 · 50 · 80 · 58 · 37 · 64 %), no overlap bar (7 formulas), herbs 10 rings + 13 dots;
the pair Wu Ling San · Zhen Wu Tang → the bar 38.8 | 14.3 | 46.9 % with "Only Wu Ling San 19 · Shared 7 · Only Zhen Wu Tang 23", 7 tinted

## Compare: sign pictures on hover (2026-11-02)
Her ask (late evening, right after the motion build): "when i hoever over symptom, alow connection with relevant animation" → "hover*".
A first mock read it as threads between twin rows; her answer "no, im talking about symptom animations" and a screenshot "like this" of
the Guide's key-sign sheet (Cold & heat: dislikes wind, ‹ ›) set it right: pointing at a sign = that sign's moving picture. **Measured:**
the engine exists and is reused, never a second drawer (`phKsSvgHtml` / `phKsHas`; the Compass popover `data-ks-pop` → `phKsPopShow`,
`#phKsPop`; the Guide card's panel; the big sheet `phPxOpen` / `phPxPaint`); 46 of the pair's 49 Ren rows and 54 of its 60 Bing rows
have a picture (not water blisters, floaters, shortness of breath). **Mock** `formula-compare-pictures-mock-2026-11-02.html` (root until
live, then `mocks/`; artifact 2FyhovJpdnDzDYUwssvgmg; its pictures are the sandbox build itself, `shots/cmp-pics-a/b/c.png`): A beside
the row (the Compass way) · B a 36 × 22 still before each sign · C the Guide card's panel above the table. **Her 4 picks (memory
project_lcm_compare_pictures_2026_11_02), every one the recommended option:** 1 A, beside the row; 2 a tap opens the big picture, ‹ ›
through the compared signs that have one; 3 the phone: a tap opens it; 4 every sign with a picture (a sign without one shows nothing).
**Built** (seven fragments in the `phCmp*` module and the `phPx*` sheet):
- `phCmpSignsTableHtml`: a sign's `td.s` carries `data-ks-pop="<key>"` and `data-w="<its strongest side>"` when `phKsHas(r.k)`; the
  existing document mouseover / mouseout / focusin / scroll handlers do the rest (the one popover, 260px, after 220 ms, beside the cell,
  hidden on scroll). CSS `td.s[data-ks-pop] { cursor: pointer }` in the "Guide · Compare" block. Nothing else on the row: no thumbnail,
  no panel (her pick A).
- `phCmpPicOpen(td)` (before `phCmpClick`, which routes `.ph-cmp-tbl td.s[data-ks-pop]` to it): the sheet's list is that table's cells
  with a picture, in table order, items `{k:"kg", g:{keys:[key], sd:Set(side), w}}`; it hides the popover and calls `phPxPaint(0, "")`.
  `phPxKsGroup(it)` (after `var phPxList`) hands a carried group to `phPxItem` and `phPxTileHtml`, so the header (name · Ren / Bing
  mark · dots), the strip, ‹ ›, the arrow keys and the phone swipe work unchanged. A Bing table opens its own list with the Bing mark. The
  Herbs table has no pictures and no hover. The `data-ks-pop` click path on the phone has no pointer, so the tap is the whole feature there.
**Tested** (sandbox on port 8998, her 27 Oct jars + recipes + one made-up patient; Wu Ling San · Zhen Wu Tang; 1024 and 375): Ren, All →
49 rows, 46 `data-ks-pop` cells (weights 2–5), 0 on the Herbs table, no thumbnails, cursor pointer; pointing at "dizziness or vertigo" →
the popover beside the name cell (260 × 186, "Head: dizziness or vertigo", 15 drawn elements); a tap → the sheet "Head: dizziness or

pass", ✕ closes; Both → 46 Ren + 54 Bing cells, a Bing tap → "Pulse: weak" with the Bing mark and 54 tiles; 375 → the page no wider than
the screen, a tap opens the sheet 343px wide with ‹ › and the strip, no popover. Prescriptions search: Zz → the one made-up patient, Qq →

## Food on the photo (2026-11-02)
Her ask (right after meal photos went live): "allow option to add food eaten linked to food in photo". Mock
`food-on-photo-mock-2026-11-02.html` (artifact Vkm8efs7qB8qpSQhyddQFG; a live big view with a drawn salmon / rice / broccoli plate + 9
questions). Her picks, all A: 1 **tap the food** on the photo, the search opens there, a dot stays; 2 a **numbered dot**, name on hover;
3 under the photo **the meal's food table**, rows numbered like the dots; 4 a food typed before the photo: **Place**, then a tap; 5 its
**usual amount**, − + on its row; 6 tap a dot = − + and **Remove** (off the meal, Undo); 7 hover a dot = **its Food share**; 8 the
**phone the same**, the search from the foot; 9 dots **only in the big view**; "Yes, build it".
- **Kept:** on the meal's own entry (her Me row, so it syncs): `d.meals["<day>|<slot>"].pins = {<photo>: {<food>: [x, y]}}`, x · y = 0–1
  of the photo. <photo> = `phMealPhPid(r)` = `r.srcId || r.id`: a phone's photo keeps its id on her computer because the relay name now
  carries it (`phCapRelayPath(…, meal, rid)` → `…_<rand>_r<id>_m<slot>.jpg`; push, retry and backfill pass it; `phCapAutoImport` reads
  `/_d[^_]+_[a-z0-9]+_r([a-z0-9]+)_m[blds]\.jpg$/` into `srcId`, strict so a random part starting with r is never read as an id; the
  old build's `/_m([blds])\.jpg$/` still matches). `PH_REN_BACKUP_FIELDS` + `srcId`. <food> = `phMealBase(x)`; a snack: "@" + its `at`.
  A dot whose food left the meal is kept and not drawn (Undo brings it back with the food).
- **One save, one Undo:** a tap on the photo sets `phMealPhPend` {key, photo, x, y, the meal's foods now}; `phMealSave` calls
  `phMealPhPinIn(d, now)` after its change: the food the meal did not have before (a snack: the item saved at `now`) gets its dot in that
  same save, so the toast's Undo (its snapshot is taken before) takes the food and the dot back together. Then `phMealPhPopEnd` puts
  back the `phMealPk` the planner's picker had (the search borrows `phMealPk`, so the Add list's own row taps, Enter for her own words,
  Thisbowl and dishes all work unchanged). A save that adds nothing (− +, another meal) leaves the dot waiting.
- **The big view (`phMealPhRender`):** the photo in `.ph-mph-pw` (the dots' frame, `data-mph-pw`; img max 60vh / 55vh on a phone, the
  food table scrolls under it), dots `.ph-mph-pin` (32px white, ink number, gold ring when lit or open; `fresh` drops in), the table =
  `phMealTblHtml(lid, vs, true, ph)` → `phMealRowHtml(lid, x, kj, ph)` (new 4th arg: the number circle `.ph-mph-nb`, Place `.ph-mph-plc`
  in place of − + when no dot, no ✕ in a card); snacks `phMealPhSnRowHtml`. The search `.ph-mph-pop` = `phMealAddHtml(phMealPk, vs)` (a
  snack: `phMealPickHtml`), search field first, its rows once she types (`.q`), then the meal's foods with no dot here (`data-mph-here`,
  one tap = a dot on the spot); no Done / + New in it. It grows from the spot (down from the top half, up from the lower half:
  `phMealPhPlaceEl`), so typing never runs it off the card. A dot's card `.ph-mph-pc`: its row (− +, kJ) + Remove (`data-meal-rm`, so
  MEAL REPEATS asks as in the table) + ✕. Hover: a dot carries the row's `data-mac-bk` (`x|day|slot|food`, a snack `s|day|i`), so the
  one Food share box shows; a row lights its dot and a dot its row. Esc closes the search / card / Place first, then the view; ← → never
  step while she types. Phone (PHONE REDESIGN block): the search is a sheet from the foot, lifted over the keyboard (`phMealPhKb`,
  visualViewport → `--ph-mph-kb`).
- **Fixed on the way:** the planner's tap-away closed its picker (and `phMealPk`) for a tap inside the big view: `#phMealPhView` joins its
  exceptions. `phMealRepaint` and `phMealCardRepaint` repaint the big view; `phMealPhPaint` waits while she types in it. The MEAL PHOTOS
  state is `var` now (read by `phMealSave` from anywhere).
**Tested** (test copy, Browser pane at 1220 by DOM, headless Edge pictures at 1220 and 375): Place on Eggs then a tap = dot 1 saved on
the meal (`pins[photo]["food:egg"]`); a tap at a spot opened the search beside it, "toast" listed the toasts, Wholemeal toast went in at 2
slices with dot 3 in one save, the search closed, `phMealPk` back to null and the planner's open Lunch picker still open; Undo took
banana and its dot back together; a dot's card: + made 3 slices, Remove took it off with Undo, Undo put both back; hover a dot = the Food
share box (z above the view) and its row lit, hover a row lit its dot; Esc closed the card, then the search, then the view; ← in the
search did not step; a snack photo: "banana" picked = a snack + dot "@<time>"; Breakfast (photo 7:40, no foods): banana on the photo
ticked Had it at 7:40; Broccoli (in the meal, no dot) listed under the search, one tap = dot 3; phone 375: the sheet at the foot, no
sideways scroll, rows fit; relay names parse (with id, without id, a random part starting with r); Prescriptions search: Jane narrows,
Zzqx none, clear returns. **Not tested:** a real phone (touch, keyboard lift), the relay end to end with ids, her real Meals. **LIVE** build 20261102-214600 (publish df157b5b); mock in mocks/.

## Fasting dial (2026-11-02)
Her ask (late evening, a screenshot of the Meals rings' fasting ring "7:18 · Fasting · of Breakfast ▾ · → 7 am"): "make this stand out
more and give it interactive elements to show how many hours ive fasted adn how many more to go - show mock". **Measured:** the ring was
`phMplFastRingHtml` / `phMplDayFastRingHtml`, 64px like kJ · P · C · F (so it did not stand out), moved each minute by `phMplLive`
(`data-mpl-fring`) and `phFastTick` (`data-fast-hm`); on a phone 44px with the goal hidden. **Mock** `fasting-ring-mock-2026-11-02.html`
(app root until live, then `mocks/`; artifact V4iAacsGHcTKCLrU7QQpYp): Now · A Hour ring · B Night dial · C Hour bar, each on a computer
and a phone, with a mock clock (7:19 in · 12 h · 7 am · past 7 am, Next hour). **Her 4 picks (memory project_lcm_fasting_dial_2026_11_02):**
1 **B · Night dial** (the recommended was A); 2 the hours fasted big, **a tap swaps** to the hours to go; 3 **a gold pop once** when an hour
fills; 4 the **phone the same** as the computer.
**Built** (the "FASTING DIAL" block before `phMplFastRingHtml`, ten fragments):
- `phMplDialOf(k, f)`: the fast a dial draws, "now" = the running one (`phFastActive`, `phFastGoal`), a day = the fast that ended that day
  (`phMplDayFast`, which now also returns its start `s`: the logged fast's, or the last thing she ate the day before); s, g, h, run, met, lg.
- `phMplDialInner(m, k)` draws a 150 × 150 face: the track, 24 hour ticks (every 6th longer) and 12a / 6a / 12p / 6p, the fast one piece an
  hour from its start's clock angle (`phFdPt`, `phFdArc`; 0.9° gaps): done `--ph-herb`, to go `--ph-mac-pl`, met all `--ph-good`; the running
  hour part-filled; a gold dot = now (running only); a white ring where the goal lands (until met); a transparent hit arc an hour
  (`data-mac-bk="q|<day>|<i>"`, a faint band on hover) and the middle (`q|<day>|f`, `data-mpl-fswap` while it runs to its goal); the middle's
  big number = fasted, or to go after her tap (`phMplFswap`, localStorage `lcm-mpl-fswap`, this device). A goal over 24 h: the hours round
  a plain face (no ticks or clock words).
- `phMplDialV(m)`: the line under the dial, the number the middle is not showing ("8:36 to go" / "7:19 fasted"; past the goal "✓ goal +0:30").
- `phMplDialPaint(el, live)`: repaints one dial in place (the svg's inside and its line); on the minute's tick (`phMplLive`, which now
  repaints `svg[data-mpl-dial='now']`) an hour that just filled gets `.pop` (gold, wider, 0.8 s, `phTpReduceMotion` skips it); a box open
  on the dial is shown again from the new piece.
- `phMplDialBk(at)`: the box, in the rings' one box (`phMacBkShow` gains `fq` beside `fs`; `.ph-mac-bk.fq` 280px): an hour (Hour n of m,
  its clock times and day, a dot + done / now · n left / starts in n, or for a past fast ended h / not reached), or the fast (fasted, to go
  or ✓ goal, %, Started, Breakfast or Goal, This week n planned · aim; a past one: logged or from your meals, Started, Ended, Breakfast).
- `phMplFastRingHtml(days, ph)` and `phMplDayFastRingHtml(k, tk)` draw the dial (`phMplDialSvg`); a phone's Stop / Start / Continue
  last fast go beside it (`.fb`) and `phMplRactsHtml(past, ph)` leaves them out; the call in `phMplHtml` passes `phone`.
- The swap: one document click listener before the goal's change listener (`[data-mpl-fswap]`), repaints every dial in place, the big
  number fades in (`.mo-sw`).
- CSS: the block "FASTING DIAL" after `.ph-mac-rg.fa.mo-gold` (170px column, the face's parts, `.pop`, `.mo-sw`, `.fq`, the box's state
  dot `.st` with `--ph-dot`, both animations off under reduced motion); the phone in the PHONE REDESIGN block after `.ph-mpl-racts`: the
  dial on its own row (136px), its line, → 7 am and the buttons in a column beside it, the four rings under it.
**Disclosed calls:** a day not today draws a dial too (paging days keeps one shape); a past fast's "n short" now measures against that
fast's own goal (its breakfast when that is the goal; before, "short" read the hours while ✓ read the breakfast); the fast ring's day-change
sweep (`data-arc` "macfa") went with the ring, the macro rings keep theirs; while a fast runs the dial's hover title (aim · planned) moved
into the fast's box (no native tooltip over the boxes); the Fasting page's own 240px clock (Your fasts ›) is untouched, not part of her
ask; the goal field stays hidden on a phone (on Your fasts ›, as before).
**Tested** (test copy on port 8998, a made-up "me" record with a running fast to a 7 am breakfast, Browser pane + headless Edge at 1220
and 375): 16 hour pieces + the part-filled one, 16 hit arcs, 4 clock words, the line "8:15 to go" and → 7 am; pointing (the page's own
mouseover handler) at hour 6 → "Hour 6 of 16 · 8:05 pm – 9:05 pm Mon · done", at the middle → "Fasting 48% · 7:40 fasted 8:14 to go ·
Started Mon 3:05 pm · Breakfast Tue 7 am · This week 3 planned · aim 3–5"; a tap on the middle → 8:14 "to go", the line "7:40 fasted",
`lcm-mpl-fswap` = 1, the box still open; a second tap → back, the key gone; a fast moved to 7:59:54 → on the minute the same svg repainted
to 8:00 with `.pop` on hour 8 (data-hrs 7 → 8); a 16 h goal at 16:30 → all 16 pieces green, no goal ring, "✓ goal +0:30", no swap; a
breakfast goal of 25.2 h → 27 pieces round a plain face, no ticks or words; past days: Sat 31 Oct (a logged 3 pm → 7:30 am fast) → green,
16:30 fasted, ✓ goal, its box "Fasted · logged · ✓ goal · +0:30 · Started Fri 3 pm · Ended Sat 7:30 am · Breakfast Sat 7 am"; Thu 29 Oct →
12:50, ✓ goal +1:00; a day with none → the face, "–", "No fast"; phone 375: the dial row (136px) with "8:06 to go", → 7 am, Stop fast,
the four rings under it, Your fasts › after, no sideways scroll; the header clock chip read the same time. Prescriptions search: Zz → 2,
Qqx → "0 match", clear → all. Console: no app error. Pictures `shots/fasting-dial-build-*.png` (computer, hour, fast, swap, past day,
phone, phone-hour; the box held open for the picture). **Not tested:** her real fasts and devices; a real finger (taps were the page's

## Meal amounts: ¼ ½ ¾ and a typed amount (2026-11-03)
Her ask (a screenshot of an open breakfast, "Plain congee − 1 bowl +" and its food-share box): "give options to do 0.5 or 0.25 bowl
or 0.5 of things - know what i mean?". **Measured:** a meal row's − amount + (`phMealRowHtml` → `phMealAmtStep`) went by the food's
own step (`phMealStep` = `PH_FOOD[id][5]`: 662 counted foods by 1, bowls / cups / serves / plates by ½, grams by 25 / 10 / 50, ml by
50; a dish by 1 serve) and never under one step, so an egg, a banana, a menu item or a dish could not go under 1 and a bowl stopped
at ½. Amounts already stored decimals (`food:x*0.5`) and showed ¼ ½ ¾ (`PH_FRAC`). **Mock** `meal-amount-mock-2026-11-03.html`
(app root until live, then `mocks/`; artifact 8inJ7TnoeDpWC2FToXWcxu): A tap the amount (a bar) · B finer − + · C type it.
**Her picks (memory project_lcm_meal_amounts_2026_11_03):** "b and c" (both, not the recommended A); pieces ¼ · ½ · ¾; everything she
counts (eggs, fruit, buns, menu items, bowls, cups, serves, her dishes; grams and ml keep their steps).
**Built** ("MEAL AMOUNTS"):
- `phMealStepQ(x, q, dir)`: a thing she counts (any unit but g / ml, a dish too) goes by ¼ below one (1 → ¾ → ½ → ¼, never under ¼)
  and by its own step above (1 → 2 eggs, 1 → 1½ bowls), each tap landing on that step's mark (a typed 1.3 goes to 1½ or 1, then by
  ¼); g / ml exactly as before (their step, never under one step). 40 steps at most, as before. The − greys out at the floor.
- The amount is a field (`.fld`: the Field tint inside the joined − + bar, the unit after it, `phFoodUnitW` "bowl" / "bowls" / "g";
  `phFoodAmt` reads the same word). She types 0.5, .25, 1.5, ½, 1½, 1/2, 1 1/2 or 0,5 (`phMealQParse`); Enter or leaving the field
  keeps it, Esc puts back what it was (the picker or the sheet stays open); a word, 0 or over 40 steps shows the last amount again.
- One door, `phMealAmtTo(c, x, how)`, taken by − + (`phMealAmtStep`) and the field (`phMealAmtType`): a repeating food asks its days
  first (MEAL REPEATS) with the new amount in the field, as − + did.
- Leaving the field by a tap: the typed amount goes in after that tap lands (the repaint would otherwise swallow the tap:
  `phMealPtrDown`, then pointerup, with a 3 s way out); an amount field she moved to keeps the focus, its number selected.
- A dish's Made of (`phDishEdHtml`): the same steps and a field (`phDishAmtType`), the unit before the food's name.
- CSS "MEAL AMOUNTS" in place of the old `.ph-meal-step b` rule; on a phone the app's 16px input size holds (no zoom on focus).
**Disclosed calls:** a dish's Made of got the same steps and field (one stepper for one job); the field is 42px (the mock 46px) so a
row stays near its old width; a dish keeps its bare count (no "serve" word, as before); after Enter the focus leaves the field (the
row is drawn again); a typed amount may be anything over 0 (her own value wins), only − + keep the ¼ floor.
**Tested** (test copy on port 8998, `sandbox/mg-shot.html?ma=1`: today's breakfast = made-up plain congee 1 bowl, 2 eggs, 1 banana,
150 g yoghurt; Browser pane at 1220 and 375, headless Edge pictures; rebased on HEAD b038bdb1 and re-checked): banana 1 → ¾ → ½ → ¼
(− greyed) → + ½, kJ 479 → 359 → 239 → 120; congee ¼ ↔ 1 → 1½ → 2 bowls → 1½ → 1 → ¾ → ½; eggs 2 → 1 → ¾ → 1 → 2 → 3; yoghurt by its
50 g down to 50 g (− greyed) as before; typed 1½ (leaving), 1/2 (Enter), .25, 1 1/2, 0,75 taken; "abc", "0", "99" (over 20 bowls) put
back; Esc put 3 back to 1½ and the picker stayed; 180 g yoghurt; ½ egg; stored `food:cn_congee*0.75` … `food:yoghurt*180`; a typed
