## Body composition: her scan as a page (2026-11-06)

- **Her words:** "use these images to build my body composition page", with three pictures of a body scan's result sheet (a summary, a body composition list, and five body parts drawn round a figure, each with its lean and fat mass and the machine's range).
- **Where it lives.** A third view on her own Meals › Body tab: **Forecast · Over time · Composition** (`data-mbf-view="cp"`, this device's `lcm-mbf-view`; `phMbtView` and `phMbfHtml`). The Body panel over the calendar keeps its two doors (three do not fit its column).
- **The record.** A scan is one day's numbers as the machine printed them, with the machine's own ranges: `rec.body.comp = [{ d, v: { key: number }, r: { key: [low, high] }, b }]`. One write door, `phMscWrite(name, d, fn)` (`phMscSet` for one box): the scan is made on its first number, with the ranges of the scan before it, and goes with its last. The numbers (`PH_MSC_SUM`, `PH_MSC_CMP`, `PH_MSC_SEG` → `PH_MSC_F`): 20 of the sheet's summary and composition lines and lean + fat for Right arm, Left arm, Torso, Right leg, Left leg. Energy stays in kcal as the sheet prints it (kJ in the row's hover).
- **The day's reading follows the scan** (`body.readings`: `h`, `w`, `fp → f`, `smm → m`, inside `PH_BODY_LIM`), so her figure everywhere, the Body panel's ratios, the Forecast's You row, the Weight chart and the Ren's build signs (`phBodySigns`) read it. The rules, all in `phMscWrite`:
  - a number at a time, and only the number that write changed: an edit to Protein never re-stamps a weight she typed elsewhere that day;
  - set = stamped; cleared = taken back out, to what the reading held before the scan (`s.b`, kept on the scan the first time it stamps a field), and only while the reading still holds the scan's number (her own number stays); a reading left with nothing goes;
  - a later day's reading that only carried the old number forward follows it (`phBodyWrite` copies the last height, body fat and muscle into a new day, so a sheet dated before a later weigh-in would otherwise never reach the figure); it stops at the first later number that differs, and a weight is never carried (a weight is always its own measurement);
  - the newest reading of each still wins on read, so a weight she typed on a later day stays hers.
- **The page** (`phMscHtml`; CSS "MEALS BODY COMPOSITION"):
  - **Her figure** is the one body (`phMbdSvg("msc")` with `phBodyBuild` at that scan's height, weight, body fat and muscle; the Body panel's look, `PH_MBD_BOLD` now names `msc`), redrawn only when one of those four changed (`phMscFigPaint`). The **five parts** sit round it as tags with gold leads to a mark on the part (`phMscLeadSvg`, the figure's own outline points at her build): Lean and Fat, each a box, each with a dot, green inside the machine's range and amber outside (the hover says Under / Optimal / High and the range). Her right is on the left, as on every front view in the app.
  - **Summary** under the figure, **Composition** beside it (`phMscGrpHtml`): a row = the sheet's word, a box, the Blood tests' low–high bar with the range in numbers (`phBldBarHtml`, the one component), and the **change** since the scan before that has that number ("+0.5", "−1.6", "="; the hover says since when).
  - **What her weight is made of**: one bar of six parts (`PH_MSC_MADE`: Subcutaneous fat, Visceral fat, Intracellular fluid, Extracellular fluid, Protein, Mineral) with its key and kg; the colours are marks.
  - **Every number is a box** (`class="field-bare"`: the tinted row or tag is the field): saved when she leaves it, refused with words when it is outside what a body can be, and the page is painted where it stands (`phMscPaint`: the box she moved into is never rebuilt; the dot glides, the bar's parts glide; off under reduced motion). The head (its chips, Remove) is kept as a string (`phMsc.hd`) and swapped only when it changed, and never under a tap on its way to one of its buttons (`phTbPress`: the swap waits for the tap to land, the Body panel's own pattern).
  - **+ Scan**: a date and one box for the sheet's numbers, a number a line (`phMscParse`: the sheet's words or this page's, "46.9 [40.2 - 49.1]" keeps the range, a date as 2026-10-20 or 20-10-2026 sets the date box, it counts what it reads as she pastes and says how many lines it could not read). The box keeps its words through a repaint (`phMsc.txt`). The date box follows the sheet only when the sheet's date changes (`phMsc.pd`), so a date she picked stays; Save uses what the box shows; a date after today is refused. Saved empty, it opens a **blank day** to type in (`phMsc.blank`), nothing saved until the first number.
  - **More than one scan**: a chip a date, oldest first; a dropdown past six, and on a phone past four (past three when a date is of another year), which is what one line holds. **Remove** takes the scan and its numbers back out of the day's reading; the one toast's Undo puts the scan and every reading back as they were.
  - No record of hers yet: the same "No record of yours yet" flag as Over time. No scans: the page opens on the paste box.
- **Judgment calls (mine, hers to change):** (1) it is a view of the Body tab, not a page of its own; (2) the numbers go in by paste, because 30 boxes by hand is slow and her numbers must not be written into the public code; (3) the order is the sheet's own, not A–Z (a document's order); (4) her right on the left, the app's way, where the sheet may draw it mirrored; (5) left out: the sheet's food and supplement suggestions and its body balance words (the app has her own goals; a supplement list is the maker's); (6) the ranges are the machine's, never the app's, and are changed by a paste only; (7) Remove asks nothing first, it has Undo; (8) her scan now also feeds the Ren's build signs on her own record, through the reading, as any body number does.
- **Checked by three separate readers** (the data, the screen and its rules, the rest of the app), each finding traced again by another reader: 15 findings, 11 different ones, all real, all fixed before saving. The reading: a cleared number stayed in it; every edit re-stamped all four fields; a sheet dated before a later weigh-in never reached the figure; Remove could drop a reading that was there before the scan (the four rules above). The paste: Save could use a later date the box did not show; a picked date was overwritten on the next keystroke. The screen: six date chips could not fit a phone; the paste box took the app-wide 16px corners (now a Field, 6px); the phone's tags were sized for a 13px number the phone never draws (it draws 16px: measured 47.6px in a 50px box now); an empty joined bar on a first blank day; the low end's dot was cut by its cell; the head was rebuilt under a tap and, with a dropdown, on every edit. Found clean: escaping, accessible names, the colour law, side lines, the other two views, the page-wide watchers, save and sync (the same as `body.tape`).
- **Known gap, older than this:** `phPatientMerge` has no line for `rec.body`, so readings, tape and scans are all left behind when two records are merged. Not changed here.
- **Tested 2026-11-06** on a test copy built from this commit's parent in the same run, on a made-up record ("Sandbox Self", made-up numbers), by driving the real handlers: 62 checks, all passing. Paste (30 numbers, 19 ranges, the sheet's date, a line not read is counted), the reading following, a number typed (kept, rounded, same row and dot, the dot moved, the figure redrawn), a number out of range refused, a tag's dot following its range, the bar following a part, a number cleared, a second scan (ranges carried, the change column, two chips), picking the older scan, Remove and Undo, a blank day (first number makes the scan in place, last number cleared leaves the day open), a date after today, words with no numbers, Cancel, Forecast and Over time still opening, and each of the review's fixes. Pictures in headless Edge at 1500 x 1150 (one scan, two scans, the paste box) and in a 360px phone frame; at 360px no number is cut and the page does not scroll sideways. No page errors.
- **Not tested:** her own record and her real numbers (nothing of hers was written), her phone itself, a touch screen, the glide of the dot and the bar frame by frame (plain CSS transitions; their start and end values were read), two devices syncing a scan, a screen reader.
- **Pages checked:** Meals › Body (Forecast, Over time, Composition). Not opened after the change: Patient details' Body card, the Appointments Body panel and Fang Bing Ren, which read the same reading through `phBodyLatest` as before.
- **Her data is not in the code or these notes.** Every example and test number is made up.

## Guide study reference, step 1a: the study entry in a trip session (2026-11-06)

Her design (2026-11-05, 16 picks; the plan and every pick are in the memory note `project_lcm_guide_study_reference_2026_11_05`). This is step 1 of her approved order, first half: **she types on the laptop in the teacher's room** (pick 2), **one box, the time stamps itself, "New patient" turns a note into a case study** (pick 9), in a **private library that is not the clinic's data** (pick 1). The cloud copy is step 1b and is NOT built.

- **Where:** an open trip session (`phTripSesHtml`) has a new row, **Study** (`phStuBoxHtml`). The session's old Note row is drawn only while it still holds text (nothing of hers is hidden or moved; the Study box replaces it for new writing).
- **The box is only ever a new entry.** One textarea. The first keystroke makes the entry and stamps the time on the trip's clock (`phStuNow`). Joined chips **New patient** | **Return** turn the entry in the box into a case study (the picked one again = a note); **Next entry** (or Ctrl+Enter) files it and empties the box. Plain Enter is a new line. A key that belongs to Chinese typing is left alone (`isComposing`).
- **The list** under it, newest first, an entry with no time first: a time button (tap = a time field; Enter or leaving keeps it, Esc leaves it as it was; the old time goes into the entry's history), the mark (Patient / Return), the words, a ✕ (gone from the list with **Undo** on the toast; an entry over 200 characters asks first). Nothing is ever erased: ✕ sets a `del` stamp.
- **A row is changed where it sits** (`phStuEd`, `phStuEdOpen`, `phStuEdType`, `phStuEdClose`). Tapping a row's words draws its own field under its time, with its own New patient | Return pair and its ✕; the box and whatever is being typed there are not touched. Her words go into the entry in the same event. **An emptied field puts the entry back at once to the words the row had when she tapped it** (the words she typed go into its history), never a leftover letter; a row's time never changes because of its words. Esc closes (her words are kept), Ctrl+Enter closes and goes to the box. A trip rebuild in mid-sentence draws the field again from `phStuEd.draft` and `data-trip-fk` puts the cursor back. An earlier version moved a tapped row up into the one box; two independent review rounds found 15 real faults from that one choice (a row emptied key by key, Ctrl+Z, a batch saving an emptied record), so it was taken out rather than patched.
- **An entry written on another day than the session's** (a session of yesterday, or after midnight on the trip's clock) gets no time: its button says "Set time" (`live` 0 = added later; `live` 1 = written in the room).
- **The state line:** "On this laptop only · N" ("phone" at 640px and under), "One copy on this device" whenever any entry is missing one of its two copies or the store has not been read (worked out by `phStuOneSet` from `phStuMiss`, `phStuRead`, `phStuTried`; nothing sets it by hand), "Not protected from clean-up" until the browser has granted storage that it will not clear, and the chip **Back up**, which saves `LCM-study-YYYY-MM-DD.json` (`{ app: "LCM study library", exported, f: 1, recs }`, removed entries included). With the store unreadable the file is written from what the page holds and the toast says "Saved FILE, but some entries could not be read".
- **Deleting a session** that holds study entries asks first ("Its N study entries are kept, but no page shows them without the session."). The entries stay stored.
- **Storage (all new, all hers alone):** IndexedDB `lcm-study` v1 (stores `rec` keyed by id with an index on `d.ses`; `pic` and `meta` made now, empty, so the picture step needs no upgrade) and localStorage `lcm-study-outbox` (the second copy, every record until a cloud confirms it) + `lcm-study-dev` (this device's id). **Never** in `lcm-me`, a `daybook*` key, the clinic's cloud row, the backup file, a snapshot, or a log. The library opens the first time a Study row is drawn, never while the app starts.
- **A record** (format 1): `{ id, f: 1, t: "entry", d: { kind: "note" | "case", visit: "" | "new" | "return", txt, day, at: "HH:MM" | "", tz, live, trip, ses, sesW, sk, who, whoz, venue }, s: { field: stamp }, h: [{ k, v, up }] (newest 20), made, dev, up, del, cs }`. The session's facts (teacher, venue, kind, title) are copied onto the entry when it is made, so an entry still says where it was written after the session is edited or deleted.
- **Saving:** memory first, then both copies (`phStuSave`): 300 ms after a keystroke, at once on leaving a field, on Next entry, when the tab hides or the lid closes. The outbox is written at once. **The store is never written before it has been read in this page life** (`phStuRead`; the write waits behind `phStuLoad`, and writes the records as they stand then), so an older copy can never go over a newer one. An entry that missed a copy goes again with every later save until both hold it (`phStuLag`); if a batch does not fit the outbox, this entry still goes alone. Neither copy = the red save banner ("Couldn't save that study entry on this device. Copy your text somewhere safe."), a retry every 5 s, and the banner comes back if she closed it while it still fails. A store write counts after 4 s without an answer as failed, a read after 8 s, an open after 4 s. The store taken away while the page is open turns the line on at once and the next save reads and refills it. On opening, whatever one copy holds that the other lacks, or holds newer, is written across (`phStuLoad`); where memory and the store both changed, the two are merged field by field and the words that lost are kept in the history (`phStuMerge`). An outbox that cannot be read is set aside (`phQuarantineCorrupt`), never overwritten blind. Two windows tell each other (`BroadcastChannel "lcm-study"`).
- **Her hands:** the second press of a double-click is never a tap of its own (a row's words, its pair, its ✕, its time, the box's pair, Back up): `e.detail > 1` in the click listener, and a `mousedown` guard so it cannot take the cursor out of the field or select words in a field a Study button has just put under the pointer. A second press that lands OUTSIDE the Study row, after a first press in the row or on the toast's Undo moved the page, is no tap at all (a venue's ✕ or a fold never answers it): `phStuFirst`, on the window because the trip's own click listener on the document comes first. The same when the first press opened a row's time (`phStuAtIn`). Undo or redo that would change any field other than the one holding the cursor is refused when either is a Study field (`beforeinput`: Chrome keeps one undo history for the page; one Ctrl+Z too many would have taken back the box or gone to a venue's name). Next entry gives a new empty box, so Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y cannot write a filed entry back as a garbled second one. Two removals within the toast's life come back with its one Undo. Esc on a button of an open row closes the row only, never the record under it. A field the cursor comes back to after its row closed is open again from the moment the cursor is in it (`phStuEdBack`, so a rebuild draws it). A mouse press under or outside the Study row with a row or a time open reaches what she pressed: the row closes, the time goes back to its button and the list is redrawn only after the press (`phStuDown`, `phStuHeld`, only a redraw THAT press held back). The pointer listeners do nothing else anywhere in the app, except that a double-click's second press is held back as above.
- **How it was made:** a read-only map of the trip session, the Me store, the deploy files, the IndexedDB patterns and the UI conventions; a build spec; a builder; three independent reviews, fixes, a last read; I drove it; then two more review rounds (15 real findings), a revision (spec `step1a-r3-spec.md`, in scratch), three lenses with a skeptic on each finding, fixes, a last read with real mouse and keys, a closing round, and one more hand-on check. Agents' claims were read against the code.
- **Tested** on test copies on their own local storage, with a made-up patient, a made-up trip and made-up entries (never hers), built on the app as saved now: boot with no page error; `phFbrKeyCheck()` empty; the Study row inside the record page; real keys: typing, Ctrl+Enter with the trip clock's time and the session's teacher, venue and kind; a row opened where it sits with the box's words untouched; a redraw in mid-sentence keeps the open row, words and cursor, and typing goes on; a row backspaced key by key to nothing goes back to its words in memory and both copies; Ctrl+Z brings the typing back; typing over and Esc keeps its time; a time changed with real keys (old time in the history, list re-sorted); a double-click on ✕ removes one row and Undo brings it back; a double-click on Return leaves it picked; the Back up file read back; reload shows every row; a session of an earlier day shows its old Note row and a new entry says "Set time"; the outbox removed: rebuilt from the store; the store deleted with the page open: "One copy on this device" at once; after a reload: refilled from the outbox; the words are in neither `lcm-me` nor any other key; at 360x469: no sideways scroll, fields at 16px, an open row's time, pair and ✕ on one line. By the reviewers' harnesses (headless Chrome, real mouse, finger taps by touch emulation, keys, injected faults): storage full, room for a short entry only, the store slow, dead, dead then back, an unreadable outbox, a store write or read that never answers, each across a reload; a press held and dragged; Tab and Shift+Tab round trips. After the last fixes, all together on one build: every earlier reproduction again (each of the ten hand-on faults closed, real output); the press matrix against its old output (only each fix's own change); 9 random walks of real presses and keys, 2,300+ steps, 0 words lost; 179 ordinary controls on 9 other tabs with real single clicks, the same as without the patch. Then the same real-key run by hand on the final copy, on the app as saved now.
- **Not tested:** her laptop, her real record, her real trip; a real phone or touch screen (phone size only, and finger taps emulated); typing Chinese with a real input method (read in the code; simulated only); a real second window (its message was called by hand); the lid closing mid-sentence (read); a truly full disk (a refusal was imitated); a mouse released outside the window; a real right-click menu.

## A rail step that opened no page: one plan + a prescription not on a plan (2026-11-07)

Her report: "my fang bing ren page doesnt open", with a screenshot: a white page, Treatment Care Plan lit in the rail although she pressed Fang Bing Ren.

- **Cause (found on her own records, read-only, in her installed build):** `presStagePlanAutoOpen` opened a plan on the first landing only when there was one plan and nothing loose, and on every render only when there were several plans. **One plan AND a prescription with no `phaseTag` (`presTpLooseScripts`) fell between the two:** `presTpInlinePlanId` stayed null, so `presTpInlineHtml` drew the plan list for every rail step that is a page of a plan (Fang Bing Ren, Today's visit, Treatment, the exam pages), with Treatment Care Plan lit (`!plan`). The list is short and the rail is tall, so with the page scrolled down to reach the step she saw only white. Exactly 6 of the 97 patients with plans at CBD, and every other patient opened it; the one on her screen is one of the 6 (same rail facts). It is not from the study box: the rule dates from 2026-10-13.
- **Fix:** the render rule now also opens the plan for one plan + something loose. Those patients have the plan tabs ("Not on a plan", "+ New"), so "‹ All plans" is hidden for them as it is for several plans; one plan and nothing loose keeps "‹ All plans" as its door to the list and to + New. **`phFlowOpenAPlan`** (the rail's `data-flow-go` and `phFlowGoPlanTab`): a rail step tapped from the "Not on a plan" list, the new-plan form, "‹ All plans" or an open patient letter opens the plan's page; a patient with no plan yet keeps the form. (The letter was an independent reader's find: the rail stayed stuck on it. A half-filled + New loses only its combine switch and ticks; the form has no typed fields.)
- **Tested:** old build, a made-up patient with one plan + a loose prescription, real press: stays on the list, Treatment Care Plan lit (her fault). Fixed build: lands on the plan; real press opens Fang Bing Ren with its row lit; Today's visit, Treatment and the plan open; "Not on a plan" opens and holds over a repaint, and a rail press from it opens the page; + New holds over a repaint; a rail press from a letter opens the page; no page errors. **On her records:** her installed text with these exact swaps, in a read-only frame (writes go to memory, no sync, no service worker) in her Chrome: all 45 patients with one plan and an untagged record, including the 6 that stay loose: Fang Bing Ren opens with no error. An independent reader attacked the fix: no fault, one addition (the letter). A closed plan opened this way writes nothing (`phIvfDaySync`, `phTpSelfCloseSweep`, `phTpSyncPlansOnOpen` act on active plans only).
- **Not tested:** her own window, a phone or touch. **Noticed, a change she will see:** a return patient with one plan + a loose prescription now lands on Today's visit like every other return patient.
- **Found in passing, not changed:** the worker's `install` takes the page with `c.add`, which may answer from the browser's 10-minute copy: on her laptop right after the publish, the waiting worker's cache `lcm-20261107-013500` held the page of 20261106-180400. An Update taken with signal corrects itself on the next open (the fetch handler stores the network copy), so only an Update followed by opening with no signal would show the older build. `new Request(u, { cache: "reload" })` for the page would close it.
- **LIVE in build 20261107-021600** (her word, 2026-11-07; 6de2fad8, publish fd74968c). The live page was read back: it holds the new rule, `phFlowOpenAPlan` and the Study row. Her devices need the gold Update.


## 2026-11-07 · Whole-app audit: bugs, files, consistency (her "do an audit of app to resolve any bugs, clean up the files if necessary, look for app ui inconsistencies and resolve")
Audit = apply. Sixteen readers, one area each, read the whole code and the side files; a second reader tried to refute each finding: 252 of 256 stood. The fixes went on a copy of the newest saved build; fourteen more readers tried to break the fixes, gave 66 more repairs (the one for names was stopped by a filter, so that one was done by hand) and wrote a test per area. Real patient names are never written here (this repo is public).
- **Data-loss fixes:** a merge or rename kept only a list of named stores and lost the phone, email, opt-out, sessions and more; the old record came back from the cloud (`phMergeFillGaps`, `PHARMACY.deletedPatients`, read in `mergePatientsByRecency`). A device with no merge base could push the app's seed or the other clinic's copy into a row (`localReady`, `afterAuth`). Sign out wiped unsent edits when the save failed and revoked the login on her other devices. A double tap on Arrived or Finish added stock twice. Saving a herb's form raised its $/g. Undo of a Log delete allowed a second dispense. Scheduled dispense's Confirm did nothing, or deducted twice.
- **Clinical fixes:** a past miscarriage or live birth read as pregnant for good and hid the cycle; Quick log wrote egg numbers over an older round; plans closed one visit early; Close plan and a deleted acute plan left the main plan paused; IVF re-run dropped phases for good (now in Recently deleted); a self-added sign could never score; a phase skipped could be Moved onto.
- **The day:** `TODAY` moves in place past midnight (`phTodayRoll`), so a tab left open overnight no longer dates bookings, sent marks, meals or dispenses yesterday. CLAUDE.md's Trap is rewritten. Mine and Meals' own fixes for this were dropped for the root fix.
- **Screens:** the side lines the sweep missed, pills to 6px, icon-only to 32px circles, coloured words to ink, Fitness' C22 chips, off-scale corners, explaining sentences, example placeholders, A–Z misses, the Latin half of herb names, "script" to prescription, emoji to the sprite, hand-typed she / her.
- **Safety:** a crafted #trip link could run script (`esc`), flashes and an intake row were trusted as HTML, a partial restore could wipe a section, a restore wrote keys that were not LCM's, a file or on-device backup from the other clinic now warns or leaves the list.
- **Patient pages:** My Cycle installed opened a demo chart; note, weight and medicines never woke Save; a page left open overnight saved today's temperature over yesterday's; an old link replaced a working one; the service worker could store an error page; the intake form refused a period that began today before 11 am.
- **Egg pages:** regenerating them showed a trap from 11/6: the reduced-motion helper was two lines, the pages copy one, so the setting would have quietly stopped working there. It is one line now.
- **Left for her word (not built):** the list is in `mocks/audit-2026-11-07.html` and her reply. Whole-app sync timing she took off the backlog stays as it is.
- **Files and privacy:** names out of comments and docs, `PH_RETYPE_NEVER` emptied, install pictures retaken with no patient at all under new names, audits and mocks and `ia/` untracked and kept in `mocks/`, her two sign-in addresses out of `supabase/me_setup.sql`, two more export names in `.gitignore`. **History and the older public copies still hold what was there: that is her decision.**
- **Checked on the page:** every area's test in the sandbox (stock 67, dispense 39, midnight 30, sync 15, Cycle and IVF 54, Care Plan 45, Meals and Mine 28, Ren and FBR 53, safety 26, patient pages 36, screens 139 and 15, Communications 33 of 35: the two left expected the older roll, which the review changed on purpose), the press test on the fixed copy (1220 px: 77 pages, 1,499 presses; 360 px: 77 pages, 1,521 presses; no page error, blank page, sideways scroll or cut-off), the offline harness (off, lie, late, expired and fresh sign-in, 31 s with no wall, GET + POST with no cover), owner tag (true, foreign false). **Not exercised:** real cloud sync between two devices, real sign-out, her live data, the patient pages on a real link. ## Her whole-app audit, the clinical six (2026-11-08)

Six of the "31 wait for your word" questions from the whole-app audit (`mocks/audit-2026-11-07.html`), her picks on the clinical group, all the recommended options.

- **IVF transfer counts** (`phIvfFrozenUsed` / `phIvfFreezeAvail`): a cancelled transfer logged with Count 0 was counted as 1 used, so a cancelled transfer quietly ate one frozen embryo from the bank. `(x.count || 1)` → `x.count` in the three frozen/fresh "used" tallies — a real 0 now stays 0. Her pick: cancelled keeps it frozen.
- **Phase delete** (`phTpPhaseDeleteNow`): deleting the phase that was current left no phase current. It now hands current to the phase that moves up into the deleted one's place, or the phase before it if the deleted one was last. Her pick: next phase moves up.

Her pick: the phase that ends.
- **Red flag wording** (the Pause box on Ask her): cut the second sentence ("This shows on Today's visit and the Treatment tab until you clear it; it never stops you logging") — the box still says Pause and lists what's ticked. Her pick: cut the second sentence.
- **Australian spelling on screen:** Gynaecological masses, gynaecological blood-stasis signs/presentations, oestrogen (FET Prep aim, the FET Prep desc, Frozen — medicated), diarrhoea (the five diagnosis/sign labels that said it), anaemia (the qi-blood deficiency diagnosis label). Identity keys (`anemia_qb`, `alcohol_vomit_diarrhea`, `dx_postchole_diarrhea`, `dx_postchole_diarrhea_now`, `vomit_diarrhea_cold_limbs`) are untouched — only the words she reads changed. ## Abdomen chart: basic drawing faded, motion and touch (2026-11-09)
- **Her words:** "add more animations or interactive elements. the fundamental drawing of the abdomen needs to be more faded. show mock".
- **Mock** (`mocks/abdomen-fade-motion-mock-2026-11-09.html` + `.jpg`, the real chart output, live controls). **Her picks:** fade = Ghost; hover link, press
  ripple, heat and frost, Today / Both / Last bar, scan in once per open + Replay (all five).
- **Code** (`index.html`):
  - Fade: the anatomy groups carry `.ph-abd2-b` (dotted lines, ribs, rectus) and the outline `.ph-abd2-bs`; CSS gives them, the bones and the points
    `--abd-f` (default .28) / `--abd-fs` (.55) on `.ph-abd2-svg:not(.ro)`, so the `.ro` minis (Visit checks, Care Plan, trend sheet, Key-sign scene) keep full strength.
  - Today's layers sit in `<g class="ph-abd2-nowl">` (dist + heat / frost, and top); last visit stays `.ph-abd3-prev`.
  - Hover link: `phAbdHl` / `phAbdHlClear` (delegated mouseover / mouseout, only when `(any-hover: hover)`): a tint overlay on the place, `.foc` dims the anatomy, the
    other words go `.dim`, the side band `.hl`; hover a side band and its places light on the front.
  - Press rings: a capture-phase click listener draws `phAbdRipple` at the tap (the svg's `data-ten` = the chart's Tension sets reach, seconds, rings, line);
    `phAbdTap` lets `phAbdAfterPaint` carry the rings on after the repaint the tap causes (negative animation delay = the age).
  - Heat and frost: `phAbdTempMotion(m, Z, uid)` in `marksSvg` (live charts only): warm = 4 wavy lines rising, cold / cool = frost specks drifting, each clipped to its place and the skin; whole = the centre column.
  - Today / Both / Last: `phVisitAbdHtml` draws one joined `.ph-tng2-seg` bar (`data-abd3="view:*"`) plus the Replay 32px circle (`data-abd3="replay:"`, `i-refresh`) under the
    front chart, replacing the two key dots; `presAbdView` (reset on open) sets `data-view` on `.ph-abd3-left`; the bar's taps update in place (`phAbdViewApply`), no repaint.
    Last fades today's marks to 8% and shows last visit's at full; Today fades last visit's.
  - Sweep in: the first render of a patient's chart in an open carries `scan0` (key `phAbdScanKey`, cleared in `presOpenScript`; not on an empty chart or under reduced motion):
    a scan line (`.ph-abd2-scan`) moves ribs to pubis in 1.5 s and each mark fades in as it reaches its height (`--sd` from `phAbdSd`); pure CSS, so nothing can stay hidden.
    Replay removes and re-adds the class. A repaint (any tap) drops it.
  - All of it off under reduced motion (the Replay circle hidden); the side chart gets the fade, hover link and rings, not heat / frost / sweep / Today-Last.
- **Tested** (sandbox, the real `phVisitAbdHtml` / `phAbdChartSvg` / `phAbdSideSvg` drawn into a made-up host, no patient): fade computed .28 / .55 on the live chart, 1 / 1 on a `.ro`
  mini; hover on the R flank tinted it, dimmed 8 words, lit the side umb band; a tap made 3 rings + dot at soft tension; Last / Replay set `data-view` / `scan0`; no duplicate ids;
  tap-audit at 1280: only the existing `.ph-tng2-seg` bars (Seen, Whole abdomen and the new bar alike, 29px in this bare host) flagged, the Replay circle passes; 360: the bar wraps in the 144px figure.
- **Not tested:** a real patient (the exam page, the Guide's chart, a tap that paints a mark, with the popup); the repaint carrying the rings in the live flow; reduced motion by running it; the Key2;
  the Guide's copy of the chart (shares the code); the bar's 29px / 999 corners are the existing `.ph-tng2-seg` look in this host, not re-measured in the real page.
- **Pages checked:** the Abdomen exam page chart + side view only (the Guide's Abdomen chart shares the same code and the same host class).

## Title bar: one centre line, and a check so it stays (2026-11-09)
- **Her words:** "see the problem? fix it and prevent from happening in the future" (screenshot of the Guide's bar: Me, Families, the search box, Learned 0 of 42).
- **The problem:** Me sat 8px lower than Families, the search box and the Learned pill (22 vs 14px from the top; the pill was 28px, the rest 32px). Cause: since her 2026-11-08 "merge these lines into one" the Guide's head (`.ph-gd-head`) rides inside the title bar, but kept its `margin-bottom: 16px` from when it was its own row; the bar centres its children, so the 16px pushed the whole cluster 8px up. The same fault sat on the Log (`.ph-widget-head` 14px top), All templates, Directory and Dispenses (`.ph-widget-head` 10-12px bottom margin / padding): found by the new check, not by her.
- **Fix** (`index.html`): `#pharmacyPage .ph-shell-titlebar > :not(h1) { margin-block: 0 !important }` and `> div { padding-block: 0 !important }` beside `.ph-tbmerge` (the guard: no vertical margin or padding on anything the bar centres); the Learned pill `.ph-gdf-prog` 28px to 32px (the chip size).
- **Prevention:** `.github/scripts/titlebar-audit.js` (`lcmTitlebarAudit()`): lists any control whose centre is off its row's line by more than 1px, a single row off the bar's centre by more than 1.5px, and any vertical margin on a wrapper in the bar. CLAUDE.md gets the rule "TOP BAR" (Fit the screen) and a line in "Before finishing".
- **Tested** (sandbox, the real app): before the fix the check flagged the Guide, Log, All templates, Directory and Dispenses (Me 4-9px off); after it, all 21 pages with a bar are clean at 1220 and at 360 (phone); bar heights are now one value (58-59px, Photos 97 with its second row); the Guide's Families menu opens fully with the bar aligned; tap audit on the Guide's bar (menu open) 14 of 14 ok.
- **Not tested:** the Key2; a patient page's own bar (Today's visit and the others draw their head inside the plan stage, not through `phShellHead`); the Cycle / Appointments calendar bar (it has its own bar, the check read it as clean).
- **SAVED, not live:** goes out with her next "push live".

## 2026-11-09 · Fang Bing Ren board: a tick repaints in place
Her pick in a popup, after the hover fix above: "Yes, do it here" (a tick redrew the whole board), then "Push live" on the numbers.
- **Measured (sandbox, a made-up patient, the same row ticked 8 times a round, 3 rounds):** a tick took a median 220 ms on the computer
  layout (1220) and 840 ms on the phone layout (360). Where it went: `phTriHtml` built 500 KB of HTML (about 100 ms), then
  `outerHTML` swapped in all 6,800 parts of the page and laid them out (about 150 ms). Inside the build the same questions were
  asked again and again: the Ren leader (`phFbrRenLead`) 8 times, a side's effective ticks (`phTriEffective`) 6, the pattern clues
  (`phPatClues`) 8, the sign list (`phTriAll`) about 720 times (80 per `phFbrRank`), and every row's colour family
  (`phFbrSignFam`) over all 40 families.
- **Built:**
  - `phTriMorph` / `phTriMorphNode`: the same HTML is parsed into a template. An equal part stays (`isEqualNode`); a part whose shape
    changed (its child count, or a running picture `__pp`) is swapped whole; attributes and text are set in place; every field
    ends on its markup value, as the full redraw left it. If the build has more than one root it falls back to `outerHTML`.
    (`phMorph` stays the composer's: keyed children, typed words kept.)
  - `phTriMemo` + `phTriMemoGet`: one memo while ONE build runs (`phTriHtml` wraps `phTriHtmlBody`; `phTriRefresh` opens it for the
    page and the cards beside it: growing triangle, Today's card, the switch, the side rail; never the Compass, which may write).
    Served from it: `phTriEffective` (a copy each time; key = side + her picks + carried ticks), `phPatClues` (a copy),
    `phFbrRenLead` (a family id), `phTriAll` (a copy; a fresh call re-sorts, is never served from it, and drops the plain answer).
    Outside a build every call is as before.
  - `phFbrSignFam`: kept per side + sign (+ a learned sign's own points) until `phFbrEditsBust`, which runs on every weight edit and
    every replace of PHARMACY; lazy, so boot never meets an uninitialised Map.
- **Now:** a median 100 ms a tick on the computer layout (from 220), 310 ms on the phone layout (from 840); the build 59 ms (from 96).
- **Tested** (sandbox, a build copy on c9937d7b's index, nothing saved): after each of 26 taps (Bing and Ren ticks and unticks, rule
  out and undo, the Tongue & pulse block, Show All / Ticked / Still to ask, a family tile, two tiles, clearing them, an area folded
  and opened, ticks at 360) the page equals a plain full build, apart from two things a full redraw has too: a mounted picture
  (`svg[data-pp]`, drawn after the paint) and Ask her's one-off `ph-qr in` class. The memo build is byte for byte the plain build
  (no memo, no colour cache) in every state, on the page's first open (fresh) too; the switch and Today's card the same. A weight
  edit through `PHARMACY.fbrEdits` + `phFbrEditsSync` moves a row's colour family and undoing it moves it back. Console clean, no
  sideways scroll; tap audit the same as before (the markup is the same).
- **Not tested:** her real records; the Key2.
- **Found, already there before today (her pick: fix it next, mock first):** on the phone layout the board's Ren column is cut off at
  the right edge and its tick buttons measure 8 px tall.
- **Published on her popup "Push live"** with this commit.

  idempotent-by-key seed pattern as the Sources library). A `Formula family` picker on the card
  links a case to its PH_FORMULAS entry; 8 cases matched with reasonable confidence on name or

## Guide: Sources and Tour Cases fill the page again, 2026-11-09

Her "look at the display -- see the problem" on Tour Cases, picker wrapped to 3-per-row and the
card confined to a narrow strip with a huge blank area to its right.

Root cause: `.ph-gdf` is the Families tab's own two-column layout (`display:grid`,
`grid-template-columns: 318px minmax(0,1fr)` -- a rail, then the wide content pane), not a plain
styling wrapper. Sources and Tour Cases both reused it just to pick up its card/button CSS, each
with one content div -- which an implicit grid drops into that first 318px rail column, leaving
the second column empty. Same bug in both, same fix: `grid-column:1 / -1` on that one div.
Confirmed in the harness: Tour Cases' picker now fits 7-per-row and the card fills the page;
Sources is back to its own 560px reading width. **SAVED, not live:** goes out with her next
"push live".

(the formula's person). Tour Cases is the "B33 C4 LCM" session's code; it had confirmed no unsaved work there.

- **The round ticks are gone** (`.tcd-tk`, `.tcd-r`, `.tcd-tkbar`, the `data-tc-tick` tap). Side by side is picked from the
  open case: a chip **"Compare with… ▾"** at the end of the case bar (`phTcCaseBarHtml(c, t, cmp)`; the chip is built in
  `phTcDayHtml`) opens a list of the other cases by number, a tick box each (the Complaint filter's own list, `.ph-cmp-addl`);
  a pick puts that case beside the open one and the list stays open for more (`data-tc-cwpick`; the same `phGdTcTick`, the
  open case first). The chip then reads "Compare with · N ▾" in teal and a chip **"Close compare"** follows it
  (`data-tc-tick-clear`, as before). Unpicking the last one = one case again. "Working on" is unchanged. In the list the
  open case is the teal row and a case beside it has a teal outline (`.tcd-pg.cw`).
- **Day chips** (`phTcDayHtml`): a day is a chip only once it holds a case, plus the day she is on; **"All days ▾"** after
  them lists every day with its count (a tap goes to that day, `data-tc-dday`), and is not drawn when every day has a case.
  "Not placed" as before. The row wraps now, it does not scroll sideways (a list has to open under it).
- **`phGdTcPop`** = which of the two lists is open, `"days"` or `"cw"`; a tap outside or Esc closes it (`phTcClick`,
  `phTcKey`). Both lists open from their row's left edge, under the row (the chip's wrapper is `position: static` inside
  `.tcd-tabs` / `.tcd-cb`), so they stay on the screen at every width; the Compare list is at most 440px or the row's width,
  a long formula line ends in "…".
- **A case's row** = its formula's person, then "n · complaint" in bold and the formula under it (was "Case n", complaint,
  formula on three lines). **`phTcPerHtml(fam)`**: the one body (`PH_BODY_GEOM.svg`) with the formula's own build
  (`phFsBuild`, the build of the formula's film), head and shoulders (`viewBox 40 -2 140 168`), 40 x 48. Drawn once a family
  into a hidden holder (`#phTcPerDefs`, one `<g id="phTcPer_<family>">` each) and reused by every row through `<use>`, so 15
  rows cost 12 drawings. A case with no family yet shows the usual person. The picture carries `data-keep-size` (a picture,
  not a tap target; the whole row is the tap).
- Tested on a test copy (15 seed cases, one tour of 11 days, Day 1 holding all 15): the list, All days → an empty day (it
  shows as a chip while she is on it) → back; Compare with one, two, then unpicking both; Close compare; Esc and a tap
  outside close a list; a tap on another case ends the compare; Places and My patients still open; no errors. Tap audit clean
  at 1220 and 360 with each list open and with two cases side by side; no sideways page scroll at 360. NOT tested: her real
  cases, a tour with cases on several days, a place that is not a tour, keyboard-only use of the lists.

## Ban Xia Hou Po Tang's film: a chapter for each condition, 2026-11-11

Her synth22 item 6, on the Ban Xia Hou Po Tang card: "make a more advanced video/animation of how this formula works on the
symptoms and conditions it is indicated for". Her picks: **C · Both** (inside the body first, then a chapter per condition) and
**Ban Xia Hou Po Tang first** (the others on her word). Her word to save it: "save the film and show me".

- **What plays.** The four stops as before (Person, Trouble, Formula at work, Settled: 1:46, unchanged), then five chapters,
  one a condition: Plum-pit Throat · Anxiety, Tight Chest · Nausea, Vomiting · Cough with Phlegm · Bloating. 4:18 in all
  (was 1:50). A chapter (29.8 s) plays on that condition's own sign picture, full stage: its title; **How it forms** (the
  picture comes up as the trouble does, a mark shows the cause); her own row words; one more sign she feels; each herb chip
  in its turn (Ban Xia · Hou Po, Zi Su Ye · Sheng Jiang, Fu Ling: the picture eases a third each, the herb's chip lights, a
  mark shows what the herb does); **Eased**.
- **Told her plainly:** the first part is the same film. Nothing "deeper inside the body" was added to it; the new
  inside-the-organ work is the five chapters. The five conditions are Claude's grouping of the formula's Bing signs (it has
  no Diagnosis rows, so `phFsStory().dx` is empty); every word of a chapter is Claude's DRAFT (a Draft pill beside the chips).
- **`PH_FS_COND[id]`** (only `banxiahoupotang` today) = the chapters: `n` name, `main` the sign whose picture it plays on,
  `more` one more sign, `at` where the marks sit on that picture (a share of the stage), `at0` where they sit once the
  picture has settled when the picture itself moves as it eases (the throat close-up slides to the middle: its viewBox is
  `62 + 44a`), `form` [mark, words], `herbs` {herb chip: [mark, words]}, `eased`. A formula with no entry plays as before.
- **Shots** (`phFsShots`): a condition's chapter is stop 10, 11, ... in `CH` (its name through `phSymCase`). Every shot now
  has **`sk`** = the body scene's stop in that shot (default = its `stop`); a chapter walks 0, 1, 2 inside itself. New shot
  kind **`cond`**: `a0` to `a1` = how strong the trouble is across the shot, `fx` = [mark, at, at0], `inK` / `outK` = the
  picture holds from the shot before / to the next (no fade between a chapter's own shots), `c0` = the picture's clock start.
  The "one more sign" is an ordinary `sign` shot. A sign that is not one of the film's groups (Cough, weight 3) gets a loose
  group (`{ keys, pl, loose }`) and its row label as words.
- **Player** (`phFsMount`): `kOf` now glides the scene's stop wherever a shot changes `sk` (the same result as before for
  the other films: it changed only at a chapter's first shot); `sh.sk` replaces `sh.stop` where the scene's state or a
  picture's strength is read. The chapter chips are `[data-fp-stop="10"...]`, so `phFsJump`, the lit chip and the scrub
  bar's segments (nine) needed no change.
- **The marks** (`phFsFxMake`, `phFsFxStep`; `<svg class="fs-fx">`, 384 x 240, over the pictures; only in a film with
  chapters, the card's class `adv`): knot (green qi threads wind in, grey flecks stick), gather (flecks), up (rust
  chevrons), press (four arrows in), swell (rings) = the trouble; down (teal chevrons), open (arcs spreading), drain (blue
  drops) = a herb; clear (a green ring) = eased. Made once a shot (inside `.fs-player`, so the page watchers skip it), a
  frame only writes transforms and opacity. A tapped tile clears them. Reduced motion: one still pose.
- **The card:** a "Conditions" row of five chips under the Person · Trouble · Formula at work · Settled bar (`phFsCondHtml`,
  `.fs-cond`); the words band is two lines tall on this card (`.gf-fs.adv .fs-sub`, 58px) so a sentence does not move the
  controls; full screen leaves room for the extra row.
- **Tested on a test copy:** the film sought every 0.4 s from 0:00 to 4:18 with no error and no empty picture (17 pictures
  made); a condition chip jumps and lights; a stop chip, a herb chip and a sign tile still work (a tile clears the marks);
  Wen Dan Tang (no chapters) plays as before, 1:58, no chips; a herb family card still opens. Tap audit clean on the card at
  1366, 1220 and 360; no sideways page scroll at 360. Eighteen frames looked at (each chapter's How it forms and first
  herb; all of the throat chapter). A first build left the throat's marks behind when the picture slid: `at0` fixed it.
- **NOT tested:** real-time playback and frame rate (the test pane has no frames; frames were made by seeking), Full screen,
  reduced motion, the Key2. The local MP4 of this film in `refs/films/` is now the older, shorter film (not re-recorded).

## Every formula's film: condition chapters, bold herb marks, captions, pattern-effect marks, 2026-11-12

Her word after Ban Xia Hou Po Tang's film went live (build 20261112-013100): "do the same for all formulas". Built
without a round of questions: she asked for the same treatment, and it is the "Both" she picked on 11/11 with "Ban Xia
Hou Po Tang first". The 30 other formula films now have what that one has.

- **One table, `PH_FS_ADV[id] = { w, a, c }`** (31 formulas; `phFsAdv(id)` reads it, an id with no entry gets an empty
  one). It replaces `PH_FS_COND`, `PH_FS_WORKFX` and `PH_FS_ALLFX`. `w[chip] = [marks, the band's words, place?, size?]`
  is a herb chip at work on the body; `a[sign] = [mark, caption, place?]` is one of the whole formula's pictures;
  `c[] = { n, main, more?, at?, at0?, form: [mark, words], herbs: { chip: [marks, words] }, eased }` is a chapter. Ban Xia
  Hou Po Tang's entry keeps its words and its hand-set places.
- **A mark finds its own place** (no hand-set points for 30 films). On the body: the dot of the herb's own label
  (`svg.__labs`, the leader's circle; `bodyFx` in `phFsShots`), unless `w` gives a place (Huang Lian Jie Du Tang's three
  burner chips do). On a sign's picture: `phFsAtOf(L, key)` = the scene's spot in `PH_FS_AT` (25 scenes; four numbers
  when the picture moves as it eases), else the middle of the picture's own glow (`.ksfx ellipse`, mapped from the
  picture's viewBox to the 384 x 240 overlay the way the picture is fitted), else the middle. A tongue or a pulse chart
  takes no marks, only its caption.
- **Fifteen new marks** beside the twelve there (27 in all, `phFsFxMake` / `phFsFxStep`). The trouble: `pool` (water,
  damp), `clot` (blood stasis), `heat` (flames rise), `cold` (frost closes in), `leak` (sweat or fluids not held),
  `flutter` (a jittering line: heart or spirit unsettled), `empty` (grey rings shrink: qi, blood or essence low). A herb
  or the formula: `lift`, `unclot`, `cool` (the fire dies back under cool waves), `warm` (a glow, its rays going out),
  `build` (plus signs flow in, the middle fills), `calm` (a jagged line smooths to a slow wave), `seal` (a broken ring
  closes), `moisten` (drops fall in and spread). Their colours are marks (the colour law): `PH_FS_FXC`.
- **A line of words stays up long enough to read** (`read(words, min)` in `phFsShots`: 1.6 s + .24 s a word, never less
  than the shot's own time). Ban Xia Hou Po Tang's film is 4:25 for it (was 4:18). The others: 2:03 (Wai Tai Fu Ling Yin,
  two chapters), 2:27 (Xiao Jian Zhong Tang, two), 2:58 to 3:38 (three chapters), 4:10 (Xue Fu Zhu Yu Tang, four).
- **The card.** The chapter chips row ("Conditions", `phFsCondHtml`) is on every formula's film and always carries the
  Draft pill, Gui Zhi Tang's too (its first words are read, `PH_FS_READ`; these are new). Her own Diagnosis rows line
  under it is named "Diagnoses" when a film has chapters, so two rows are not both "Conditions" (`phFsDxHtml`). `.adv`
  is on whenever a formula has an entry. A chapter's second sign is skipped when it shares the first one's picture.
  **Cover › Signs** now blurs the chapter chips too (a chapter's name is its signs); a blurred chip still jumps.
- **The words are Claude's DRAFT, all of them:** 94 chapters (89 new; two to five a formula), each a grouping of her own
  rows under a name Claude chose, with a How it forms line, a line for each herb chip (273) and an Eased line; a caption
  for every herb chip's turn (112) and every whole-formula picture (121). Only Wai Tai Fu Ling Yin's second chapter uses
  a sign outside that formula's own rows (`appetite_poor_tend`; it has four rows). No pronoun names the person.
- **A second reader checked the words** (an independent medical read of the table against each formula's standard
  composition and actions): no errors; ten weak points, nine changed. Yu Ping Feng San: Fang Feng disperses, it does not
  seal (`open`; "so none is sealed in"), and the puffiness caption says the qi firms the flesh (the formula has no
  draining herb). Ban Xia Xie Xin Tang: "Warms the middle, dries damp" and "the clear sinks". Huang Lian Tang: Huang
  Lian's heat is in the chest (Shang Han Lun 173). Shen Qi Wan: "refill the yin and essence that drain away". Si Ni San:
  the cold hands warm by `open`, not `warm` (no warm herb; the contrast with Si Ni Tang). Xiao Chai Hu Tang: "Frees the
  pivot, appetite returns". Chai Ling Tang: "the held damp". Left for her: Shen Qi Wan's chips name Shu Di, Shan Yao, Ze
  Xie, Fu Ling (the Jin Gui text has dried Di Huang; Shan Zhu Yu and Mu Dan Pi are on no chip). Those are the app's
  existing chips, not this build's words.
- **From reading the frames** (a contact sheet of every film's key frames): Yu Ping Feng San's "Catches every cold"
  forms with `press` (arrows in), not `leak` (hollow drops over the lungs read as bleeding); the `empty` rings are darker
  and thicker; the 23 longest How it forms lines were shortened to about 19 words.
- **The phone at 360:** a picture's caption stays two lines (13 were three, over a 155 x 97 picture: shortened, e.g.
  "Bladder qi moves the water") and a line of words stays three (two were four and made the band grow: shortened, five
  more for margin). A caption fits two lines at about 28 characters, a line of words three lines at about 105.

  San; the same on the live build). On a computer those chips are now 30px, so the bar is the Guide's 32px
  (`@media (min-width: 641px)` beside the card's own rule; a wrapped bar is 62px, was 54px; the phone is unchanged).

the words: against the sources, against the herbs' actions, and against her own Ren / Bing rows and card lines). Then a
checker tried to refute each point. No error in the code. In the words one line was wrong (Xue Fu Zhu Yu Tang, below); the
rest are small. Only points that stood were changed.

    which turns the teaching round: the spirit is what is housed; three readers and the checker).

    was the only one in the table).

  - Gui Zhi Jia Long Gu Mu Li Tang's Gui Zhi · Shao Yao "close the surface, hold the yin" (the pair's joint effect;

  blurred, but the same name stood in clear on the picture for the chapter's first 2 s. A stop's title (Person, Trouble,

- Tested on test copies: the code of this build with ten word changes (these four, and six the checker then judged fair
  as built) on all 31 films at 1366 and at 360: sought every 0.45 s from start to end, no error; the tap audit clean on
  every card; a line of words two lines at most (three at 360), the band keeps its height, every caption inside its

## Patient profile: search patients by sign or symptom (2026-11-12)
- **Her words:** "allow for me to search my patients based on signs and symptoms e.g. hot above umbilicus cold below".
- **Built** (`index.html`): before `renderPrescriptions`, `phPtSxLab` (Fang Bing Ren key -> label), `phPtSxLines(rec)` (a patient's findings as lines `{src, text, date, m}`, `m` = the words matched: the text plus hidden everyday words such as navel / belly button / upper / lower / hot / heat), `phPtSxHits(name, q)`, `phPtSxHtml`. In `renderPresList`'s list filter a patient not found by name / formula / herb / notes is kept when `phPtSxHits` finds a line (`sxHits`); `tlRow` (computer), the phone card and the table row show the line. CSS `.ph-sxhit` beside `.ph-pl-age`. Abdomen concepts: a mark at a zone reads "<mark> above / at / below the umbilicus, <zone>" (`phAbdRowOf`); warm (+1) / cool (-1) / cold (-2) averaged above vs below gives "warmer above the umbilicus, colder below (her marks)"; `tempC` epi - lower >= 1.0 °C gives "hot above the umbilicus, cold below: epi .. °C, lower .. °C, lower .. °C cooler" (the reverse for <= -1.0). The 1 °C line is a judgement call (CV4 is normally the coolest spot): change `Math.abs(diff) >= 1` to move it.
- **Tested** (sandbox, three seeded patients): A epi 34.2 / lower 32.6 °C, B warm epigastrium + cold lower abdomen (40 days ago), C epi 33.4 / lower 33.0 °C + complaint "Can't sleep" + "Bloated after meals" + Fang Bing Ren Sleep: poor, light. "hot above umbilicus cold below", "heat above cold below", "upper hot lower cold" find A and B (not C, a 0.4 °C gap); "cold below the navel" finds A and B; "insomnia" and "poor sleep" find C (the sign, +1 the complaint); "bloating" finds C's complaint; "Test Al" still finds the name only. Typed into the real box at 1220 and 360 (the phone card shows the line). No console errors. Tap audit at 360 on the list: nothing new; the phone's Sort pills (Recent / Name / Total, `.ph-count-btn`, 26px, 9.5px text) were already off before this build and are left for her word.

## A tour note that says "no" is not the sign (2026-11-12)
- **Found by:** the C22 session (measured on 4b00fed9, 141 cases, 1316 notes): 303 notes got a Tag pre-fill, 51 held a negation word, about 43 of them wrong ("No itchy skin" -> Skin: itchy; "Not scared of cold" -> sensitive to cold; "No period pain" -> Periods: painful; "No high blood pressure" -> Pregnancy: high blood pressure). "Accept all" on such a case would have saved the wrong sign. I took the fix (`phTcSynMatch` is mine).
- **Built** (`index.html`, just above `phTcMatchAll`): `PH_TC_NEG`, `phTcNegRead(t)` -> {pos, neg} word sets, `phTcSynMatchNeg(t)` (memo `PH_TC_NEG_MEMO`); `phTcMatchAll` calls it in place of `phTcSynMatch`. The note splits at ; but however although though (hard) and , . (soft). Each part is first run through `phSynPhrases`, so a negation those phrases already turn into a positive sign stays positive. A part still holding no / not / never / without / none / neither / nor / cannot / nil / denies / n't is negated; when the first part of a stretch opens with one, the whole stretch to the next hard break is negated ("No headache, nausea or dizziness"). A similar-wording match survives when one word of its sign is in a positive part, or the sign label says none / absent / nil / lack / without. The exact-wording list (PH_TC_MATCH) and the exact sign words (`phTcDescMatch`) are untouched; a note with no negation word is matched exactly as before.
- **Tested** (sandbox, all 1316 notes: 15 tour seeds + PH_TC_HH): 41 pre-fills removed, every one a denial; kept right: "Sweating that does not stop" (Sweat: profuse), "Pulse not very deep, slippery" and "Pulse not tight, slippery and smooth" (Pulse: slippery, only), "No bitter mouth, but dry" (dry mouth), "Weak pulse, no force", "Short of breath, can't climb stairs", "Doesn't want to eat, low appetite", "No tongue coating, mirror-like, red" (her own list). Controls: "Can't sleep", "No appetite", "No periods for 3 months" still match. No console errors. Two older loose matches without a negation problem stay as they were ("Abdomen soft, no water sounds" -> Heart: soft sounds; "Pain ... can't sleep for pain" -> Legs & knees).
- **SAVED, not live:** goes out only on her own "push live".

## Abdomen synth22, step 4: the side view's bulge, one full dome (2026-11-13)
- **Her words:** "the bulging line more curved / realistic". Her pick B "Full" (plan guide `mocks/abd-synth22-2026-11-12/guide.html`,
  note 2, `bulge-3.png`): bulging places next to each other make one dome.
- **Built** (`index.html`, `phAbdSideWall` only): the positive local bumps (`phAbdSideState().locals`: bulging at a row, full /
  distended at a row) no longer add one bell each; the rows they sit in group into spans of neighbouring rows, and each span is ONE
  dome, `v * sin²(πt)` from 28 units above its first bump's centre to 28 below its last (the centre a bump's own `yc` where it has one,
  the row's middle otherwise), clamped to the xiphoid and the pubis so it eases to nothing there (no kink at the ribs). Its height is
  the span's biggest bump × 1.4 × (1 + 0.22 per extra row): one place 10.5 (was 7.5), three places one dome of 15.1 where the old
  three bells made waves. Where two domes meet the higher wins; a hollow (sunken) keeps its own dip. Whole-belly shapes, the breath,
  the navel dimple, the last visit's grey copy and the big view all read the same function.
- **Tested** (sandbox): five cases drawn before and after (`mocks/abd-synth22-2026-11-12/step4-before.png`, `step4-after.png`):
  bulging at the navel, at three places, at epi + navel, full at the lower row, bulging epi with a sunken lower row; the wall meets
  the ribs (60 at y 24) and the pubis (57.5 at y 143) as before; no marks = the old line; the patient page draws with no error and
  the size check clean. **Not tested:** her real records.
